# oTraiL · India

Personal Android GPS journal for life on the road. Android 11+, targeting Android 15. Map data is never bundled in the APK or committed. All dataset download options run on the phone through Android DownloadManager.

## First run

Open oTraiL once and grant **precise location**, **Allow all the time**, and notifications. Recording starts automatically; there are no Record/Stop mode controls. Live and History affect only the map display. A persistent location foreground service requests GPS every **5 seconds**, with zero minimum movement; Android/GPS delivery can vary. START_STICKY handles ordinary process reclamation. Boot completion (after first unlock) and app replacement both restart tracking when background-location permission is granted. No account or telemetry.

On POCO/HyperOS, enable Background autostart and set App info → Battery → No restrictions. Force-stop, revoked permission, power-off and manufacturer restrictions cannot be overridden by an ordinary app. Reopen oTraiL after force-stop. Boot auto-start is enabled by default; no separate record-mode setting is needed.

### Persistence and Google Drive backup

Updates installed over the existing app and phone restarts preserve the trail database and download state. **Uninstall deletes app-private storage and permissions.** Configure backup before uninstalling.

In Maps & downloads → Choose backup location, use Android's Save picker to select **Google Drive**, open your desired folder and save `otrail-backup.json`; a persistent Documents folder on the phone is also supported. This uses the installed Drive document provider, not embedded account credentials or a backend. If Drive is not offered, enable/install its document provider. The app retains document access and writes a normalized trail snapshot approximately every 15 minutes while tracking; **Back up trail now** writes immediately. The provider controls upload/offline sync, so a successful file write is not proof of completed cloud upload. Verify Drive sync before uninstalling.

Backup includes trips, fixes, stops, update logs, map-provider/offline preferences and completed dataset status references. Coordinates retain WGS84, UTC timestamps and original units. Restore from Google Drive / Files merges the snapshot into current history, remaps trip IDs, skips already-present fixes/stops, preserves new fixes, and rolls back malformed/incomplete backups. Restored journeys are historical; current recording continues. Backup writes to the selected file replace its content: do not manually edit it during a backup.

After reinstall, open the app, regrant permissions, choose **Restore trail from Google Drive / Files**, and select the existing snapshot. Then configure a **new backup target file** for subsequent automatic backups (file permissions cannot silently survive uninstall). Data since the last successful backup is not recoverable after uninstall.

New completed dataset downloads are retained in shared **Downloads/oTraiL** outside app-private storage. After reinstall, import the retained India `.map` through the file picker to rebuild the private rendering copy; no redownload is necessary. Raw PBF also stays in Downloads. Active in-progress download jobs cannot be guaranteed across uninstall; retry those after reinstall. Retained dataset versions can be managed in the phone Files app. The backup is for trail/log/settings data and does not upload multi-GB map files to Drive.

## Providers

| Provider | Use | Phone download |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OpenStreetMap | Online roads + normal viewed-tile cache | No bulk downloads on public tile server |
| Mapsforge / OSM | Full India offline vector map, rendered on-device | Manual Wi-Fi or cellular download/update, about 1.5 GiB |
| Geofabrik / OSM | Optional India raw PBF source data | Manual Wi-Fi or cellular download/update, about 1.6 GiB; **not rendered or used for routing yet** |
| Esri World Imagery | Online satellite + common trail/stop overlays | No offline pack |
| OSRM / FOSSGIS | In-app online driving routes, text guidance and rerouting | Last route cached on phone; no offline graph yet |
| Google Maps / OsmAnd | Optional external navigation | Installed app manages its own data |

Maps & downloads shows estimated size before download, server-reported size/progress during download, queued/paused/failure/ready status, cancellation, retry, manual updates and timestamped logs. No automatic map updates. Downloads survive closing oTraiL. A failed candidate retains the installed map. India `.map` import is also supported. Allow enough free phone storage for the old map plus downloaded candidate plus validation copy (roughly 4.6 GiB during an update, plus retained older versions in Downloads). The offline-only switch blocks online map requests, but explicit dataset downloads are separate actions.

Full India map: https://download.mapsforge.org/maps/v5/asia/india.map
Raw India data: https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/india-latest.osm.pbf
Attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Satellite tiles © Esri / Maxar / Earthstar Geographics and contributors. Third-party territorial representations are preserved as supplied; viewport is bounded approximately to India (6–38°N, 68–98°E), not a boundary definition.

## Tracking and data

`trips`, `fixes`, `stops`, `sync_logs` are separate normalized tables with foreign keys and a trip/time index. Database schema version 2 (additive v1 migration). UTC Unix milliseconds, WGS84 decimal latitude/longitude, meters, m/s, degrees. Optional altitude and bearing remain null when unavailable. Source provider is retained. GeoJSON export streams Point features, `[longitude, latitude]`, with fix and stop properties plus trip IDs. Consumers can group fixes by trip/time into lines. Existing 12,000 km of journeys cannot be reconstructed without previous GPS logs; import of historical journeys is a future feature.

A stop requires >120 seconds within a 35 m anchored radius with speed ≤1.5 m/s and accuracy ≤50 m. Gaps >60 seconds break dwell inference. Departure is the last observed stationary fix; signal loss is never counted as additional stopped time. Fixes older than 30 seconds or worse than 100 m accuracy are discarded; >30-second-old location is marked stale on screen. Live state colors: green recording/ready, blue moving, turquoise stopped, cyan historical. Tappable stop markers show arrival and observed duration on every basemap. No fake/demo coordinates.

## Build and deploy

JDK 21 and Android SDK platform 35 required. Use `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`, then `adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`. Open `in.otrail/.MainActivity`. Wi-Fi ADB must already be paired and connected. Gradle wrapper 9.6.0; AGP 9.4.0. Debug signing is for local testing. APK snapshots and checksums are committed under `releases/`. No signing keys or provider credentials in this repository.

## Scaffold limits

In-app online navigation uses OSRM with written guidance and rerouting. No voice guidance, live traffic, embedded offline routing engine or offline graph is included. Google Maps/OsmAnd remain optional external choices. Commercial providers such as Mappls/Google/Mapbox require separate SDK credentials and terms before integration. Raw PBF is an optional source archive only. No GPX importer, map delta updates, or validated all-day battery guarantee yet. Drive provider upload and full physical reboot behavior require device/account testing. osmdroid 6.1.20 is a legacy renderer; evaluate a maintained renderer before production. UI loads collected fixes before thinning display geometry; multi-year datasets will need paginated queries and simplification.

Dependencies: osmdroid (Apache 2.0); osmdroid-mapsforge bridge and Mapsforge (LGPL family—retain notices and applicable source/relinking obligations when distributing). See upstream licenses. No release-store readiness is claimed.

## Validation

`./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest` builds the app and isolated backup test APK. On a connected phone, install both debug APKs and run `adb shell am instrument -w in.otrail.test/in.otrail.BackupInstrumentation`. The five backup checks use device-protected test storage, separate from the user's credential-protected trail database. Six JVM stop-detector tests cover dwell threshold, signal gaps, accuracy rejection, moving fixes, duplicate timestamps and drift.

## Stop location enrichment and complete trails (0.2.3)

Confirmed stops are queued for place/locality/district/state/country/PIN/road lookup through Android Geocoder, independently of the five-second GPS writer. Existing stops are backfilled automatically; failed lookups retry after 24 hours. Maps & downloads has an Identify historical stop locations action. Coordinates and timings survive lookup failure. Addresses appear in stop popups, snapshots and GeoJSON. The Mapsforge `.map` is an offline rendering dataset, **not** an offline reverse-geocoding database. Android's geocoding service may use network providers and may be unavailable.

Live displays the complete collected journal; History can display all journeys or one selected journey. Short plausible gaps are joined in amber without map text labels. Inference details are stored only in logs; no guessed GPS coordinates enter the journal, backup or export. Long/implausible gaps stay open.

Old places searches the recent phone location within 25 km for OSM historic/heritage/tourism elements whose source date falls within 200–600 years of the current year. Gold markers highlight names; source dates and age uncertainty are visible in their popups. Results are cached on the phone for offline display. Lookup requires connectivity and is blocked by Offline only; coverage and age tags are incomplete and not independently verified. No historic datasets are bundled with the APK.

For detailed file-by-file changes, migration safeguards and validation commands, see [the 0.2.3 implementation guide](docs/0.2.3-changes.md).

## Silent navigation and daily app updates (0.2.4)

Navigate searches an Indian place or coordinates; holding the map offers an in-app route preview. Start enables written turn directions, remaining distance/time and rate-limited rerouting from fresh GPS. No voice or speech code is included. Cached routes can be followed during loss of connectivity, but new calculations require internet. Navigation is separate from recorded fixes/stops; this release keeps SQLite schema version 2 unchanged.

App updates in Maps & downloads checks the repository's `releases/latest.json`, manually or approximately daily through Android's scheduler. Only newer versionCodes are offered. Downloads require matching size, SHA-256, package identity, advertised version and installed signing key. Android install confirmation is required; there is no silent installation or uninstall/data-clear operation.

See [0.2.4 usage, integrity checks, update publishing and offline-routing options](docs/0.2.4-navigation-updates.md). APKs remain committed in `releases/`, not GitHub Releases. Device/road/installer testing for 0.2.4 remains pending; JVM tests, Android checks and the online route/parser smoke test are automated here.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {
    ".git", ".gradle", ".idea", ".kotlin",
    ".cxx", ".externalNativeBuild",
    "build", "out", "target", "dist",
    "node_modules", "vendor", "deps",
    "venv", ".venv", "__pycache__",
    "generated", "intermediates", "outputs",
    "captures", "coverage", ".pytest_cache"
}

INCLUDE_EXT = {
    ".java", ".kt", ".kts",
    ".xml", ".gradle",
    ".properties", ".toml",
    ".c", ".cpp", ".cc", ".h", ".hpp",
    ".aidl", ".proto",
    ".json", ".yaml", ".yml",
    ".sh", ".py", ".md",
    ".pro"
}

INCLUDE_NAMES = {
    "gradlew", "settings.gradle",
    "build.gradle", "gradle.properties",
    "AndroidManifest.xml",
    "proguard-rules.pro",
    "CMakeLists.txt",
    "Makefile"
}

EXCLUDE_FILES = {
    "local.properties",
    "concat_android.py",
    "android-project-sources.txt",
    "google-services.json",
    "key.properties"
}

MAX_FILE_SIZE = 2 * 1024 * 1024

def concat_android(root):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    output = root / "android-project-sources.txt"
    count = 0
    skipped = 0

    with output.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
        out.write("ANDROID PROJECT SOURCE SNAPSHOT\n")
        out.write(f"Project: {root}\n")
        out.write("=" * 80 + "\n\n")

        for current, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
            dirs[:] = sorted(
                d for d in dirs
                if d not in EXCLUDE_DIRS
                and not d.endswith(".egg-info")
            )

            for name in sorted(files):
                path = Path(current) / name

                if name in EXCLUDE_FILES:
                    continue

                if (
                    path.suffix.lower() not in INCLUDE_EXT
                    and name not in INCLUDE_NAMES
                ):
                    continue

                try:
                    if path.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
                        skipped += 1
                        continue

                    content = path.read_text(
                        encoding="utf-8",
                        errors="replace"
                    )

                    relative = path.relative_to(root)

                    out.write("\n" + "=" * 80 + "\n")
                    out.write(f"FILE: {relative}\n")
                    out.write("=" * 80 + "\n\n")
                    out.write(content)
                    out.write("\n")

                    count += 1

                except (OSError, UnicodeError) as e:
                    print(f"Skipped {path}: {e}")
                    skipped += 1

    print(f"Project: {root}")
    print(f"Sources combined: {count}")
    print(f"Skipped: {skipped}")
    print(f"Output: {output}")
    print(f"Size: {output.stat().st_size:,} bytes")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    concat_android(
        sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "."
    )

#!/bin/sh

#
# Copyright © 2015 the original authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

##############################################################################
#
#   gradlew start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh gradlew
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/3d91ce3b8caaf77ad09f381f43615b715b53f72c/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$PWD" ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac



# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -jar "$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

// Keep Android's startup/dialog theme in sync with the editable Java UI configuration.
def uiConfigSource = layout.projectDirectory.file('src/main/java/in/otrail/UiConfig.java')
def uiThemeOutput = layout.buildDirectory.dir('generated/uiConfig/res')
android.sourceSets.main.res.srcDir(uiThemeOutput.get().asFile)
def generateUiTheme = tasks.register('generateUiTheme') {
    inputs.file(uiConfigSource)
    outputs.dir(uiThemeOutput)
    doLast {
        def source = uiConfigSource.asFile.text
        def literal = { String name ->
            def match = source =~ /\b${name}\s*=\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|"[^"]*"|[0-9]+)/
            if (!match.find()) throw new GradleException("UiConfig literal missing: ${name}")
            match.group(1)
        }
        def values = new StringBuilder('<resources>\n')
        ['BLUE','PURPLE','ACCENT_TEXT','SECONDARY','BACKGROUND','BUTTON','BUTTON_TEXT','INK','MUTED'].each { name ->
            values.append("<color name=\"ui_${name.toLowerCase()}\">#${literal(name).substring(2)}</color>\n")
        }
        ['BODY_FONT','BUTTON_FONT'].each { name ->
            values.append("<string name=\"ui_${name.toLowerCase()}\" translatable=\"false\">${literal(name)[1..-2]}</string>\n")
        }
        values.append("<dimen name=\"ui_button_size\">${literal('BUTTON_SIZE_SP')}sp</dimen>\n</resources>\n")
        def output = new File(uiThemeOutput.get().asFile, 'values/ui_config_theme.xml')
        output.parentFile.mkdirs()
        output.text = values.toString()
    }
}
tasks.named('preBuild').configure { dependsOn(generateUiTheme) }

// Reproducible compiler classpath for the separately downloaded GOD toolchain.
tasks.register('exportGodRuntime') {
    dependsOn('assembleDebug')
    doLast {
        def output = layout.buildDirectory.file('god-runtime-paths.txt').get().asFile
        output.text = configurations.debugRuntimeClasspath.files.collect { it.absolutePath }.join('\n') + '\n'
    }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.app.*;
import android.content.*;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import android.location.*;
import android.os.Bundle;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import org.json.*;

/** Validation builds target a separate app; all fixtures use isolated device-protected storage. */
public final class BackupInstrumentation extends Instrumentation {
  @Override
  public void onCreate(Bundle args) {
    super.onCreate(args);
    start();
  }

  private static void require(boolean ok, String message) {
    if (!ok) throw new AssertionError(message);
  }

  private Context context;
  private int checks;

  private void check(String name, RunnableWithException test) throws Exception {
    test.run();
    checks++;
    android.util.Log.i("oTraiLTests", "PASS: " + name);
  }

  interface RunnableWithException {
    void run() throws Exception;
  }

  @Override
  public void onStart() {
    Bundle result = new Bundle();
    context =
        new ContextWrapper(getTargetContext().createDeviceProtectedStorageContext()) {
          @Override
          public Context getApplicationContext() {
            return this;
          }
        };
    try {
      String old = versionOneFixture();
      check(
          "non-destructive v1 migration",
          () -> {
            try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
              require(db.getReadableDatabase().getVersion() == 4, "schema version");
              require(db.trips().equals(List.of(7L)), "trip ID changed");
              require(db.fixes(7).get(0).id() == 11, "fix ID changed");
              TrailDb.Stop s = db.stops(7).get(0);
              require(
                  s.id() == 13
                      && s.arrival() == 1_000_000
                      && s.observed() == 1_125_000
                      && s.departure() == 1_125_000
                      && s.lat() == 20
                      && s.lon() == 77,
                  "stop GPS/timing changed");
              require("PENDING".equals(s.geocodeStatus()), "old stop not queued");
              require(db.pendingStopIds(10).equals(List.of(13L)), "queue missing stop");
              require(db.logs().contains("v1 history"), "log lost");
              try (Cursor c = db.getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("PRAGMA foreign_key_check", null)) {
                require(!c.moveToFirst(), "broken foreign keys");
              }
            }
          });
      context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
      check(
          "old backup and defaults",
          () -> {
            try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
              db.restoreBackup(new StringReader(old));
              TrailDb.Stop s = db.stops(-1).get(0);
              require(
                  s.placeName() == null && "PENDING".equals(s.geocodeStatus()),
                  "old backup not pending");
              require(db.fixes(-1).size() == 1, "old fix missing");
            }
          });
      String snapshot;
      try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
        TrailDb.Stop stop = db.stops(-1).get(0);
        db.saveStopAddress(
            stop.id(),
            "Test Town",
            "Test Locality",
            "Test District",
            "Test State",
            "India",
            "123456",
            "Test Road");
        StringWriter out = new StringWriter();
        db.writeBackup(out);
        snapshot = out.toString();
      }
      final String enriched = snapshot;
      check(
          "address snapshot",
          () ->
              require(
                  enriched.contains("\"place_name\":\"Test Town\"")
                      && enriched.contains("Test District"),
                  "address omitted"));
      check(
          "GeoJSON address and coordinate order",
          () -> {
            try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
              StringWriter out = new StringWriter();
              db.export(out);
              JSONArray features = new JSONObject(out.toString()).getJSONArray("features");
              boolean found = false;
              for (int i = 0; i < features.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject f = features.getJSONObject(i), p = f.getJSONObject("properties");
                if ("stop".equals(p.getString("kind"))) {
                  found = true;
                  require("Test Town".equals(p.getString("place_name")), "GeoJSON name");
                  require(p.getString("postal_code").equals("123456"), "GeoJSON PIN");
                  JSONArray xy = f.getJSONObject("geometry").getJSONArray("coordinates");
                  require(xy.getDouble(0) == 77 && xy.getDouble(1) == 20, "coordinate order");
                }
              }
              require(found, "no stop feature");
            }
          });
      context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
      check(
          "truncated snapshot rolls back",
          () -> {
            try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
              try {
                db.restoreBackup(new StringReader(enriched.substring(0, enriched.length() / 2)));
                throw new AssertionError("truncated backup accepted");
              } catch (Exception expected) {
              }
              require(db.trips().isEmpty() && db.fixes(-1).isEmpty(), "partial restore committed");
            }
          });
      check(
          "enriched restore",
          () -> {
            try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
              db.restoreBackup(new StringReader(enriched));
              TrailDb.Stop s = db.stops(-1).get(0);
              require(
                  "Test Town".equals(s.placeName())
                      && "Test District".equals(s.district())
                      && "RESOLVED".equals(s.geocodeStatus()),
                  "address lost on restore");
            }
          });
      check(
          "merge enriches old duplicate",
          () -> {
            try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
              TrailDb.Stop stop = db.stops(-1).get(0);
              db.getWritableDatabase()
                  .execSQL(
                      "UPDATE stops SET"
                          + " place_name=NULL,locality=NULL,district=NULL,state=NULL,country=NULL,postal_code=NULL,road=NULL,geocode_status='PENDING'");
              db.restoreBackup(new StringReader(enriched));
              TrailDb.Stop merged = db.stops(-1).get(0);
              require(
                  merged.id() == stop.id()
                      && merged.lat() == stop.lat()
                      && merged.observed() == stop.observed(),
                  "merge changed stop identity");
              require("Test Town".equals(merged.placeName()), "merge did not supply address");
              db.restoreBackup(new StringReader(enriched));
              require(
                  db.stops(-1).size() == 1 && db.fixes(-1).size() == 1, "merge duplicated rows");
            }
          });
      check(
          "merge retains current address and enriches missing fields",
          () -> {
            try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
              db.getWritableDatabase()
                  .execSQL("UPDATE stops SET place_name='Current name',road=NULL");
              db.restoreBackup(new StringReader(enriched));
              TrailDb.Stop s = db.stops(-1).get(0);
              require(
                  "Current name".equals(s.placeName()) && "Test Road".equals(s.road()),
                  "merge replaced current label or lost road");
            }
          });
      context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
      check("new stop ID and geocoder independence", this::independentGeocoding);
      check("lookup failure and 24h cooldown", this::failedGeocoding);
      check("historical queue drains beyond first 25", this::largeBackfill);
      check("historic place age filtering/cache", this::historicCache);
      check(
          "inferred edges only in logs",
          () -> {
            try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
              int count = db.fixes(-1).size();
              List<TrailSegments.Segment> edges =
                  TrailSegments.build(
                      List.of(
                          new TrailSegments.Sample(1, 1, 1000, 20, 77),
                          new TrailSegments.Sample(2, 1, 121000, 20.001, 77)),
                      10);
              db.logInferredGaps(edges);
              db.logInferredGaps(edges);
              require(db.fixes(-1).size() == count, "inference fabricated GPS samples");
              try (Cursor c =
                  db.getReadableDatabase()
                      .rawQuery(
                          "SELECT count(*) FROM sync_logs WHERE provider='Trail gap'", null)) {
                c.moveToFirst();
                require(c.getInt(0) == 1, "gap log duplicated");
              }
            }
          });
      check("sequential marker popup ownership", this::markerPopups);
      check("map reparent keeps repository and stop details", this::mapReparent);
      check("cached navigation preserves journal", this::navigationIntegrity);
      check("restart recovers earliest stationary arrival", this::stopContinuity);
      check("v2 metrics migration preserves normalized journal", this::metricsMigration);
      check("road cache survives reopen without network", this::roadCache);
      check("shared journal pool under concurrent writes", this::concurrentJournal);
      check("backup snapshot does not block GPS writer", this::backupDuringRecording);
      check("uncertain GPS retains stop and raw observations", this::uncertainStop);
      check("native text honors configured dark text", this::nativeTextStyle);
      check("fullscreen activity cold launch", this::fullscreenStartup);
      result.putString(
          "stream",
          "PASS: "
              + checks
              + " migration, backup, geocoding, heritage and gap checks (isolated database)\n");
      finish(Activity.RESULT_OK, result);
    } catch (Throwable e) {
      android.util.Log.e("oTraiLTests", "FAIL", e);
      result.putString("stream", "FAIL: " + e + "\n");
      finish(Activity.RESULT_CANCELED, result);
    } finally {
      context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
    }
  }

  private void concurrentJournal() throws Exception {
    try(TrailDb tracker=new TrailDb(context);TrailDb ui=new TrailDb(context)) {
      require(tracker.getWritableDatabase()==ui.getWritableDatabase(),"journal handles opened competing pools");
      TrailDb temporary=new TrailDb(context);temporary.getReadableDatabase();temporary.close();temporary.close();
      require(tracker.getWritableDatabase().isOpen(),"closing UI handle closed active tracker pool");
      long trip=tracker.begin();int before=tracker.fixes(-1).size();
      ExecutorService workers=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
      try {
        Future<?> fixes=workers.submit(()->{
          StopDetector detector=new StopDetector();
          for(int n=0;n<60;n++) {
            Location fix=new Location("gps");fix.setLatitude(20);fix.setLongitude(77);
            fix.setTime(2_000_000_000L+n*5000L);fix.setAccuracy(3);fix.setSpeed(0);
            tracker.record(trip,fix,detector);
          }
        });
        Future<?> logs=workers.submit(()->{try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(context)){for(int n=0;n<100;n++)db.log("Concurrency fixture","OK","entry "+n);}});
        Future<?> reads=workers.submit(()->{try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(context)){for(int n=0;n<10;n++){db.fixes(-1);db.stops(-1);}}});
        fixes.get(20,TimeUnit.SECONDS);logs.get(20,TimeUnit.SECONDS);reads.get(20,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        require(tracker.fixes(-1).size()==before+60,"concurrent work dropped GPS fixes");
        try(Cursor check=tracker.getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("PRAGMA integrity_check",null)) {
          require(check.moveToFirst()&&"ok".equals(check.getString(0)),"concurrent journal integrity");
        }
      } finally {workers.shutdownNow();}
    }
  }

  private void backupDuringRecording() throws Exception {
    if(android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT<35)return;
    try(TrailDb backup=new TrailDb(context);TrailDb tracker=new TrailDb(context)) {
      long trip=tracker.begin();CountDownLatch snapshotOpen=new CountDownLatch(1),release=new CountDownLatch(1);
      ExecutorService workers=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
      try {
        Future<?> snapshot=workers.submit(()->{
          try {
            backup.writeBackup(new Writer(){
              boolean waited;
              @Override public void write(char[] b,int start,int count)throws IOException {
                if(!waited){waited=true;snapshotOpen.countDown();try{if(!release.await(10,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new IOException("snapshot fixture timed out");}catch(InterruptedException e){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();throw new IOException(e);}}
              }
              @Override public void flush(){}
              @Override public void close(){}
            });
          } catch(Exception e){throw new RuntimeException(e);}
        });
        require(snapshotOpen.await(10,TimeUnit.SECONDS),"backup snapshot not started");
        Future<?> write=workers.submit(()->{
          Location fix=new Location("gps");fix.setLatitude(20);fix.setLongitude(77);fix.setAccuracy(3);
          fix.setTime(2_001_000_000L);tracker.record(trip,fix,new StopDetector());
        });
        write.get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS); // Must finish while backup's read snapshot is still open.
        release.countDown();snapshot.get(10,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
      } finally {release.countDown();workers.shutdownNow();}
    }
  }

  private void uncertainStop() throws Exception {
    context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
    try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(context)) {
      long stop=seedStop(db),trip=db.activeTrip();int before=db.fixes(-1).size();
      StopDetector detector=new StopDetector();db.restoreDetector(trip,detector);
      long arrival=db.stopById(stop).arrival(),observed=db.stopById(stop).observed();
      Location poor=fix(1140000,20.01,77,30);poor.setAccuracy(80);db.record(trip,poor,detector);
      require(db.stopById(stop).departure()==0,"poor accuracy closed stop");
      require(db.stopById(stop).observed()==observed,"uncertain fix advanced confirmed observation");
      poor=fix(1145000,20.01,77,30);poor.setAccuracy(15);db.record(trip,poor,detector);
      ContentValues duplicate=new ContentValues();duplicate.put("trip_id",trip);duplicate.put("arrival_ms",1145000L);
      duplicate.put("observed_ms",1145000L);duplicate.put("latitude",20);duplicate.put("longitude",77.001);duplicate.put("place_name","Retained user label");
      long duplicateId=db.getWritableDatabase().insertOrThrow("stops",null,duplicate);
      for(int n=0;n<3;n++)db.record(trip,fix(1150000+n*5000,20,77,0),detector);
      require(db.stopById(stop).arrival()==arrival,"stable return reset original arrival");
      require(db.stopById(stop).observed()==1160000,"stable return not observed");
      require(db.stops(-1).size()==2,"duplicate repair removed saved stop IDs");
      require(db.stopById(duplicateId).departure()==1145000L,"duplicate stop remained open");
      require("Retained user label".equals(db.stopById(duplicateId).placeName()),"duplicate repair removed saved label");
      require(db.fixes(-1).size()==before+5,"quality filtering removed raw GPS");
    }
  }
  private void nativeTextStyle() {
    java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<Throwable> failure=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<>();
    runOnMainSync(()->{try{
      android.widget.Switch toggle=new android.widget.Switch(getTargetContext());AppStyle.nativeTextTree(toggle);
      require(toggle.getCurrentTextColor()==UiConfig.INK,"switch retained native black");
      android.widget.Spinner selector=new android.widget.Spinner(getTargetContext());
      android.widget.ArrayAdapter<String> choices=AppStyle.choices(getTargetContext(),List.of("India offline"));
      android.widget.TextView label=(android.widget.TextView)choices.getView(0,null,selector);
      require(label.getCurrentTextColor()==UiConfig.INK,"selector ignored configured text color");
      android.widget.EditText input=new android.widget.EditText(getTargetContext());AppStyle.nativeTextTree(input);
      require(input.getCurrentTextColor()==UiConfig.INK,"input ignored configured text color");
    }catch(Throwable error){failure.set(error);}});
    if(failure.get()!=null)throw new AssertionError("Native text configuration",failure.get());
  }

  private void fullscreenStartup() throws Exception {
    Activity activity=startActivitySync(new Intent(getTargetContext(),MainActivity.class).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK));
    waitForIdleSync();
    runOnMainSync(() -> {
      require(activity.getWindow().getDecorView().getWindowInsetsController()!=null,"fullscreen window not attached");
      activity.finish();
    });
    getTargetContext().stopService(new Intent(getTargetContext(),TrackingService.class));
  }

  private void metricsMigration() throws Exception {
    String before;
    try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(context)) {
      StringWriter w=new StringWriter();db.writeBackup(w);before=w.toString();
      db.getWritableDatabase().execSQL("DROP TABLE stop_drive_metrics");db.getWritableDatabase().setVersion(2);
    }
    try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(context)) {
      require(db.getWritableDatabase().getVersion()==4,"v2 migration missing");
      DriveMetrics.Result metrics=db.driveMetrics();require(metrics.totalMeters()>=0,"invalid historical km");
      try(Cursor c=db.getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stop_drive_metrics",null)){c.moveToFirst();require(c.getInt(0)==db.stops(-1).size(),"stop metrics not backfilled");}
      StringWriter w=new StringWriter();db.writeBackup(w);
      JSONObject a=new JSONObject(before),b=new JSONObject(w.toString());
      for(String table:new String[]{"trips","fixes","stops","sync_logs"})
        require(a.getJSONArray(table).toString().equals(b.getJSONArray(table).toString()),"metrics changed normalized source table "+table);
    }
  }
  private void roadCache() throws Exception {
    context.deleteDatabase("road-cache.db");
    JSONObject road=new JSONObject().put("type","way").put("id",123)
      .put("tags",new JSONObject().put("highway","primary").put("ref","NH-09"))
      .put("geometry",new JSONArray().put(new JSONObject().put("lat",20).put("lon",77)).put(new JSONObject().put("lat",20).put("lon",77.02)));
    try(RoadContext cache=new RoadContext(context)){cache.cache(20,77.01,new JSONObject().put("elements",new JSONArray().put(road)),System.currentTimeMillis());}
    try(RoadContext cache=new RoadContext(context)){require("NH-09".equals(cache.cached(20,77.01,Double.NaN).road()),"cached road lost across reopen");}
    context.deleteDatabase("road-cache.db");
  }

  private void stopContinuity() throws Exception {
    context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
    long trip, stop;
    try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
      trip = db.begin(); StopDetector detector = new StopDetector(); stop = -1;
      for(int i=1;i<=26;i++) {
        Location l=new Location("test");l.setTime(i*5000);l.setLatitude(20);l.setLongitude(77);l.setAccuracy(8);l.setSpeed(0);
        long id=db.record(trip,l,detector);if(id>0)stop=id;
      }
      require(stop>0,"missing confirmed stop");
      // Simulate a legacy version closing and restarting the same dwell.
      db.getWritableDatabase().execSQL("UPDATE stops SET arrival_ms=60000,departure_ms=observed_ms WHERE id=?",new Object[]{stop});
    }
    try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
      StopDetector detector=new StopDetector();db.restoreDetector(trip,detector);
      require(detector.arrival()==5000,"lost earlier stationary observations");
      Location resumed=new Location("test");resumed.setTime(3600000);resumed.setLatitude(20);resumed.setLongitude(77);resumed.setAccuracy(8);resumed.setSpeed(0);
      db.record(trip,resumed,detector);
      require(db.stopById(stop).departure()!=0,"repaired before stable return");
      for(int n=1;n<=2;n++){resumed.setTime(3600000+n*5000);db.record(trip,resumed,detector);}
      require(db.stopById(stop).arrival()==5000&&db.stopById(stop).departure()==0,"stable return did not restore original stop");
      require(db.stops(-1).size()==1,"restart duplicated stop");
      for(int n=0;n<=4;n++){resumed.setTime(3615000+n*5000);resumed.setLatitude(20.001+n*.0002);resumed.setSpeed(5);db.record(trip,resumed,detector);}
      require(db.stopById(stop).departure()==3610000,"departure not preserved");
      StopDetector moved=new StopDetector();db.restoreDetector(trip,moved);require(!moved.isStopped(),"resurrected departed stop");
      require(db.fixes(-1).size()==34,"recovery changed GPS rows");
    }
  }

  private String versionOneFixture() throws Exception {
    context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
    try (SQLiteDatabase d = context.openOrCreateDatabase("trails.db", Context.MODE_PRIVATE, null)) {
      d.execSQL(
          "CREATE TABLE trips(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,started_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,ended_ms"
              + " INTEGER)");
      d.execSQL(
          "CREATE TABLE fixes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,trip_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES"
              + " trips(id),time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,latitude REAL NOT NULL,longitude REAL NOT"
              + " NULL,accuracy_m REAL NOT NULL,speed_mps REAL NOT NULL,altitude_m REAL,bearing_deg"
              + " REAL,source TEXT NOT NULL)");
      d.execSQL("CREATE INDEX fixes_trip_time ON fixes(trip_id,time_ms)");
      d.execSQL(
          "CREATE TABLE stops(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,trip_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES"
              + " trips(id),arrival_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,departure_ms INTEGER,observed_ms INTEGER"
              + " NOT NULL,latitude REAL NOT NULL,longitude REAL NOT NULL)");
      d.execSQL(
          "CREATE TABLE sync_logs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,provider TEXT NOT"
              + " NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,detail TEXT NOT NULL)");
      d.execSQL("INSERT INTO trips VALUES(7,1000000,1200000)");
      d.execSQL("INSERT INTO fixes VALUES(11,7,1000000,20,77,8,0,NULL,NULL,'fixture')");
      d.execSQL("INSERT INTO stops VALUES(13,7,1000000,1125000,1125000,20,77)");
      d.execSQL("INSERT INTO sync_logs VALUES(17,1000000,'test','SUCCESS','v1 history')");
      d.setVersion(1);
      JSONObject backup = new JSONObject().put("otrail_backup_version", 1);
      for (String table : new String[] {"trips", "fixes", "stops", "sync_logs"}) {
        JSONArray rows = new JSONArray();
        try (Cursor c = d.rawQuery("SELECT * FROM " + table, null)) {
          while (c.moveToNext()) {
            JSONObject row = new JSONObject();
            for (int i = 0; i < c.getColumnCount(); i++) {
              Object value =
                  c.isNull(i)
                      ? JSONObject.NULL
                      : c.getType(i) == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER
                          ? c.getLong(i)
                          : c.getType(i) == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT
                              ? c.getDouble(i)
                              : c.getString(i);
              row.put(c.getColumnName(i), value);
            }
            rows.put(row);
          }
        }
        backup.put(table, rows);
      }
      return backup.toString();
    }
  }

  private long seedStop(TrailDb db) throws Exception {
    long trip = db.begin(), id = -1;
    StopDetector detector = new StopDetector();
    for (int i = 1; i <= 26; i++) {
      Location l = fix(1_000_000 + i * 5000, 20, 77, 0);
      long opened = db.record(trip, l, detector);
      if (i < 26) require(opened == -1, "stop opened before >2 min");
      else id = opened;
    }
    require(id > 0, "stop ID not returned");
    return id;
  }

  private Location fix(long time, double lat, double lon, float speed) {
    Location l = new Location("fixture");
    l.setTime(time);
    l.setLatitude(lat);
    l.setLongitude(lon);
    l.setAccuracy(8);
    l.setSpeed(speed);
    return l;
  }

  private Address address() {
    Address a = new Address(Locale.ENGLISH);
    a.setLocality("Test Town");
    a.setSubAdminArea("Test District");
    a.setAdminArea("Test State");
    a.setCountryName("India");
    return a;
  }

  private void independentGeocoding() throws Exception {
    try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
      long id = seedStop(db);
      CountDownLatch entered = new CountDownLatch(1), release = new CountDownLatch(1);
      try (StopGeocoder geocoder =
          new StopGeocoder(
              context,
              (lat, lon) -> {
                entered.countDown();
                release.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                return address();
              })) {
        geocoder.request();
        require(entered.await(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "lookup not queued");
        long began = System.nanoTime();
        db.record(db.activeTrip(), fix(1_135_000, 20.001, 77, 5), new StopDetector());
        require(
            (System.nanoTime() - began) < TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(2) && db.fixes(-1).size() == 27,
            "lookup blocked recording");
        release.countDown();
        awaitStatus(db, id, "RESOLVED");
        require(
            db.stopById(id).lat() == 20 && db.stopById(id).lon() == 77,
            "lookup changed coordinates");
      }
    }
  }

  private void failedGeocoding() throws Exception {
    context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
    try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
      long id = seedStop(db);
      try (StopGeocoder geocoder =
          new StopGeocoder(
              context,
              (a, b) -> {
                throw new IOException("offline");
              })) {
        geocoder.request();
        awaitStatus(db, id, "FAILED");
        require(db.pendingStopIds(10).isEmpty(), "failed lookup retried too soon");
        db.record(db.activeTrip(), fix(1_135_000, 20.001, 77, 5), new StopDetector());
        require(db.fixes(-1).size() == 27, "failure stopped recording");
        db.getWritableDatabase()
            .execSQL(
                "UPDATE stops SET geocode_attempt_ms=?",
                new Object[] {System.currentTimeMillis() - TrailDb.GEOCODE_RETRY_MS - 1000});
        require(db.pendingStopIds(10).contains(id), "expired failure not eligible");
      }
    }
  }

  private void largeBackfill() throws Exception {
    context.deleteDatabase("trails.db");
    try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
      long trip = db.begin();
      for (int i = 0; i < 28; i++)
        db.getWritableDatabase()
            .execSQL(
                "INSERT INTO stops(trip_id,arrival_ms,observed_ms,latitude,longitude)"
                    + " VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
                new Object[] {trip, 1_000_000 + i * 200000, 1_125_000 + i * 200000, 20, 77});
      try (StopGeocoder geocoder = new StopGeocoder(context, (a, b) -> address(), 0)) {
        geocoder.request();
        long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 5000;
        while (!db.pendingStopIds(1).isEmpty() && System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline)
          Thread.sleep(20);
        require(db.pendingStopIds(100).isEmpty(), "backfill stopped after a batch");
      }
    }
  }

  private void historicCache() throws Exception {
    try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
      int y = java.time.Year.now(java.time.ZoneOffset.UTC).getValue();
      JSONArray elements = new JSONArray();
      for (int age : new int[] {350, 50, 900})
        elements.put(
            new JSONObject()
                .put("type", "node")
                .put("id", age)
                .put("lat", 20)
                .put("lon", 77)
                .put(
                    "tags",
                    new JSONObject()
                        .put("name", "Fixture " + age)
                        .put("start_date", "" + (y - age))));
      int count =
          HistoricPlaces.cacheResult(db, new JSONObject().put("elements", elements), 20, 77);
      require(count == 1, "wrong historic age filter");
      require(HistoricPlaces.cached(db, 20, 77).size() == 1, "cache missing");
      require(HistoricPlaces.cached(db, 25, 77).isEmpty(), "distant place shown nearby");
    }
  }

  private static final class ReparentMap extends org.osmdroid.views.MapView {
    ReparentMap(Context c) { super(c); }
    void windowDetached() { super.onDetachedFromWindow(); }
  }
  private void mapReparent() throws Exception {
    java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<Throwable> failure=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<>();
    runOnMainSync(() -> {
      ReparentMap map=null;
      try {
        map=new ReparentMap(getTargetContext());map.setDestroyMode(false);map.setUseDataConnection(false);
        org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Marker stop=new org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Marker(map);
        stop.setTitle("Preserved stop");stop.setSnippet("Arrived 13:47 · duration 1h");map.getOverlays().add(stop);
        map.windowDetached();
        map.getOverlays().add(new org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Polyline(map));
        require("Preserved stop".equals(stop.getTitle()),"stop title lost during reparent");
        require(stop.getSnippet().contains("13:47"),"stop details lost during reparent");
        org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Marker another=new org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Marker(map);
        require(another.getInfoWindow()!=null,"marker repository destroyed");
      }catch(Throwable e){failure.set(e);}finally{if(map!=null)map.onDetach();}
    });
    if(failure.get()!=null)throw new Exception("Map reparent regression",failure.get());
  }

  private void markerPopups() throws Exception {
    java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<Throwable> failure =
        new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<>();
    runOnMainSync(
        () -> {
          org.osmdroid.views.MapView map = null;
          try {
            map = new org.osmdroid.views.MapView(getTargetContext());
            map.setUseDataConnection(false);
            map.layout(0, 0, 720, 1200);
            map.getController().setCenter(new org.osmdroid.util.GeoPoint(20, 77));
            org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Marker a = new org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Marker(map),
                b = new org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Marker(map);
            a.setPosition(new org.osmdroid.util.GeoPoint(20, 77));
            b.setPosition(new org.osmdroid.util.GeoPoint(20.001, 77));
            a.setTitle("First stop");
            b.setTitle("Second stop");
            map.getOverlays().add(a);
            map.getOverlays().add(b);
            MarkerPopups.openOnly(map, a);
            require(a.isInfoWindowShown(), "first popup not open");
            MarkerPopups.openOnly(map, b);
            require(!a.isInfoWindowShown() && b.isInfoWindowShown(), "old popup remained open");
            MarkerPopups.openOnly(map, a);
            require(
                a.isInfoWindowShown() && !b.isInfoWindowShown(), "sequence showed wrong marker");
            require(
                org.osmdroid.views.overlay.infowindow.InfoWindow.getOpenedInfoWindowsOn(map).size()
                    == 1,
                "multiple windows open");
          } catch (Throwable e) {
            failure.set(e);
          } finally {
            if (map != null) map.onDetach();
          }
        });
    if (failure.get() != null) throw new AssertionError("popup regression", failure.get());
  }

  private void navigationIntegrity() throws Exception {
    try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
      StringWriter beforeOut = new StringWriter();
      db.writeBackup(beforeOut);
      JSONObject before = new JSONObject(beforeOut.toString());
      before.remove("created_ms");
      JSONObject maneuver =
          new JSONObject().put("type", "depart").put("location", new JSONArray("[77,20]"));
      JSONObject response =
          new JSONObject()
              .put("code", "Ok")
              .put(
                  "routes",
                  new JSONArray()
                      .put(
                          new JSONObject()
                              .put("distance", 1112)
                              .put("duration", 120)
                              .put(
                                  "geometry",
                                  new JSONObject()
                                      .put("coordinates", new JSONArray("[[77,20],[77,20.01]]")))
                              .put(
                                  "legs",
                                  new JSONArray()
                                      .put(
                                          new JSONObject()
                                              .put(
                                                  "steps",
                                                  new JSONArray()
                                                      .put(
                                                          new JSONObject()
                                                              .put("name", "Fixture road")
                                                              .put("maneuver", maneuver)))))));
      JSONObject cached =
          new JSONObject()
              .put("version", 1)
              .put("response", response)
              .put("name", "Test route")
              .put("latitude", 20.01)
              .put("longitude", 77)
              .put("mode", "ACTIVE");
      try (Writer w =
          new java.io.FileWriter(
              new java.io.File(context.getFilesDir(), "navigation-route.json"))) {
        w.write(cached.toString());
      }
      NavigationManager navigation = NavigationManager.get(context);
      long until = System.currentTimeMillis() + 5000;
      while (navigation.state().route() == null && System.currentTimeMillis() < until)
        Thread.sleep(20);
      require(navigation.state().route() != null, "cached route not restored");
      navigation.start();
      Location l = fix(System.currentTimeMillis(), 20.005, 77, 4);
      navigation.update(l);
      Thread.sleep(100);
      navigation.clear();
      StringWriter afterOut = new StringWriter();
      db.writeBackup(afterOut);
      JSONObject after = new JSONObject(afterOut.toString());
      after.remove("created_ms");
      require(
          before.toString().equals(after.toString()),
          "navigation altered trail tables or backup settings");
    }
  }

  private void awaitStatus(TrailDb db, long id, String expected) throws Exception {
    long end = System.currentTimeMillis() + 5000;
    while (System.currentTimeMillis() < end) {
      if (expected.equals(db.stopById(id).geocodeStatus())) return;
      Thread.sleep(20);
    }
    throw new AssertionError("expected " + expected);
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Context;

/** Apply configured text colors after Android inflates native dialog/list layouts. */
final class AppDialogs extends AlertDialog.Builder {
  AppDialogs(Context context){super(context);}
  @Override public AlertDialog create(){
    AlertDialog dialog=super.create();
    dialog.setOnShowListener(ignored->{
      if(dialog.getWindow()!=null){
        AppStyle.nativeTextTree(dialog.getWindow().getDecorView());
        dialog.getWindow().setBackgroundDrawable(AppStyle.panel(dialog.getWindow().getDecorView(),UiConfig.PURPLE));
      }
      int title=dialog.getContext().getResources().getIdentifier("alertTitle","id","android");
      android.widget.TextView heading=dialog.findViewById(title);
      if(heading!=null){heading.setTextColor(UiConfig.HEADING);heading.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(UiConfig.HEADING_FONT,UiConfig.HEADING_FONT_STYLE));heading.setTextSize(UiConfig.HEADING_SIZE_SP*UiConfig.TEXT_SCALE);}
    });
    return dialog;
  }
}

  /** Blend only the decorative finish; original manual palette values are never rewritten. */
  private static int mix(int from,int to,float amount){
    float t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,amount));
    return Color.argb((int)(Color.alpha(from)*(1-t)+Color.alpha(to)*t),
        (int)(Color.red(from)*(1-t)+Color.red(to)*t),
        (int)(Color.green(from)*(1-t)+Color.green(to)*t),
        (int)(Color.blue(from)*(1-t)+Color.blue(to)*t));
  }
  public static android.graphics.drawable.Drawable canvas(){

    return new GradientDrawable(GradientDrawable.Orientation.TL_BR,PSYCHEDELIC_GRADIENTS?colors:
        new int[]{mix(BACKGROUND,CYAN,.12f),BACKGROUND,mix(BACKGROUND,SECONDARY,.10f)});
  }

  public static void spaceButtons(LinearLayout row){
    row.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
    int inset=dp(row,CONTROL_ROW_PADDING_DP),halfGap=dp(row,BUTTON_GAP_DP)/2;
    row.setPadding(dp(row,PANEL_INNER_PADDING_DP),inset,dp(row,PANEL_INNER_PADDING_DP),inset);
    for(int i=0;i<row.getChildCount();i++){
      android.view.View child=row.getChildAt(i);
      if(child instanceof Button && !(child instanceof CompoundButton)){
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params=child.getLayoutParams() instanceof LinearLayout.LayoutParams current
            ?current:new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-2,dp(row,44));
        params.height=dp(row,44);params.setMargins(halfGap,0,halfGap,0);child.setLayoutParams(params);
      }else if(child instanceof TextView label && !(child instanceof CompoundButton)){
        label.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);label.setMinHeight(dp(row,44));
      }
    }
  }
  /** Reflow existing settings buttons; listeners and asynchronous status references stay attached. */
  public static void compactSettings(android.view.ViewGroup group,int requestedColumns){
    int columns=Math.max(1,requestedColumns);
    java.util.List<android.view.View> children=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    for(int i=0;i<group.getChildCount();i++)children.add(group.getChildAt(i));
    for(android.view.View child:children)if(child instanceof android.view.ViewGroup nested)compactSettings(nested,columns);
    if(!(group instanceof LinearLayout box))return;
    if(box.getOrientation()==LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL){
      boolean onlyButtons=box.getChildCount()>0&&box.getChildCount()<=columns;
      for(int i=0;i<box.getChildCount();i++)onlyButtons&=box.getChildAt(i) instanceof Button;
      if(onlyButtons){
        for(int i=box.getChildCount();i<columns;i++)box.addView(new android.view.View(box.getContext()),new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,1,1));
        spaceButtons(box);
      }
      return;
    }
    int index=0;
    while(index<box.getChildCount()){
      if(!(box.getChildAt(index) instanceof Button)){index++;continue;}
      java.util.List<Button> run=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
      while(index<box.getChildCount()&&box.getChildAt(index) instanceof Button button){box.removeViewAt(index);run.add(button);}
      for(int start=0;start<run.size();start+=columns){
        LinearLayout row=new LinearLayout(box.getContext());
        for(int c=0;c<columns;c++){
          if(start+c<run.size()){
            Button button=run.get(start+c);button.setSingleLine(false);button.setMaxLines(2);
            row.addView(button,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,dp(box,44),1));
          }else row.addView(new android.view.View(box.getContext()),new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,1,1));
        }
        spaceButtons(row);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params=new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,-2);
        params.setMargins(0,dp(box,2),0,dp(box,2));box.addView(row,index++,params);
      }
    }
  }
  public static void toggle(Switch toggle){
    toggle.setThumbTintList(new ColorStateList(new int[][]{new int[]{android.R.attr.state_checked},new int[]{}},new int[]{PURPLE,CYAN}));
    toggle.setTrackTintList(new ColorStateList(new int[][]{new int[]{android.R.attr.state_checked},new int[]{}},new int[]{mix(SURFACE,PURPLE,.55f),mix(SURFACE,CYAN,.55f)}));
  }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/in/otrail/AppUpdater.java

package in.otrail;

import android.app.*;
import android.content.*;
import android.content.pm.*;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.*;
import android.provider.Settings;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public final class AppUpdater {
  public static final String ACTION = "in.otrail.CHECK_UPDATE";
  private static final ExecutorService WORKER = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

  public interface Callback {
    void done(UpdateManifest manifest, String message);
  }

  public interface DownloadCallback {
    void progress(int percent);

    void done(File file, String error);
  }

  public static long installed(Context c) throws Exception {
    return c.getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(c.getPackageName(), 0).getLongVersionCode();
  }

  public static boolean daily(Context c) {
    return c.getSharedPreferences("updates", 0).getBoolean("daily", true);
  }

  public static void daily(Context c, boolean enabled) {
    c.getSharedPreferences("updates", 0).edit().putBoolean("daily", enabled).apply();
    schedule(c);
  }

  public static void schedule(Context c) {
    android.app.job.JobScheduler scheduler =
        (android.app.job.JobScheduler) c.getSystemService(Context.JOB_SCHEDULER_SERVICE);
    if (!daily(c)) {
      scheduler.cancel(2401);
      return;
    }
    if (scheduler.getPendingJob(2401) != null) return;
    scheduler.schedule(
        new android.app.job.JobInfo.Builder(2401, new ComponentName(c, UpdateCheckService.class))
            .setPersisted(true)
            .setRequiredNetworkType(android.app.job.JobInfo.NETWORK_TYPE_ANY)
            .setPeriodic(24L * 60 * 60 * 1000, 4L * 60 * 60 * 1000)
            .build());
  }

  public static String status(Context c) {
    return c.getSharedPreferences("updates", 0).getString("status", "No update check yet")
        + "\nDaily check: "
        + (daily(c) ? "on" : "off")
        + " · Android may defer the job until network/background work is available.";
  }

  public static void check(Context context, boolean manual, Callback callback) {
    Context c = context.getApplicationContext();
    WORKER.execute(
        () -> {
          UpdateManifest manifest = null;
          String message;
          try {
            String text = OnlineRouting.get(UpdateManifest.PREFIX + "latest.json", 32_000);
            UpdateManifest available = UpdateManifest.parse(text);
            if (available.newerThan(installed(c))) {
              manifest = available;
              message = "Update " + available.versionName() + " available";
              if (!manual) notifyUpdate(c, available);
            } else message = "Up to date · " + available.versionName();
          } catch (Exception e) {
            message = "Update check unavailable: " + e.getMessage();
          }
          c.getSharedPreferences("updates", 0)
              .edit()
              .putLong("checked", System.currentTimeMillis())
              .putString("status", message + "\nChecked: " + new Date())
              .apply();
          if (callback != null) callback.done(manifest, message);
        });
  }

  private static void notifyUpdate(Context c, UpdateManifest m) {
    android.content.SharedPreferences p = c.getSharedPreferences("updates", 0);
    if (p.getLong("notified", 0) >= m.versionCode()) return;
    NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager) c.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
    nm.createNotificationChannel(
        new NotificationChannel("updates", "App updates", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT));
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
        && c.checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) return;
    PendingIntent open =
        PendingIntent.getActivity(
            c,
            2401,
            new Intent(c, MainActivity.class).setAction(ACTION),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE | PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
    nm.notify(
        2401,
        new Notification.Builder(c, "updates")
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_sys_download_done)
            .setContentTitle("oTraiL " + m.versionName() + " is available")
            .setContentText("Tap to review and install. Your trails and maps are preserved.")
            .setContentIntent(open)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .build());
    p.edit().putLong("notified", m.versionCode()).apply();
  }

  public static void download(Context context, UpdateManifest m, DownloadCallback callback) {
    Context c = context.getApplicationContext();
    WORKER.execute(
        () -> {
          File folder = new File(c.getFilesDir(), "updates");
          folder.mkdirs();
          File part = new File(folder, "candidate.part"), ready = new File(folder, "verified.apk");
          String error = null;
          File file = null;
          try {
            HttpURLConnection connection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(m.url()).openConnection();
            connection.setConnectTimeout(12000);
            connection.setReadTimeout(25000);
            connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "oTraiL updater/0.2.4");
            try {
              if (connection.getResponseCode() != 200)
                throw new IOException("APK download returned HTTP " + connection.getResponseCode());
              MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
              long count = 0;
              int percent = -1;
              try (InputStream in = connection.getInputStream();
                  FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(part)) {
                byte[] bytes = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(bytes)) != -1) {
                  count += n;
                  if (count > m.size()) throw new IOException("APK exceeds declared size");
                  out.write(bytes, 0, n);
                  digest.update(bytes, 0, n);
                  int next = (int) (count * 100 / m.size());
                  if (next != percent) {
                    percent = next;
                    callback.progress(percent);
                  }
                }
                out.getFD().sync();
              }
              if (count != m.size() || !hex(digest.digest()).equals(m.sha256()))
                throw new SecurityException("APK checksum or size mismatch");
              verifyPackage(c, part, m);
              java.nio.file.Files.move(
                  part.toPath(), ready.toPath(), java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
              file = ready;
            } finally {
              connection.disconnect();
            }
          } catch (Exception e) {
            part.delete();
            error = e.getMessage();
          }
          callback.done(file, error);
        });
  }

  private static void verifyPackage(Context c, File file, UpdateManifest m) throws Exception {
    PackageManager pm = c.getPackageManager();
    PackageInfo
        archive =
            pm.getPackageArchiveInfo(
                file.getAbsolutePath(), PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES),
        current = pm.getPackageInfo(c.getPackageName(), PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES);
    if (archive == null
        || !c.getPackageName().equals(archive.packageName)
        || archive.getLongVersionCode() != m.versionCode()
        || archive.getLongVersionCode() <= current.getLongVersionCode()
        || archive.signingInfo == null
        || current.signingInfo == null)
      throw new SecurityException("APK identity or version does not match");
    Set<String> a = signers(archive.signingInfo), b = signers(current.signingInfo);
    if (a.isEmpty() || !a.equals(b))
      throw new SecurityException("APK signing key differs from the installed app");
  }

  private static Set<String> signers(SigningInfo info) throws Exception {
    Set<String> out = new HashSet<>();
    for (android.content.pm.Signature signature : info.getApkContentsSigners())
      out.add(hex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(signature.toByteArray())));
    return out;
  }

  static String hex(byte[] bytes) {
    StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
    for (byte b : bytes) out.append(String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%02x", b & 255));
    return out.toString();
  }

  /** Imported phone builds must preserve package identity, signing identity and version. */
  public static void prepareBuiltApk(Context c,File file) throws Exception {
    PackageManager pm=c.getPackageManager();
    PackageInfo archive=pm.getPackageArchiveInfo(file.getAbsolutePath(),PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES);
    PackageInfo current=pm.getPackageInfo(c.getPackageName(),PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES);
    if(archive==null||!c.getPackageName().equals(archive.packageName)||archive.getLongVersionCode()<current.getLongVersionCode()
        ||archive.signingInfo==null||current.signingInfo==null||!signers(archive.signingInfo).equals(signers(current.signingInfo)))
      throw new SecurityException("Build signing key, package or version differs. Import the existing signing keystore in Tools; never uninstall to replace it.");
    File ready=new File(c.getFilesDir(),"updates/verified.apk");ready.getParentFile().mkdirs();
    java.nio.file.Files.copy(file.toPath(),ready.toPath(),java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
  }

  public static void install(Activity activity, File verified) {
    if (!activity.getPackageManager().canRequestPackageInstalls()) {
      activity.startActivity(
          new Intent(
              Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_UNKNOWN_APP_SOURCES,
              Uri.parse("package:" + activity.getPackageName())));
      return;
    }
    Uri uri = Uri.parse("content://" + activity.getPackageName() + ".updates/verified.apk");
    activity.startActivity(
        new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW)
            .setDataAndType(uri, "application/vnd.android.package-archive")
            .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION));
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.content.*;

/** Credential-protected trail data becomes available after the first unlock. */
public final class BootReceiver extends BroadcastReceiver {
  @Override
  public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
    String action = intent.getAction();
    if (Intent.ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED.equals(action)
        || Intent.ACTION_MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED.equals(action)) {
      AppUpdater.schedule(context);
      if (!TrackingStartup.start(context, true)) {
        try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(context)) {
          db.log(
              "Always-on tracker",
              "SETUP REQUIRED",
              "Grant precise location and Allow all the time for automatic startup after"
                  + " reboot/update.");
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/** Regular upright pentagon, sized like Locate while retaining the full accessible touch target. */
final class CameraLogoButton extends ImageButton {
  CameraLogoButton(Context context,Runnable capture){
    super(context);setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_camera);setColorFilter(UiConfig.CAM_LOGO_COLOR);setScaleType(ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
    int inset=Math.round((UiConfig.LOCATE_SIZE_DP-28*UiConfig.LOCATE_VISUAL_SCALE)/2*getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);setPadding(inset,inset,inset,inset);
    setBackground(new RippleDrawable(ColorStateList.valueOf(UiConfig.LOCATE_RIPPLE_COLOR),new Pentagon(false),new Pentagon(true)));

  private static final class Pentagon extends Drawable {
    private final Paint paint=new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);private final boolean mask;
    Pentagon(boolean mask){this.mask=mask;}
    @Override public void draw(Canvas canvas){
      Rect b=getBounds();float stroke=Math.max(2,b.width()*.018f),radius=(Math.min(b.width(),b.height())/2f-stroke)*UiConfig.LOCATE_VISUAL_SCALE;
      float cx=b.exactCenterX(),cy=b.exactCenterY(),depth=Math.max(2,b.height()*.035f);Path path=new Path();
      for(int i=0;i<5;i++){double angle=-Math.PI/2+i*2*Math.PI/5;float x=cx+radius*(float)Math.cos(angle),y=cy+radius*(float)Math.sin(angle);if(i==0)path.moveTo(x,y);else path.lineTo(x,y);}path.close();
      paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);paint.setShader(null);
      if(mask){paint.setColor(Color.WHITE);canvas.drawPath(path,paint);return;}
      canvas.save();canvas.translate(0,depth);paint.setColor(UiConfig.LOCATE_BEVEL_SHADOW);canvas.drawPath(path,paint);canvas.restore();
      paint.setShader(new LinearGradient(cx-radius,cy-radius,cx+radius,cy+radius,new int[]{UiConfig.LOCATE_BEVEL_LIGHT,UiConfig.CAM_BACKGROUND,UiConfig.CAM_BACKGROUND},null,Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));canvas.drawPath(path,paint);paint.setShader(null);
      paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);paint.setStrokeWidth(stroke);paint.setColor(UiConfig.CAM_BORDER_COLOR);canvas.drawPath(path,paint);
    }
    @Override public void setAlpha(int alpha){paint.setAlpha(alpha);invalidateSelf();}
    @Override public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter filter){paint.setColorFilter(filter);invalidateSelf();}
    @Override public int getOpacity(){return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;}
  }
