  private void infoCard(String name, String tag, String detail) {
    LinearLayout card = card();
    card.addView(text(tag, 10, TEAL));
    TextView title = text(name, 18, INK);
    title.setTypeface(Typeface.create(UiConfig.HEADING_FONT, UiConfig.HEADING_FONT_STYLE));
    card.addView(title);
    card.addView(text(detail, 12, MUTED));
  }

  private LinearLayout card() {
    LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
    card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
    card.setPadding(0, dp(9), 0, dp(12));
    AppStyle.decoratePanel(card,UiConfig.PANEL_ACCENTS[downloadCards.getChildCount()%UiConfig.PANEL_ACCENTS.length]);
    LinearLayout.LayoutParams params = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2);
    params.setMargins(0, dp(10), 0, dp(4));
    downloadCards.addView(card, params);
    return card;
  }

  private void packCard(MapPacks.Pack p) {
    LinearLayout card = card();
    card.addView(
        text(
            p.key().equals("mapsforge")
                ? UiConfig.text("offline_map_india")
                : UiConfig.text("optional_source_data_india"),
            10,
            TEAL));
    TextView name = text(p.name(), 19, INK);
    name.setTypeface(Typeface.create(UiConfig.HEADING_FONT, UiConfig.HEADING_FONT_STYLE));
    card.addView(name);
    card.addView(text(p.description(), 12, MUTED));
    TextView state = text(UiConfig.text("checking_phone_storage"), 13, INK);
    card.addView(state);
    ProgressBar progress = new ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
    progress.setProgressTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(AppStyle.BLUE));
    LinearLayout.LayoutParams bar = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(8));
    bar.setMargins(dp(16), dp(4), dp(16), dp(4));
    card.addView(progress, bar);
    TextView bytes = text(UiConfig.text("estimated") + MapPacks.size(p.estimatedBytes()), 12, MUTED);
    card.addView(bytes);
    LinearLayout actions = new LinearLayout(this);
    Button action =
        button(
            UiConfig.text("download"),
            () -> {
              try {
                packs.download(p);
                toast(UiConfig.text("queued_on_phone_wi_fi_or_cellular"));
                for (Runnable r : cardUpdates) r.run();
              } catch (Exception e) {
                toast(e.getMessage());
              }
            });
    Button cancel =
        button(
            UiConfig.text("cancel"),
            () -> {
              packs.cancel(p);
              for (Runnable r : cardUpdates) r.run();
            });
    actions.addView(action, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(48), 1));
    actions.addView(cancel, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(48), 1));
    card.addView(actions);
    final boolean[] checking = {false};
    cardUpdates.add(
        () -> {
          if (checking[0]) { return; }
          checking[0] = true;
          io.execute(
              () -> {
                MapPacks.State s = packs.state(p);
                runOnUiThread(
                    () -> {
                      checking[0] = false;
                      if (!downloads) return;
                      state.setText(s.status());
                      progress.setMax(1000);
                      progress.setProgress(
                          s.installed() && !s.pending()
                              ? 1000
                              : (int) Math.min(1000, s.bytes() * 1000 / Math.max(1, s.total())));
                      progress.setIndeterminate(s.pending() && s.bytes() == 0);
                      bytes.setText(
                          MapPacks.size(s.bytes())
                              + " / "
                              + MapPacks.size(s.total())
                              + (s.pending()
                                  ? " · "
                                      + Math.min(100, s.bytes() * 100 / Math.max(1, s.total()))
                                      + "%"
                                  : UiConfig.text("phone_storage")));
                      action.setEnabled(!s.pending());
                      action.setText(
                          s.installed()
                              ? UiConfig.text("update_manually")
                              : s.status().startsWith("Failed") ? UiConfig.text("retry_download") : "Download");
                      cancel.setEnabled(s.pending());
                    });
              });
        });
  }

  private void backupNow() {
    if (!new TrailBackup(this).configured()) {
      toast(UiConfig.text("choose_a_backup_location_first"));
      return;
    }
    toast(UiConfig.text("saving_trail_backup"));
    io.execute(
        () -> {
          try {
            new TrailBackup(this).save(db, true);
            runOnUiThread(
                () -> {
                  toast(UiConfig.text("backup_written_drive_handles_upload_sync"));
                  if (downloads) showDownloads();
                });
          } catch (Exception e) {
            runOnUiThread(() -> toast(UiConfig.text("backup_failed") + e.getMessage()));
          }
        });
  }

  @Override
  protected void onActivityResult(int request, int result, Intent data) {
    super.onActivityResult(request, result, data);
    if(request==ResonationsWidget.PICK_FILES){if(result==RESULT_OK&&data!=null&&resonations!=null)resonations.selected(data);return;}
    if (result != RESULT_OK || data == null || data.getData() == null) return;
    Uri uri = data.getData();
    if (request == 31) {
      if (routingControls == null) routingControls = new RoutingControls(this);
      routingControls.imported(uri);
      return;
    }
    if (request == 22) {
      try {
        new TrailBackup(this).configure(uri, data.getFlags());
        backupNow();
      } catch (Exception e) {
        toast(UiConfig.text("cannot_retain_backup_access") + e.getMessage());
      }
      return;
    }
    if (request == 23) {
      toast(UiConfig.text("restoring_trail_snapshot"));
      io.execute(
          () -> {
            try {
              new TrailBackup(this).restore(db, uri);
              runOnUiThread(
                  () -> {
                    TrackingStartup.start(this, false);
                    provider = getPreferences(0).getInt("provider", 0);
    wtfEnabled=getPreferences(0).getBoolean("wtf_mode",false);
    wtfCourse=getPreferences(0).getFloat("wtf_course",Float.NaN);
                    offlineOnly = getPreferences(0).getBoolean("offline", false);
                    lastFixId = -1;
                    lastStopSignature = 0;
                    StopGeocoder.backfill(this);
                    toast(
                        UiConfig.text("trail_history_restored_re_select_the_backup_target_to_resume_aut")
                            + UiConfig.text("backups"));
                    if (downloads) showDownloads();
                  });
            } catch (Exception e) {
              runOnUiThread(() -> toast(UiConfig.text("restore_failed") + e.getMessage()));
            }
          });
      return;
    }
    toast(request == 20 ? UiConfig.text("importing_and_validating_india_map") : UiConfig.text("exporting_gps_logs"));
    io.execute(
        () -> {
          try {
            if (request == 20) {
              try (InputStream in = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
                packs.install(in);
              }
            } else if (request == 21) {
              try (Writer w =
                  new OutputStreamWriter(
                      getContentResolver().openOutputStream(uri),
                      java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                db.export(w);
              }
            }
            runOnUiThread(
                () -> {
                  toast(request == 20 ? UiConfig.text("india_pack_imported") : UiConfig.text("geojson_export_saved"));
                  if (downloads) for (Runnable r : cardUpdates) r.run();
                });
          } catch (Exception e) {
            db.log(UiConfig.text("file_operation"), "FAILED", e.toString());
            runOnUiThread(() -> toast(e.getMessage()));
          }
        });
  }

  private Location navigationOrigin() {
    long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
    Location best = preview;
    TrailDb.Fix fix = db.latestFix();
    if (fix != null && (best == null || fix.time() > best.getTime())) {
      best = new Location("trail");
      best.setLatitude(fix.lat());
      best.setLongitude(fix.lon());
      best.setTime(fix.time());
      best.setAccuracy(fix.accuracy());
      best.setSpeed(fix.speed());
    }
    if (best == null
        || !best.hasAccuracy()
        || best.getAccuracy() > 50
        || now - best.getTime() > 30000
        || now - best.getTime() < -10000) return null;
    return best;
  }

  private void refreshLiveBubble(){if(liveBubble!=null&&liveBubblePoint!=null&&!history&&!downloads&&status!=null){
    String address=liveContext.address(),addressNote="";if(LivePopupText.addressPending(address)){addressNote=address;address="";}String road=roadControls.roadName();if(!road.isBlank()&&!address.contains(road))address+=(address.isBlank()?"":"\n")+road;
    liveBubble.update(liveBubblePoint,status.getText(),address,"");
    if(lookupNotes!=null){String note=(addressNote.isBlank()?"":addressNote+"\n")+liveContext.worship(liveBubblePoint.getLatitude(),liveBubblePoint.getLongitude());android.text.SpannableString linked=new android.text.SpannableString(note.trim());
      for(NearbySites.Site site:liveContext.sites(liveBubblePoint.getLatitude(),liveBubblePoint.getLongitude())){int start=linked.toString().indexOf(site.line());if(start>=0)linked.setSpan(new android.text.style.ClickableSpan(){public void onClick(View view){confirmNavigation(new DestinationSearch.Result(site.name(),new RoutePlan.Point(site.lat(),site.lon())));}public void updateDrawState(android.text.TextPaint paint){paint.setColor(UiConfig.STATUS_TEXT_COLOR);paint.setUnderlineText(true);}},start,start+site.line().length(),android.text.Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE);}
      lookupNotes.setText(linked);lookupNotes.setMovementMethod(android.text.method.LinkMovementMethod.getInstance());lookupNotes.setVisibility(note.isBlank()?View.GONE:View.VISIBLE);}

  }}
  private void confirmNavigation(DestinationSearch.Result target){
    NavigationManager.State active=NavigationManager.get(this).state();String replace=active.route()!=null?"\nCurrent destination: "+DestinationLabel.format(active.name())+"\nThis will replace the current route after calculation.":"";
    new AppDialogs(this).setTitle("Navigate to "+target.name()+"?").setMessage(String.format(Locale.US,"Destination: %.4f, %.4f",target.point().lat(),target.point().lon())+replace).setPositiveButton("Start navigation",(dialog,which)->{if(history){history=false;showMap();}navigation.confirmedPlan(target);}).setNegativeButton("Cancel",null).show();
  }
  private void showNavigationHistory(){io.execute(()->{try(NavigationHistory saved=new NavigationHistory(this)){saved.remember(NavigationManager.get(this).state());List<NavigationHistory.Entry> entries=saved.entries();String[] labels=entries.stream().map(item->DestinationLabel.format(item.name())+"\n"+clock(item.time())+String.format(Locale.US," · %.1f km",item.meters()/1000)).toArray(String[]::new);runOnUiThread(()->{if(isFinishing()||isDestroyed())return;if(entries.isEmpty()){toast("No navigation history yet");return;}new AppDialogs(this).setTitle("Navigation history · reload destination").setItems(labels,(dialog,index)->{NavigationHistory.Entry item=entries.get(index);confirmNavigation(new DestinationSearch.Result(item.name(),new RoutePlan.Point(item.lat(),item.lon())));}).setNegativeButton("Close",null).show();});}catch(Exception error){runOnUiThread(()->toast("Cannot load navigation history: "+error.getMessage()));}});}
  private boolean wtfActive(){return wtfEnabled&&!history;}
  private void toggleWtf(){
    wtfEnabled=history||!wtfEnabled;getPreferences(0).edit().putBoolean("wtf_mode",wtfEnabled).apply();
    if(wtfEnabled&&history){history=false;showMap();}
    if(wtfButton!=null)wtfButton.update(wtfActive());if(wtfNorth!=null)wtfNorth.setVisibility(wtfActive()?View.VISIBLE:View.GONE);
    if(wtfEnabled){fitTrail=false;follow=true;navigationFollow=true;if(Float.isFinite(wtfCourse))wtfRotate(WtfCamera.rotation(wtfCourse));if(map.getZoomLevelDouble()<14)map.getController().setZoom(16.0);}
    else{wtfTarget=null;if(wtfTurn!=null){wtfTurn.cancel();wtfTurn=null;}map.setMapOrientation(0);map.invalidate();}
    lastFixId=-1;refresh();navigationTick();toast(wtfEnabled?"WTF! enabled · GPS centered · travel follows diagonal":"WTF! disabled · north-up restored");
  }
  private void wtfCenter(){
    if(!wtfActive()||map==null||wtfTarget==null||wtfRecentering)return;
    wtfRecentering=true;try{map.getController().setCenter(wtfTarget);if(wtfNorth!=null)wtfNorth.rotation(map.getMapOrientation());}finally{wtfRecentering=false;}
  }
  private void wtfRotate(float target){
    if(!wtfActive()||map==null)return;if(wtfTurn!=null)wtfTurn.cancel();MapView view=map;float start=view.getMapOrientation(),turn=WtfCamera.shortestTurn(start,target);
    wtfTurn=android.animation.ValueAnimator.ofFloat(start,start+turn);wtfTurn.setDuration(UiConfig.WTF_TURN_ANIMATION_MS);wtfTurn.addUpdateListener(animation->{if(view!=map||!wtfActive())return;float angle=WtfCamera.normalize((Float)animation.getAnimatedValue());view.setMapOrientation(angle);wtfCenter();view.invalidate();});wtfTurn.start();
  }
  private void navigationChanged() {
    routeFitRevision = -1;
    if ("ACTIVE".equals(NavigationManager.get(this).state().mode())) {
      navigationFollow = true;
      if (history) {
        history = false;
        showMap();
      }
    }
    navigationTick();
    lastFixId = -1;
    refresh();
  }

  private void navigationTick() {
    if (downloads || map == null) return;
    navigation.refresh(map);
    NavigationManager.State state = NavigationManager.get(this).state();
    if (!wtfActive()&&!history && state.route() != null && routeFitRevision != state.revision()) {
      if (!"PREVIEW".equals(state.mode()) || navigation.fit(map))
        routeFitRevision = state.revision();
    }
    if(wtfActive()){Marker live=visibleMarkers.get("live");if(live!=null)wtfTarget=live.getPosition();wtfCenter();return;}
    if (!history && "ACTIVE".equals(state.mode()) && navigationFollow) {
      Location fix = navigationOrigin();
      if (fix != null) {
        map.getController().setCenter(new GeoPoint(fix.getLatitude(), fix.getLongitude()));
        if (map.getZoomLevelDouble() < 14) map.getController().setZoom(16.0);
      }
    }
  }

  private String clock(long t) {
    return new SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM, HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(new Date(t));
  }

  private String duration(long ms) {
    long secs = Math.max(0, ms / 1000);
    return secs < 60
        ? secs + "s"
        : secs < 3600
            ? secs / 60 + UiConfig.text("m_3") + secs % 60 + "s"
            : secs / 3600 + UiConfig.text("h") + secs / 60 % 60 + "m";
  }

  private void fullscreen() {
    getWindow().setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false);
    WindowInsetsController controller = getWindow().getDecorView().getWindowInsetsController();
    if (controller != null) {
      controller.setSystemBarsBehavior(WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE);
      controller.hide(WindowInsets.Type.systemBars());
    }
  }

  @Override public void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean focused) {
    super.onWindowFocusChanged(focused);
    if (focused) fullscreen();
  }

  private void toast(String s) {
    Toast.makeText(this, s, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
  }

  @Override
  protected void onResume() {
    super.onResume();
    fullscreen();
    TrackingStartup.start(this, false);
    StopGeocoder.backfill(this);
    if (map != null) map.onResume();
    if(wtfActive()&&Float.isFinite(wtfCourse))wtfRotate(WtfCamera.rotation(wtfCourse));
    boolean camNow=new ModuleStore(this).enabled("mod2");if(map!=null&&!downloads&&camNow!=camVisible){camVisible=camNow;showMap();}
    updates.resume();
    handler.post(ticker);
  }

  @Override
  protected void onPause() {
    handler.removeCallbacks(ticker);
    if(wtfTurn!=null){wtfTurn.cancel();wtfTurn=null;}
    if(wtfActive()&&map!=null)getPreferences(0).edit().putFloat("wtf_zoom",(float)map.getZoomLevelDouble()).apply();
    if (map != null) map.onPause();
    super.onPause();
  }

  @Override
  public void onBackPressed() {
    if(mapMenu!=null&&mapMenu.closeIfOpen())return;
    if (downloads) {
      showMap();
      return;
    }
    super.onBackPressed();
  }

  @Override
  protected void onDestroy() {
    handler.removeCallbacks(ticker);
    if(wtfTurn!=null){wtfTurn.cancel();wtfTurn=null;}
    if (map != null) map.onDetach();
    io.shutdown();
    heritageIo.shutdownNow();
    if(moduleHost!=null)moduleHost.close();
    navigation.close();
    roadControls.close();
    if(liveContext!=null)liveContext.close();if(liveBubble!=null)liveBubble.close();
    if (routingControls != null) routingControls.close();
    super.onDestroy();
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.app.DownloadManager;
import android.content.*;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Environment;
import org.mapsforge.map.reader.MapFile;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;

/** Large datasets are downloaded by Android directly to phone storage, never bundled. */
public final class MapPacks {
    public record Pack(String key,String name,String description,String url,String filename,long estimatedBytes){}
    public static final Pack[] PACKS={
        new Pack("mapsforge","Mapsforge · India offline","Roads, places and labels. Works in the offline map.","https://download.mapsforge.org/maps/v5/asia/india.map","india.map",1626726400L),
        new Pack("geofabrik","Geofabrik · India source data","Raw OSM PBF for future routing/data tools. Not a viewable map pack.","https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/india-latest.osm.pbf","india.osm.pbf",1712324608L)
    };
    public record State(String status,long bytes,long total,boolean pending,boolean installed){}
    private final Context c;private final TrailDb db;private final SharedPreferences prefs;private final DownloadManager dm;
    public MapPacks(Context c,TrailDb db){this.c=c;this.db=db;prefs=c.getSharedPreferences("packs",0);dm=(DownloadManager)c.getSystemService(Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE);}
    public File active(){return new File(c.getFilesDir(),"maps/india.map");}
    public File raw(){return new File(prefs.getString("raw_path",new File(c.getExternalFilesDir("datasets"),"india.osm.pbf").getAbsolutePath()));}
    private File candidate(Pack p){return new File(prefs.getString(p.key()+"_candidate",new File(c.getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS),p.filename()+".candidate").getAbsolutePath()));}
    public synchronized void download(Pack p){
        if(prefs.getLong(p.key(),-1)!=-1)throw new IllegalStateException("This download is already queued");
        String relative="oTraiL/"+System.currentTimeMillis()+"-"+p.filename();File tmp=new File(Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS),relative);
        prefs.edit().putString(p.key()+"_candidate",tmp.getAbsolutePath()).apply();
        DownloadManager.Request r=new DownloadManager.Request(Uri.parse(p.url())).setTitle("oTraiL · "+p.name()).setDescription("India · Wi-Fi or cellular · "+size(p.estimatedBytes())).setAllowedOverMetered(true).setAllowedOverRoaming(false).setNotificationVisibility(DownloadManager.Request.VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_COMPLETED).setDestinationInExternalPublicDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS,relative);
        long id=dm.enqueue(r);prefs.edit().putLong(p.key(),id).putInt(p.key()+"_policy",2).putString(p.key()+"_status","Queued").apply();db.log(p.name(),"QUEUED",p.url());
    }
    public synchronized void cancel(Pack p){long id=prefs.getLong(p.key(),-1);if(id!=-1)dm.remove(id);prefs.edit().remove(p.key()).putString(p.key()+"_status","Cancelled").apply();db.log(p.name(),"CANCELLED","Previous installed dataset retained");}
    public synchronized State state(Pack p){
        File installed=p.key().equals("mapsforge")?active():raw();long id=prefs.getLong(p.key(),-1);
        if(id==-1)return new State(prefs.getString(p.key()+"_status",installed.exists()?"Ready offline":"Not downloaded"),installed.exists()?installed.length():0,p.estimatedBytes(),false,installed.exists());
        try(Cursor cur=dm.query(new DownloadManager.Query().setFilterById(id))){
            if(!cur.moveToFirst()){finish(p,"Removed from Android downloads");return state(p);}
            int status=cur.getInt(cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_STATUS));long bytes=cur.getLong(cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_BYTES_DOWNLOADED_SO_FAR));if(prefs.getInt(p.key()+"_policy",0)<2&&bytes==0&&(status==DownloadManager.STATUS_PENDING||status==DownloadManager.STATUS_PAUSED)){dm.remove(id);prefs.edit().remove(p.key()).apply();download(p);db.log(p.name(),"MIGRATED","Replaced zero-byte legacy Wi-Fi-only request with metered-network request");return new State("Requeued · Wi-Fi or cellular allowed",0,p.estimatedBytes(),true,installed.exists());}long total=cur.getLong(cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_TOTAL_SIZE_BYTES));if(total<=0)total=p.estimatedBytes();
            if(status==DownloadManager.STATUS_FAILED){finish(p,"Failed · reason "+cur.getInt(cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_REASON)));return state(p);}
            if(status==DownloadManager.STATUS_SUCCESSFUL){
                try{if(p.key().equals("mapsforge")){try(InputStream in=new FileInputStream(candidate(p))){install(in);}}else{File file=candidate(p);if(file.length()<1000000)throw new IOException("Dataset is unexpectedly small");prefs.edit().putString("raw_path",file.getAbsolutePath()).apply();}
                    prefs.edit().putString(p.key()+"_retained",candidate(p).getAbsolutePath()).apply();finish(p,"Ready offline");
                }catch(Exception e){finish(p,"Failed validation: "+e.getMessage());}
                return state(p);
            }
            int reason=cur.getInt(cur.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_REASON));
            String s=status==DownloadManager.STATUS_PAUSED?switch(reason){case DownloadManager.PAUSED_WAITING_FOR_NETWORK->"Paused · no usable network";case DownloadManager.PAUSED_QUEUED_FOR_WIFI->"Paused · Android requires unmetered Wi-Fi";case DownloadManager.PAUSED_WAITING_TO_RETRY->"Paused · server/network retry pending";default->"Paused by Android · reason "+reason;}:status==DownloadManager.STATUS_PENDING?"Queued by Android · awaiting scheduler":"Downloading";
            if(prefs.getInt(p.key()+"_policy",0)<2&&bytes>0)s+=" · legacy Wi-Fi-only job; cancel/retry for cellular";
            return new State(s,bytes,total,true,installed.exists());
        }
    }
    private void finish(Pack p,String status){prefs.edit().remove(p.key()).putString(p.key()+"_status",status).apply();db.log(p.name(),status.startsWith("Ready")?"SUCCESS":"FINISHED",status);}
    public synchronized void install(InputStream in)throws Exception{
        File target=active();target.getParentFile().mkdirs();File part=new File(target.getParentFile(),"candidate.map");
        try{try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(part)){byte[] buffer=new byte[65536];int n;while((n=in.read(buffer))!=-1)out.write(buffer,0,n);out.getFD().sync();}
            MapFile map=new MapFile(part);try{org.mapsforge.core.model.BoundingBox b=map.boundingBox();if(b.maxLatitude<6||b.minLatitude>38||b.maxLongitude<68||b.minLongitude>98)throw new IOException("Map does not overlap India");}finally{map.close();}
            Files.move(part.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            db.log("India offline pack","SUCCESS","Validated map installed; "+target.length()+" bytes");
        }catch(Exception e){part.delete();throw e;}
    }
    public static String size(long bytes){return bytes>=1073741824?String.format(java.util.Locale.US,"%.2f GB",bytes/1073741824.0):String.format(java.util.Locale.US,"%.1f MB",bytes/1048576.0);}
}

package in.otrail;

import org.osmdroid.views.MapView;
import org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Marker;
import org.osmdroid.views.overlay.infowindow.InfoWindow;

/** Always close the previous popup before rebinding the next marker's content. */
final class MarkerPopups {
  private MarkerPopups() {}

  static void openOnly(MapView map, Marker marker) {
    InfoWindow.closeAllInfoWindowsOn(map);
    marker.showInfoWindow();
    if(marker.getInfoWindow()!=null&&marker.getInfoWindow().getView()!=null)
      AppStyle.nativeTextTree(marker.getInfoWindow().getView());
    map.invalidate();
  }
}

package in.otrail;

/**
 * Text-only guidance controls; route overlays have their own identities, separate from trail
 * history.
 */
final class NavigationControls implements AutoCloseable {
  private final Activity activity;
  private final NavigationManager manager;
  private final Supplier<Location> origin;
  private final Runnable locate, changed;
  private final ExecutorService searches = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
  private LinearLayout panel;
  private TextView title, instruction, summary;
  private Button start;
  private MapView lastMap;
  private long drawnRevision = -1;
  private final List<Overlay> overlays = new ArrayList<>();
  private DestinationSearch.Result pending,autoStartTarget;
  private boolean searching;
  java.util.function.Consumer<GeoPoint> roadTap;

  NavigationControls(Activity a, Supplier<Location> origin, Runnable locate, Runnable changed) {

    this.locate = locate;
    this.changed = changed;
  }

  LinearLayout panel() {

    panel.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
    AppStyle.decoratePanel(panel,AppStyle.CORAL);
    android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable background=new android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable();
    background.setColor(UiConfig.NAV_PANEL_BACKGROUND);background.setCornerRadius(UiConfig.NAV_BOX_CORNER_DP*activity.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    background.setStroke(dp(1),UiConfig.NAV_TEXT_SPECTRUM[0]);panel.setBackground(background);
    title = text("", UiConfig.NAV_TITLE_SIZE_SP);
    instruction = text("", UiConfig.NAV_INSTRUCTION_SIZE_SP);
    summary = text("", UiConfig.NAV_SUMMARY_SIZE_SP);
    title.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
    title.setTextAlignment(View.TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
    title.getPaint().setFakeBoldText(UiConfig.NAV_TITLE_BOLD);

    instruction.setMaxLines(2);
    panel.addView(title);
    panel.addView(instruction);
    panel.addView(summary);
    LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(activity);
    start =
        button(
            UiConfig.text("start"),
            () -> {
              NavigationManager.State s = manager.state();
              if ("ACTIVE".equals(s.mode())) {
                locate.run();
              } else {
                if (origin.get() == null) {
                  toast(UiConfig.text("a_fresh_gps_fix_is_required_to_start"));
                  locate.run();
                  return;
                }
                manager.start();
                Location current = origin.get();
                if (current != null) manager.update(current);
                locate.run();
              }
              changed.run();
            });
    row.addView(start, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(44), 1));
    row.addView(button(UiConfig.text("turns"), this::turns), new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(44), 1));
    row.addView(
        button(
            UiConfig.text("clear"),

              changed.run();
            }),
        new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(44), 1));

    panel.addView(row);

    credits.setOnClickListener(
        v ->
            activity.startActivity(
                new Intent(

    credits.setVisibility(View.GONE);
    panel.addView(credits);
    panel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
    return panel;
  }

  private int dp(int value) {
    return (int) (value * activity.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + .5f);
  }

  private TextView text(String value, int size) {
    TextView v = new TextView(activity);
    v.setText(value);
    v.setTextSize(UiConfig.textSize(size));
    AppStyle.text(v);
    v.setTextColor(AppStyle.textColor(size, size>=14));
    if(size>=14)v.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(UiConfig.HEADING_FONT,UiConfig.HEADING_FONT_STYLE));
    v.setPadding(dp(8), dp(2), dp(8), dp(2));
    v.getPaint().setShader(null);
    v.setTextColor(UiConfig.NAV_TEXT_COLOR);
    return v;
  }

  private Button button(String label, Runnable click) {
    Button b = new Button(activity);
    b.setText(label);
    b.setAllCaps(false);
    AppStyle.button(b);
    b.setOnClickListener(v -> click.run());
    return b;
  }

  void search() {
    if (searching) {
      toast(UiConfig.text("search_is_already_running"));
      return;
    }
    EditText query = new EditText(activity);
    query.setHint(UiConfig.text("place_in_india_or_latitude_longitude"));
    query.setSingleLine(true);
    new AppDialogs(activity)
        .setTitle(UiConfig.text("where_are_you_going"))
        .setView(query)
        .setPositiveButton(
            UiConfig.text("search"),
            (d, w) -> {
              String q = query.getText().toString().trim();
              if (manager.offline() && !q.matches("[+\\-0-9.]+\\s*,\\s*[+\\-0-9.]+")) {
                toast(UiConfig.text("offline_enter_latitude_longitude_or_hold_a_point_on_the_map"));
                return;
              }
              if (q.isEmpty()) return;
              searching = true;
              toast(UiConfig.text("searching_places"));
              searches.execute(
                  () -> {
                    try {
                      List<DestinationSearch.Result> results =
                          DestinationSearch.search(activity.getApplicationContext(), q);
                      activity.runOnUiThread(
                          () -> {
                            if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                            if (results.isEmpty()) {
                              toast(
                                  UiConfig.text("no_matching_place_in_india_try_a_nearby_town_or_coordinates"));
                              return;
                            }
                            String[] names =
                                results.stream()
                                    .map(DestinationSearch.Result::name)
                                    .toArray(String[]::new);
                            new AppDialogs(activity)
                                .setTitle(UiConfig.text("choose_destination"))
                                .setItems(names, (dialog, index) -> plan(results.get(index)))
                                .setNegativeButton(UiConfig.text("cancel"), null)
                                .show();
                          });
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                      activity.runOnUiThread(() -> toast(UiConfig.text("search_unavailable") + e.getMessage()));
                    } finally {
                      searching = false;
                    }
                  });
            })
        .setNegativeButton(UiConfig.text("cancel"), null)
        .show();
  }

  void plan(DestinationSearch.Result destination){plan(destination,false);}
  void confirmedPlan(DestinationSearch.Result destination){plan(destination,true);}
  private void plan(DestinationSearch.Result destination,boolean autoStart) {
    if (!DestinationSearch.india(destination.point())) {
      toast(UiConfig.text("choose_a_destination_in_india"));
      return;
    }
    if (manager.offline() && !OfflineRouting.selected(activity)) {
      toast(UiConfig.text("choose_brouter_or_valhalla_in_maps_downloads_to_calculate_offlin"));
      return;
    }
    autoStartTarget=autoStart?destination:null;
    pending = destination;
    Location current = origin.get();
    if (current == null) {
      toast(UiConfig.text("waiting_for_an_accurate_gps_fix"));
      locate.run();
    } else begin(current);
    changed.run();
  }

  private void begin(Location current) {
    DestinationSearch.Result target = pending;
    pending = null;
    manager.preview(
        new RoutePlan.Point(current.getLatitude(), current.getLongitude()),
        target.point(),
        target.name());
  }

  void refresh(MapView map) {
    if (panel == null) return;
    if (pending != null) {
      Location current = origin.get();
      if (current != null) begin(current);
    }
    NavigationManager.State s = manager.state();
    if(autoStartTarget!=null&&pending==null&&s.route()!=null&&s.target()!=null&&"PREVIEW".equals(s.mode())&&RoutePlan.metres(s.target(),autoStartTarget.point())<1){autoStartTarget=null;manager.start();s=manager.state();changed.run();}
    else if(autoStartTarget!=null&&pending==null&&!"PLANNING".equals(s.mode())&&s.target()!=null&&RoutePlan.metres(s.target(),autoStartTarget.point())>=1)autoStartTarget=null;
    boolean has = s.route() != null;
    panel.setVisibility(has || pending != null || !s.note().isEmpty() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    if (panel.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
      draw(map, s);
      return;
    }
    android.text.SpannableString destination=new android.text.SpannableString(DestinationLabel.format(pending != null ? pending.name() : s.name()));
    int placeEnd=destination.toString().indexOf(':');if(placeEnd<0)placeEnd=destination.length();
    if(UiConfig.NAV_TITLE_BOLD)destination.setSpan(new android.text.style.StyleSpan(android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD),0,placeEnd,android.text.Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE);
    title.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(UiConfig.NAV_TITLE_FONT,android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));title.getPaint().setFakeBoldText(false);title.setText(destination);
    NavigationProgress.Guidance g = s.guidance();
    boolean active = "ACTIVE".equals(s.mode());
    boolean stale =
        active && (s.fixTime() == 0 || System.currentTimeMillis() - s.fixTime() > 30_000);
    instruction.setText(
        pending != null
            ? UiConfig.text("waiting_for_a_fresh_gps_fix")
            : stale
                ? UiConfig.text("gps_stale_waiting_for_location")
                : g != null && g.offRoute()
                    ? s.note()
                    : g != null && active && !g.arrived()
                        ? distance(g.untilTurn()) + " · " + g.instruction()
                        : s.note());
    double remaining = g != null ? g.remaining() : has ? s.route().distance : 0,
        seconds = g != null ? g.seconds() : has ? s.route().duration : 0;
    summary.setText(
        has
            ? distance(remaining)
                + UiConfig.text("remaining")
                + Math.max(1, Math.round(seconds / 60))
                + UiConfig.text("min_no_live_traffic")
                + (g != null && g.offRoute() ? " · " + s.note() : "")
            : s.note());
    start.setText(active ? UiConfig.text("recenter") : UiConfig.text("start"));
    start.setEnabled(has && !"ARRIVED".equals(s.mode()) && !"PLANNING".equals(s.mode()));
    draw(map, s);
  }

  private void draw(MapView map, NavigationManager.State s) {
    if (map == null) return;
    if (lastMap != map) {
      lastMap = map;
      drawnRevision = -1;
      overlays.clear();
    }
    if (drawnRevision == s.revision() && overlays.stream().allMatch(map.getOverlays()::contains))
      return;
    map.getOverlays().removeAll(overlays);
    overlays.clear();
    drawnRevision = s.revision();
    if (s.route() != null) {
      ArrayList<GeoPoint> points = new ArrayList<>();
      for (RoutePlan.Point p : s.route().points) points.add(new GeoPoint(p.lat(), p.lon()));
      Polyline route = new Polyline(map);
      route.setId("navigation:route");
      route.setPoints(points);
      route.getOutlinePaint().setColor(UiConfig.NAV_ROUTE_COLOR);
      route.getOutlinePaint().setStrokeWidth(dp(6));
      route.getOutlinePaint().setStyle(android.graphics.Paint.Style.STROKE);route.getOutlinePaint().setStrokeJoin(android.graphics.Paint.Join.ROUND);route.getOutlinePaint().setStrokeCap(android.graphics.Paint.Cap.ROUND);route.getOutlinePaint().setAntiAlias(true);route.getOutlinePaint().setPathEffect(null);
      route.setOnClickListener(
          (line, view, event) -> {
            if (roadTap != null) roadTap.accept(event); else turns();
            return true;
          });
      int index = map.getOverlays().size();
      for (int i = 0; i < map.getOverlays().size(); i++)
        if (map.getOverlays().get(i) instanceof Marker) {
          index = i;
          break;
        }
      map.getOverlays().add(index, route);
      overlays.add(route);
      Marker end = new Marker(map);
      end.setId("navigation:destination");
      end.setPosition(new GeoPoint(s.target().lat(), s.target().lon()));
      end.setTitle(DestinationLabel.format(s.name()));
      end.setSnippet(UiConfig.text("navigation_destination"));
      end.setOnMarkerClickListener(
          (marker, view) -> {
            MarkerPopups.openOnly(view, marker);
            return true;
          });
      map.getOverlays().add(end);
      overlays.add(end);
    }
    map.invalidate();
  }

  boolean fit(MapView map) {
    NavigationManager.State s = manager.state();
    if (map == null || s.route() == null || map.getWidth() == 0 || map.getHeight() == 0)
      return false;
    List<GeoPoint> points = new ArrayList<>();
    for (RoutePlan.Point p : s.route().points) points.add(new GeoPoint(p.lat(), p.lon()));
    BoundingBox bounds = BoundingBox.fromGeoPoints(points);
    if (bounds.getLatitudeSpan() < .0001 && bounds.getLongitudeSpan() < .0001) {
      map.getController().setCenter(points.get(0));
      map.getController().setZoom(16.0);
    } else map.zoomToBoundingBox(bounds, false, dp(25));
    return true;
  }

  private void turns() {
    NavigationManager.State s = manager.state();
    if (s.route() == null) {
      toast(UiConfig.text("choose_a_destination_first"));
      return;
    }
    StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
    for (RoutePlan.Step step : s.route().steps)
      out.append(distance(step.along()))
          .append(UiConfig.text("from_start"))
          .append(step.instruction())
          .append("\n\n");
    new AppDialogs(activity)
        .setTitle(DestinationLabel.format(s.name()))
        .setMessage(out.toString())
        .setPositiveButton(UiConfig.text("close"), null)
        .setNeutralButton(
            UiConfig.text("map_corrections"),
            (d, w) ->
                activity.startActivity(
                    new Intent(
                        Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("https://www.openstreetmap.org/fixthemap"))))
        .show();
  }

  static String distance(double m) {
    return m < 1000
        ? Math.round(m) + UiConfig.text("m_2")
        : String.format(Locale.getDefault(), UiConfig.text("1f_km"), m / 1000);
  }

  private void toast(String message) {
    if (!activity.isDestroyed()) Toast.makeText(activity, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
  }

  @Override
  public void close() {
    searches.shutdownNow();
  }
}

package in.otrail;
import android.content.*;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/** Durable navigation destinations/route summaries, separate from the GPS journal. */
public final class NavigationHistory extends SQLiteOpenHelper {
  public record Entry(String name,double lat,double lon,long time,double meters){}
  public NavigationHistory(Context c){super(c.getApplicationContext(),"navigation-history.db",null,1);setWriteAheadLoggingEnabled(true);}
  @Override public void onCreate(SQLiteDatabase d){d.execSQL("CREATE TABLE routes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,latitude REAL NOT NULL,longitude REAL NOT NULL,first_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,last_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,distance_m REAL NOT NULL,duration_s REAL NOT NULL)");}
  @Override public void onUpgrade(SQLiteDatabase d,int old,int next){}
  public void remember(NavigationManager.State state){
    if(state.route()==null||state.target()==null)return;RoutePlan.Point origin=state.route().points.get(0);String identity=state.name()+"|"+state.target().lat()+"|"+state.target().lon()+"|"+origin.lat()+"|"+origin.lon()+"|"+state.route().distance;
    String id=UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(identity.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).toString();long now=System.currentTimeMillis();ContentValues row=new ContentValues();row.put("id",id);row.put("name",state.name());row.put("latitude",state.target().lat());row.put("longitude",state.target().lon());row.put("first_ms",now);row.put("last_ms",now);row.put("distance_m",state.route().distance);row.put("duration_s",state.route().duration);
    SQLiteDatabase d=getWritableDatabase();d.beginTransaction();try{d.insertWithOnConflict("routes",null,row,SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_IGNORE);ContentValues touch=new ContentValues();touch.put("last_ms",now);d.update("routes",touch,"id=?",new String[]{id});d.setTransactionSuccessful();}finally{d.endTransaction();}
  }
  public List<Entry> entries(){List<Entry> out=new ArrayList<>();try(Cursor c=getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("SELECT name,latitude,longitude,last_ms,distance_m FROM routes ORDER BY last_ms DESC",null)){while(c.moveToNext())out.add(new Entry(c.getString(0),c.getDouble(1),c.getDouble(2),c.getLong(3),c.getDouble(4)));}return out;}
}

package in.otrail;

import android.content.*;
import android.location.Location;
import android.util.AtomicFile;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import org.json.*;

/**
 * Process-wide navigation survives map changes and restores its cached route after app/reboot
 * restart.
 */
public final class NavigationManager {
  public record State(
      RoutePlan route,
      RoutePlan.Point target,
      String name,
      String mode,
      String note,
      NavigationProgress.Guidance guidance,
      long revision,
      long fixTime) {}

  private static NavigationManager instance;

  public static synchronized NavigationManager get(Context c) {
    if (instance == null) instance = new NavigationManager(c.getApplicationContext());
    return instance;
  }

  private final Context context;
  private final ExecutorService requests = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(),
      progress = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(),
      cacheWriter = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
  private State state = new State(null, null, "", "NONE", "", null, 0, 0);
  private NavigationProgress tracker;
  private State lastGoodState;
  private long ticket, lastRequest;
  private boolean fetching;
  private String routeJson;

  private NavigationManager(Context c) {
    context = c;
    requests.execute(this::restore);
  }

  public synchronized State state() {
    return state;
  }

  public boolean offline() {
    return context.getSharedPreferences("MainActivity", 0).getBoolean("offline", false);
  }

  public String server() {
    return context
        .getSharedPreferences("navigation", 0)
        .getString("server", OnlineRouting.DEFAULT_SERVER);
  }

  public void server(String s) throws Exception {
    context
        .getSharedPreferences("navigation", 0)
        .edit()
        .putString("server", OnlineRouting.server(s))
        .apply();
  }

  public void preview(RoutePlan.Point origin, RoutePlan.Point destination, String name) {
    request(origin, destination, name, false);
  }

  private synchronized void request(
      RoutePlan.Point origin, RoutePlan.Point target, String name, boolean reroute) {
    if (offline() && !OfflineRouting.selected(context)) {
      state =
          new State(
              state.route,
              state.target,
              state.name,
              state.mode,
              "Offline only · route calculation needs internet",
              state.guidance,
              state.revision,
              state.fixTime);
      return;
    }
    long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
    if (reroute && (fetching || now-lastRequest<60_000)) return;
    lastRequest = now;
    fetching = true;
    long request = ++ticket;
    if(state.route()!=null)lastGoodState=state;
    State before=state.route()==null&&lastGoodState!=null?lastGoodState:state;
    state =
        new State(
            reroute ? state.route : null,
            reroute ? state.target : target,
            reroute ? state.name : name,
            reroute ? state.mode : "PLANNING",
            reroute ? "Recalculating route…" : "Calculating driving route…",
            reroute ? state.guidance : null,
            state.revision + (reroute ? 0 : 1),
            state.fixTime);
    requests.execute(
        () -> {
          try {
            String engine = OfflineRouting.engine(context);
            String json = engine.equals("online") ? OnlineRouting.route(server(), origin, target)
                : OfflineRouting.route(context, engine, origin, target);
            RoutePlan plan = OsrmRouteParser.parse(json);
            synchronized (this) {
              if (request != ticket) return;
              if(!reroute&&before.route()!=null)rememberHistory(before);
              routeJson = json;
              tracker = new NavigationProgress(plan);
              state =
                  new State(
                      plan,
                      target,
                      name,
                      reroute ? "ACTIVE" : "PREVIEW",
                      reroute ? "Route updated" : "Route preview · tap Start",
                      null,
                      state.revision + 1,
                      0);
              persist();
            }
          } catch (Exception e) {
            synchronized (this) {
              if (request == ticket) {
                State keep = reroute ? state : before;
                state =
                    new State(
                        keep.route,
                        keep.target,
                        keep.name,
                        keep.mode,
                        "Route unavailable: " + e.getMessage(),
                        keep.guidance,
                        state.revision + 1,
                        keep.fixTime);
              }
            }
          } finally {
            synchronized (this) {
              if (request == ticket) fetching = false;
            }
          }
        });
  }

  public synchronized void start() {
    if (state.route == null) return;
    tracker = new NavigationProgress(state.route);
    state =
        new State(
            state.route,
            state.target,
            state.name,
            "ACTIVE",
            "Waiting for a fresh GPS fix",
            null,
            state.revision,
            System.currentTimeMillis());
    rememberHistory(state);
    persist();
  }

  private void rememberHistory(State snapshot){cacheWriter.execute(()->{try(NavigationHistory history=new NavigationHistory(context)){history.remember(snapshot);}catch(Exception error){android.util.Log.w("oTraiL","Navigation history write failed; active route retained",error);}});}

  public synchronized void clear() {
    ticket++;
    fetching = false;
    routeJson = null;
    lastGoodState=null;
    tracker = null;
    state = new State(null, null, "", "NONE", "", null, state.revision + 1, 0);
    cacheWriter.execute(
        () -> new AtomicFile(new File(context.getFilesDir(), "navigation-route.json")).delete());
  }

  public void update(Location location) {
    if (!"ACTIVE".equals(state().mode)) return;
    Location fix = new Location(location);
    progress.execute(() -> accept(fix));
  }

  private synchronized void accept(Location fix) {
    if (tracker == null
        || !"ACTIVE".equals(state.mode)
        || !fix.hasAccuracy()
        || System.currentTimeMillis() - fix.getTime() > 30_000
        || System.currentTimeMillis() - fix.getTime() < -10_000) return;
    RoutePlan.Point point = new RoutePlan.Point(fix.getLatitude(), fix.getLongitude());
    NavigationProgress.Guidance g = tracker.update(point, fix.getAccuracy(), fix.getTime());
    if (!g.accepted()) return;
    boolean arrived =
        g.arrived() && state.target != null && RoutePlan.metres(point, state.target) <= 70;
    String note =
        arrived
            ? "You have arrived"
            : g.arrived()
                ? "At route end · destination "
                    + Math.round(RoutePlan.metres(point, state.target))
                    + " m away"
                : g.offRoute()
                    ? (offline() && !OfflineRouting.selected(context)
                        ? "Off route · select an offline engine in settings"
                        : "Off route · checking a new route")
                    : "Following route";
    state =
        new State(
            state.route,
            state.target,
            state.name,
            arrived ? "ARRIVED" : "ACTIVE",
            note,
            g,
            state.revision,
            fix.getTime());
    if (arrived) {
      ticket++;
      fetching = false;
      persist();
    } else if (g.offRoute() && (!offline() || OfflineRouting.selected(context))) request(point, state.target, state.name, true);
  }

  private void persist() {
    if (routeJson == null || state.target == null) return;
    String response = routeJson;
    State snapshot = state;
    cacheWriter.execute(
        () -> {
          AtomicFile file =
              new AtomicFile(new File(context.getFilesDir(), "navigation-route.json"));
          FileOutputStream out = null;
          try {
            JSONObject saved =
                new JSONObject()
                    .put("version", 1)
                    .put("response", new JSONObject(response))
                    .put("name", snapshot.name)
                    .put("latitude", snapshot.target.lat())
                    .put("longitude", snapshot.target.lon())
                    .put("mode", snapshot.mode);
            out = file.startWrite();
            out.write(saved.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            file.finishWrite(out);
          } catch (Exception e) {
            if (out != null) file.failWrite(out);
          }
        });
  }

  private void restore() {
    try {
      AtomicFile file = new AtomicFile(new File(context.getFilesDir(), "navigation-route.json"));
      if (file.getBaseFile().length() > 12_500_000) return;
      JSONObject saved = new JSONObject(new String(file.readFully(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
      String cached = saved.getJSONObject("response").toString();
      RoutePlan route = OsrmRouteParser.parse(cached);
      String mode = saved.optString("mode", "PREVIEW");
      if (!mode.equals("ACTIVE") && !mode.equals("ARRIVED")) mode = "PREVIEW";
      synchronized (this) {
        if (ticket != 0) return;
        routeJson = cached;
        state =
            new State(
                route,
                new RoutePlan.Point(saved.getDouble("latitude"), saved.getDouble("longitude")),
                saved.optString("name", "Destination"),
                mode,
                "Cached route · waiting for fresh GPS",
                null,
                1,
                0);
        tracker = new NavigationProgress(route);
      }
    } catch (Exception ignored) {
      /* A missing/broken route cache must never affect the journal. */
    }
  }
}

package in.otrail;

/** Pure GPS guidance state; no UI, network, speech or writes to trail history. */
public final class NavigationProgress {
  public record Guidance(
      String instruction,
      double untilTurn,
      double remaining,
      double seconds,
      boolean offRoute,
      boolean arrived,
      boolean accepted) {}

  private final RoutePlan route;
  private double progress = Double.NaN;
  private long lastTime;
  private int offRouteCount, arrivalCount;

  public NavigationProgress(RoutePlan route) {
    this.route = route;
  }

  public Guidance update(RoutePlan.Point point, float accuracy, long time) {
    if (time <= lastTime || !Float.isFinite(accuracy) || accuracy < 0 || accuracy > 50)
      return guidance(false, false, false);
    double elapsed = lastTime == 0 ? 0 : (time - lastTime) / 1000.0;
    lastTime = time;
    RoutePlan.Match match =
        route.match(
            point,
            Double.isNaN(progress) ? 0 : Math.max(0, progress - 35),
            Double.isNaN(progress)
                ? Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY
                : progress + Math.max(800, elapsed * 60 + 200));
    boolean outside = match.distance() > Math.max(60, accuracy * 2);
    if (accuracy <= 35) offRouteCount = outside ? offRouteCount + 1 : 0;
    else offRouteCount = 0;
    if (!outside && Double.isFinite(match.distance()))
      progress = Double.isNaN(progress) ? match.along() : Math.max(progress, match.along());
    boolean atEnd =
        !Double.isNaN(progress)
            && route.length() - progress <= 40
            && RoutePlan.metres(point, route.points.get(route.points.size() - 1)) <= 50
            && accuracy <= 25;
    arrivalCount = atEnd ? arrivalCount + 1 : 0;
    return guidance(offRouteCount >= 3, arrivalCount >= 2, true);
  }

  private Guidance guidance(boolean off, boolean arrived, boolean accepted) {
    double along = Double.isNaN(progress) ? 0 : progress,
        left = Math.max(0, route.length() - along);
    RoutePlan.Step next = null;
    if (along < 25 && !route.steps.isEmpty() && route.steps.get(0).along() < 1)
      next = route.steps.get(0);
    else
      for (RoutePlan.Step step : route.steps)
        if (step.along() > along + 10) {
          next = step;
          break;
        }
    if (next == null && !route.steps.isEmpty()) next = route.steps.get(route.steps.size() - 1);
    return new Guidance(
        arrived
            ? "You have arrived"
            : next == null ? "Continue to destination" : next.instruction(),
        next == null ? left : Math.max(0, next.along() - along),
        left,
        route.length() == 0 ? 0 : route.duration * left / route.length(),
        off,
        arrived,
        accepted);
  }
}

/** Six closest mapped destinations, in any direction; no road-distance claims. */
public final class NearbySites {
  public record Site(String kind,String name,double lat,double lon,double meters){
    public String line(){return kind+": "+name+" — "+(meters<1000?String.format(Locale.US,"%.0f m",meters):String.format(Locale.US,"%.1f km",meters/1000));}
  }
  public static final String[] KINDS={"Temple","Mosque","Church","Gurdwara","Buddhist","Police station"};
  public static List<Site> parse(JSONObject payload,double lat,double lon)throws Exception{
    Site[] nearest=new Site[6];JSONArray elements=payload.optJSONArray("elements");if(elements!=null)for(int i=0;i<elements.length();i++){
      JSONObject e=elements.getJSONObject(i),tags=e.optJSONObject("tags"),point=e.has("lat")?e:e.optJSONObject("center");if(tags==null||point==null)continue;int kind=-1;
      if(tags.optString("amenity").equals("police"))kind=5;else if(tags.optString("amenity").equals("place_of_worship"))for(int r=0;r<5;r++)if(WorshipNearby.RELIGIONS[r].equals(tags.optString("religion")))kind=r;
      if(kind<0)continue;double pLat=point.getDouble("lat"),pLon=point.getDouble("lon"),distance=PhotoIndex.distance(lat,lon,pLat,pLon);if(!Double.isFinite(pLat)||!Double.isFinite(pLon)||Math.abs(pLat)>90||Math.abs(pLon)>180||distance>UiConfig.LIVE_WORSHIP_RADIUS_M)continue;
      String name=tags.optString("name",tags.optString("name:en","")).trim();if(name.isEmpty())name="Name not mapped";
      if(nearest[kind]==null||distance<nearest[kind].meters())nearest[kind]=new Site(KINDS[kind],name,pLat,pLon,distance);
    }
    List<Site> out=new ArrayList<>();for(Site site:nearest)if(site!=null)out.add(site);return List.copyOf(out);
  }

    List<Site> sites=parse(payload,lat,lon);List<String> lines=new ArrayList<>();for(String kind:KINDS){Site found=null;for(Site site:sites)if(site.kind().equals(kind))found=site;lines.add(found==null?kind+": "+(kind.equals("Police station")&&!policeSearched?"checking updated dataset":"not mapped within 25 km"):found.line());}return String.join("\n",lines);
  }

package in.otrail;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import javax.xml.transform.*;
import javax.xml.transform.dom.DOMSource;
import javax.xml.transform.stream.StreamResult;
import org.mapsforge.map.rendertheme.*;
import org.w3c.dom.*;

/** Restyles settlement captions while retaining the bundled map theme's roads and zoom rules. */
final class OfflineMapTheme implements XmlRenderTheme {
  private final XmlRenderTheme base=InternalRenderTheme.OSMARENDER;
  static String cacheKey() {
    return Integer.toHexString(Objects.hash(UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_FONT,UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_STYLE,
        UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_COLOR,UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_OUTLINE_COLOR,
        UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_OUTLINE_WIDTH,UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_SIZE_SCALE,UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_MIN_SIZE,UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_MAX_SIZE,UiConfig.BIG_CITY_LABEL_COLOR,UiConfig.BIG_CITY_LABEL_STYLE,UiConfig.MAP_ROAD_LABEL_COLOR,UiConfig.MAP_OTHER_LABEL_COLOR,UiConfig.MAP_TEXT_OUTLINE_COLOR,UiConfig.MAP_TEXT_FONT));
  }
  @Override public InputStream getRenderThemeAsStream() throws IOException {
    try (InputStream input=base.getRenderThemeAsStream()) {
      DocumentBuilderFactory factory=DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
      factory.setNamespaceAware(true);
      Document document=factory.newDocumentBuilder().parse(input);
      NodeList captions=document.getElementsByTagName("caption");
      List<Element> originalCaptions=new ArrayList<>();
      for(int i=0;i<captions.getLength();i++)originalCaptions.add((Element)captions.item(i));
      for(Element caption:originalCaptions) {
        if(!settlement(caption)){
          caption.setAttribute("fill",color(UiConfig.MAP_OTHER_LABEL_COLOR));
          caption.setAttribute("stroke",color(UiConfig.MAP_TEXT_OUTLINE_COLOR));
          caption.setAttribute("font-family",UiConfig.MAP_TEXT_FONT);continue;
        }
        caption.setAttribute("font-family",UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_FONT);
        caption.setAttribute("font-style",bigCity(caption)?UiConfig.BIG_CITY_LABEL_STYLE:UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_STYLE);
        caption.setAttribute("fill",color(bigCity(caption)?UiConfig.BIG_CITY_LABEL_COLOR:UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_COLOR));
        caption.setAttribute("stroke",color(UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_OUTLINE_COLOR));
        caption.setAttribute("stroke-width",Float.toString(UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_OUTLINE_WIDTH));
        if(caption.hasAttribute("font-size")) {
          float original=Float.parseFloat(caption.getAttribute("font-size"));
          Element parent=(Element)caption.getParentNode();
          if("city".equals(parent.getAttribute("v")))parent.setAttribute("zoom-max","22");
          int[][] bands={{0,7},{8,10},{11,13},{14,22}};
          for(int[] band:bands) {
            Element zoomRule=document.createElement("rule");
            zoomRule.setAttribute("e",parent.getAttribute("e").isEmpty()?"any":parent.getAttribute("e"));
            zoomRule.setAttribute("k","*");zoomRule.setAttribute("v","*");
            zoomRule.setAttribute("zoom-min",Integer.toString(band[0]));zoomRule.setAttribute("zoom-max",Integer.toString(band[1]));
            Element scaled=(Element)caption.cloneNode(true);
            scaled.setAttribute("font-size",Float.toString(citySize(original,band[1])));
            zoomRule.appendChild(scaled);parent.appendChild(zoomRule);
          }
          parent.removeChild(caption);
        }
      }
      NodeList roadLabels=document.getElementsByTagName("pathText");
      for(int i=0;i<roadLabels.getLength();i++) {
        Element text=(Element)roadLabels.item(i);
        text.setAttribute("fill",color(UiConfig.MAP_ROAD_LABEL_COLOR));
        text.setAttribute("stroke",color(UiConfig.MAP_TEXT_OUTLINE_COLOR));
        text.setAttribute("font-family",UiConfig.MAP_TEXT_FONT);
      }
      ByteArrayOutputStream output=new ByteArrayOutputStream();
      TransformerFactory.newInstance().newTransformer().transform(new DOMSource(document),new StreamResult(output));
      return new ByteArrayInputStream(output.toByteArray());
    } catch(Exception e) {throw new IOException("Cannot prepare offline city-label theme",e);}
  }
  static float citySize(float original,int zoom) {
    float factor=zoom<=7?.36f:zoom<=10?.40f:zoom<=13?.48f:.56f;
    return Math.max(UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_MIN_SIZE,Math.min(UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_MAX_SIZE,original*factor))*UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_SIZE_SCALE;
  }
  private static boolean bigCity(Element caption){
    for(Node node=caption.getParentNode();node instanceof Element;node=node.getParentNode()) {
      Element rule=(Element)node;if("place".equals(rule.getAttribute("k"))&&Arrays.asList(rule.getAttribute("v").split("\\|")).contains("city"))return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  private static boolean settlement(Element caption) {
    Set<String> places=Set.of("city","town","village","suburb","hamlet","locality","neighbourhood");
    for(Node n=caption.getParentNode();n instanceof Element;n=n.getParentNode()) {
      Element rule=(Element)n;
      if("rule".equals(rule.getTagName())&&"place".equals(rule.getAttribute("k")))
        for(String value:rule.getAttribute("v").split("\\|"))if(places.contains(value))return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  private static String color(int argb){return String.format(Locale.ROOT,"#%08X",argb);}
  @Override public String getRelativePathPrefix(){return base.getRelativePathPrefix();}
  @Override public XmlRenderThemeMenuCallback getMenuCallback(){return base.getMenuCallback();}
  @Override public void setMenuCallback(XmlRenderThemeMenuCallback callback){base.setMenuCallback(callback);}
  @Override public XmlThemeResourceProvider getResourceProvider(){return base.getResourceProvider();}
  @Override public void setResourceProvider(XmlThemeResourceProvider provider){base.setResourceProvider(provider);}
}

package in.otrail;

import java.util.*;
import org.json.*;

/** Both offline engines produce the same cached route format; never writes GPS observations. */
public final class OfflineRouteCodec {
  static String brouter(String json) throws Exception {
    JSONObject feature = new JSONObject(json).getJSONArray("features").getJSONObject(0);
    JSONArray points = feature.getJSONObject("geometry").getJSONArray("coordinates");
    JSONObject properties = feature.getJSONObject("properties");
    JSONArray steps = new JSONArray();
    add(steps, points.getJSONArray(0), "Head along the route");
    JSONArray hints = properties.optJSONArray("voicehints");
    if (hints != null) for (int i = 0; i < hints.length(); i++) {
      JSONArray h = hints.getJSONArray(i);
      int index = h.getInt(0), code = h.getInt(1);
      if (index < 0 || index >= points.length()) continue;
      String text = switch (code) {
        case 2 -> "Turn left"; case 3 -> "Turn slightly left"; case 4 -> "Turn sharply left";
        case 5 -> "Turn right"; case 6 -> "Turn slightly right"; case 7 -> "Turn sharply right";
        case 8 -> "Keep left"; case 9 -> "Keep right";
        case 10,11,15 -> "Make a U-turn";
        case 13,14 -> "At the roundabout take exit " + Math.abs(h.optInt(2, 1));
        case 17 -> "Take the exit left"; case 18 -> "Take the exit right";
        default -> "Continue along the route";
      };
      add(steps, points.getJSONArray(index), text);
    }
    add(steps, points.getJSONArray(points.length()-1), "Arrive at destination");
    return encode(points, steps, properties.getDouble("track-length"), properties.getDouble("total-time"));
  }

  static String valhalla(String json) throws Exception {
    JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
    if (root.has("error") || root.has("error_code") || root.has("code"))
      throw new IllegalArgumentException(root.optString("error", root.optString("message", "Valhalla could not find a route")));
    JSONObject trip = root.getJSONObject("trip");
    JSONArray legs = trip.getJSONArray("legs"), points = new JSONArray(), steps = new JSONArray();
    for (int i = 0; i < legs.length(); i++) {
      JSONObject leg = legs.getJSONObject(i);
      JSONArray shape = decode(leg.getString("shape"));
      for (int j=0;j<shape.length();j++) points.put(shape.getJSONArray(j));
      JSONArray maneuvers = leg.getJSONArray("maneuvers");
      for (int j=0;j<maneuvers.length();j++) {
        JSONObject m = maneuvers.getJSONObject(j);
        add(steps, shape.getJSONArray(m.getInt("begin_shape_index")), m.getString("instruction"));
      }
    }
    JSONObject summary = trip.getJSONObject("summary");
    return encode(points, steps, summary.getDouble("length")*1000, summary.getDouble("time"));
  }

  static JSONArray decode(String encoded) throws Exception {
    JSONArray out = new JSONArray(); long lat=0, lon=0; int[] cursor={0};
    while (cursor[0]<encoded.length()) {
      lat+=number(encoded,cursor); lon+=number(encoded,cursor);
      out.put(new JSONArray().put(lon/1e6).put(lat/1e6));
      if(out.length()>200000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Route too large");
    }
    return out;
  }
  private static long number(String s,int[] cursor) {
    long value=0; int shift=0,b;
    do {
      if(cursor[0]>=s.length() || shift>30) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid route geometry");
      b=s.charAt(cursor[0]++)-63;
      if(b<0 || b>63) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid route geometry");
      value|=(long)(b&31)<<shift; shift+=5;
    } while(b>=32);
    return (value&1)!=0 ? ~(value>>1) : value>>1;
  }
  private static void add(JSONArray steps,JSONArray xy,String text) throws Exception {
    steps.put(new JSONObject().put("_instruction",text).put("maneuver",new JSONObject().put("location",xy).put("type","continue")));
  }
  private static String encode(JSONArray points,JSONArray steps,double distance,double duration) throws Exception {
    return new JSONObject().put("code","Ok").put("routes",new JSONArray().put(new JSONObject()
      .put("geometry",new JSONObject().put("type","LineString").put("coordinates",points))
      .put("distance",distance).put("duration",duration)
      .put("legs",new JSONArray().put(new JSONObject().put("steps",steps))))) .toString();
  }
}

/** Embedded on-device engines. No HTTP client or online fallback is used here. */
public final class OfflineRouting {
  public static String engine(Context c) { return c.getSharedPreferences("navigation",0).getString("engine","online"); }
  public static boolean selected(Context c) { return !engine(c).equals("online"); }
  public static File root(Context c) { File f=new File(c.getFilesDir(),"routing");f.mkdirs();return f; }
  public static synchronized String route(Context c,String engine,RoutePlan.Point from,RoutePlan.Point to) throws Exception {
    if(from.lat()<6 || from.lat()>38 || from.lon()<68 || from.lon()>98 || to.lat()<6 || to.lat()>38 || to.lon()<68 || to.lon()>98)
      throw new IOException("Offline routing is configured for India");

      File rules=new File(root(c),"profiles2");rules.mkdirs();
      for(String name:new String[]{"car-vario.brf","lookups.dat"}) {
        File file=new File(rules,name);
        try(InputStream in=c.getAssets().open("brouter/"+name); FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(file)) { TrailBackup.copy(in,out); }
      }
      File segments=new File(root(c),"segments4");segments.mkdirs();
      List<OsmNodeNamed> waypoints=new ArrayList<>();
      for(RoutePlan.Point p:List.of(from,to)) {
        OsmNodeNamed n=new OsmNodeNamed();n.name=waypoints.isEmpty()?"from":"to";
        n.ilon=(int)Math.round((p.lon()+180)*1e6);n.ilat=(int)Math.round((p.lat()+90)*1e6);waypoints.add(n);
      }
      RoutingContext rc=new RoutingContext();rc.localFunction=new File(rules,"car-vario.brf").getAbsolutePath();rc.memoryclass=128;rc.turnInstructionMode=3;
      RoutingEngine router=new RoutingEngine(null,null,segments,waypoints,rc);
      router.doRun(60_000);
      if(router.getErrorMessage()!=null) throw new IOException(router.getErrorMessage()+" · check BRouter regional tiles in settings");
      if(router.getFoundTrack()==null) throw new IOException("No BRouter route found");
      return OfflineRouteCodec.brouter(new FormatJson(rc).format(router.getFoundTrack()));
    }
    if(!engine.equals("valhalla")) throw new IOException("Choose an offline routing engine");
    File tiles=new File(root(c),"valhalla/india.tar");
    if(!tiles.isFile()) throw new IOException("Download or import an India Valhalla graph pack in settings");
    JSONObject config;
    try(InputStream in=Valhalla.class.getResourceAsStream("/com/valhalla/valhalla/default.json")) {
      if(in==null)throw new IOException("Valhalla default configuration missing");
      ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream();TrailBackup.copy(in,out);
      config=new JSONObject(out.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name()));
    }
    JSONObject mj=config.getJSONObject("mjolnir");
    mj.put("tile_extract",tiles.getAbsolutePath());mj.put("tile_dir",tiles.getParent());
    mj.put("max_cache_size",134217728);mj.remove("tile_url");mj.remove("traffic_extract");
    File conf=new File(root(c),"valhalla.json");
    try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(conf)){out.write(config.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}
    JSONObject req=new JSONObject().put("locations",new JSONArray()
      .put(new JSONObject().put("lat",from.lat()).put("lon",from.lon()))
      .put(new JSONObject().put("lat",to.lat()).put("lon",to.lon())))
      .put("costing","auto").put("units","kilometers").put("language","en-US");
    try(Valhalla actor=new Valhalla(conf.getAbsolutePath())) {
      return OfflineRouteCodec.valhalla(actor.routeRaw(req.toString()));
    } catch(LinkageError e) { throw new IOException("Valhalla is unavailable on this phone architecture",e); }
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Locale;

/** Light personal use; replace the HTTPS OSRM endpoint for a production/self-hosted service. */
public final class OnlineRouting {
  public static final String DEFAULT_SERVER =
      "https://routing.openstreetmap.de/routed-car/route/v1/driving/";

  public static String server(String value) throws Exception {
    URI uri = new URI(value.trim());
    if (!"https".equals(uri.getScheme())
        || uri.getHost() == null
        || uri.getUserInfo() != null
        || uri.getQuery() != null
        || uri.getFragment() != null)
      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
          "Enter an HTTPS OSRM driving endpoint without credentials or query parameters");
    return value.trim().endsWith("/") ? value.trim() : value.trim() + "/";
  }

  public static String route(String endpoint, RoutePlan.Point from, RoutePlan.Point to)
      throws Exception {
    String url =
        server(endpoint)
            + String.format(
                Locale.US,
                "%.6f,%.6f;%.6f,%.6f?steps=true&overview=full&geometries=geojson&alternatives=false",
                from.lon(),
                from.lat(),
                to.lon(),
                to.lat());
    return get(url, 12_000_000);
  }

  static String get(String url, int maxBytes) throws Exception {
    HttpURLConnection c = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(url).openConnection();
    c.setConnectTimeout(12000);
    c.setReadTimeout(20000);
    c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "oTraiL/0.2.4 (in.otrail; personal navigation)");
    try {
      int code = c.getResponseCode();
      if (code != 200)
        throw new IOException(
            code == 429
                ? "Routing server is busy; try again later"
                : "Server returned HTTP " + code);
      try (InputStream in = c.getInputStream();
          ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
        byte[] b = new byte[8192];
        int n;
        while ((n = in.read(b)) != -1) {
          if (out.size() + n > maxBytes) throw new IOException("Response exceeds size limit");
          out.write(b, 0, n);
        }
        return out.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name());
      }
    } finally {
      c.disconnect();
    }
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import java.util.*;
import org.json.*;

public final class OsrmRouteParser {
  private OsrmRouteParser() {}

  public static RoutePlan parse(String json) throws Exception {
    JSONObject root = new JSONObject(json);
    if (!"Ok".equals(root.optString("code")))
      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
          "No driving route: " + root.optString("message", root.optString("code")));
    JSONObject r = root.getJSONArray("routes").getJSONObject(0);
    JSONArray coordinates = r.getJSONObject("geometry").getJSONArray("coordinates");
    if (coordinates.length() > 200000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Route is too large");
    List<RoutePlan.Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < coordinates.length(); i++) {
      JSONArray p = coordinates.getJSONArray(i);
      points.add(new RoutePlan.Point(p.getDouble(1), p.getDouble(0)));
    }
    RoutePlan geometry =
        new RoutePlan(points, List.of(), r.getDouble("distance"), r.getDouble("duration"));
    List<RoutePlan.Step> steps = new ArrayList<>();
    int cursor = 0;
    JSONArray legs = r.getJSONArray("legs");
    for (int l = 0; l < legs.length(); l++) {
      JSONArray raw = legs.getJSONObject(l).getJSONArray("steps");
      for (int i = 0; i < raw.length(); i++) {
        JSONObject s = raw.getJSONObject(i), m = s.getJSONObject("maneuver");
        JSONArray xy = m.getJSONArray("location");
        RoutePlan.Point at = new RoutePlan.Point(xy.getDouble(1), xy.getDouble(0));
        double best = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        int index = cursor;
        for (int p = cursor; p < points.size(); p++) {
          double d = RoutePlan.metres(at, points.get(p));
          if (d < best) {
            best = d;
            index = p;
          }
          if (d < .5) break;
        }
        cursor = index;
        steps.add(
            new RoutePlan.Step(
                geometry.cumulative[index],
                s.optString("_instruction", instruction(m, s.optString("name"), s.optString("ref")))));
      }
    }
    if (steps.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Route contains no turn instructions");
    return new RoutePlan(points, steps, geometry.distance, geometry.duration);
  }

  static String instruction(JSONObject m, String name, String ref) {
    String type = m.optString("type"),
        modifier = m.optString("modifier", "straight").replace('_', ' '),
        road = name.isBlank() ? ref : name;
    String text =
        switch (type) {
          case "depart" -> "Head " + heading(m.optInt("bearing_after", 0));
          case "arrive" -> "Arrive at destination";
          case "roundabout", "rotary" ->
              "Enter roundabout"
                  + (m.optInt("exit", 0) > 0 ? " · take exit " + m.optInt("exit") : "");
          case "exit roundabout", "exit rotary" -> "Exit roundabout";
          case "merge" -> "Merge " + modifier;
          case "on ramp" -> "Take the ramp " + modifier;
          case "off ramp" -> "Take the exit " + modifier;
          case "fork" -> "Keep " + modifier + " at the fork";
          case "end of road" -> "At the end of the road, turn " + modifier;
          case "turn" -> modifier.equals("uturn") ? "Make a U-turn" : "Turn " + modifier;
          case "new name", "continue", "notification" -> "Continue " + modifier;
          default -> "Continue " + modifier;
        };
    return !road.isBlank() && !type.equals("arrive") ? text + " onto " + road : text;
  }

  private static String heading(int b) {
    return new String[] {
          "north", "northeast", "east", "southeast", "south", "southwest", "west", "northwest"
        }
        [(int) Math.floorMod(Math.round(b / 45.0), 8)];
  }
}
