package in.otrail;

import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import org.json.*;

/** CAM's normalized index. JPEG and JSON originals live in the user-selected public folder. */
public final class PhotoIndex {
  private PhotoIndex() {}
  static void schema(SQLiteDatabase d) {
    d.execSQL("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,stop_id INTEGER REFERENCES stops(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,captured_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,accuracy_m REAL,fix_ms INTEGER,uri TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,filename TEXT NOT NULL,metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL)");
    d.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS photos_stop_time ON photos(stop_id,captured_ms)");
    d.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS photos_capture_time ON photos(captured_ms)");
  }
  static Long stopAt(SQLiteDatabase d,long time,double lat,double lon) {
    try(Cursor c=d.rawQuery("SELECT id,latitude,longitude FROM stops WHERE arrival_ms<=? AND (departure_ms>=? OR (departure_ms IS NULL AND observed_ms>=?)) ORDER BY arrival_ms DESC LIMIT 1",new String[]{""+time,""+time,""+(time-120000)})) {
      if(c.moveToFirst()&&distance(lat,lon,c.getDouble(1),c.getDouble(2))<=150)return c.getLong(0);
    }
    return null;
  }
  static double distance(double lat,double lon,double otherLat,double otherLon) {
    double a=Math.toRadians(lat-otherLat),b=Math.toRadians(lon-otherLon);
    double h=Math.sin(a/2)*Math.sin(a/2)+Math.cos(Math.toRadians(lat))*Math.cos(Math.toRadians(otherLat))*Math.sin(b/2)*Math.sin(b/2);
    return 12742000*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)));
  }
  static JSONObject context(TrailDb db,long time)throws Exception {
    JSONObject j=new JSONObject().put("captured_ms",time);TrailDb.Fix f=db.latestFix();
    if(f!=null){j.put("latitude",f.lat()).put("longitude",f.lon()).put("accuracy_m",f.accuracy()).put("fix_ms",f.time());
      // A stale fix is retained as explicitly aged metadata, never silently treated as a new fix.
      if(Math.abs(time-f.time())<=120000){Long stop=stopAt(db.getReadableDatabase(),time,f.lat(),f.lon());if(stop!=null){
        j.put("stop_id",stop);try(Cursor c=db.getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("SELECT trips.started_ms,stops.arrival_ms FROM stops JOIN trips ON trips.id=stops.trip_id WHERE stops.id=?",new String[]{""+stop})){
          if(c.moveToFirst())j.put("stop_uid","s"+c.getLong(0)+"-"+c.getLong(1));
        }
      }}
    }
    return j;
  }
  public static void validate(JSONObject j)throws Exception {
    if(!j.getString("id").matches("[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}")||j.getLong("captured_ms")<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid photo identity/time");
    if(!j.getString("uri").startsWith("content://")||j.getString("filename").contains("/")||j.getString("filename").length()>240)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid photo destination");
    if(j.has("latitude")&&(Math.abs(j.getDouble("latitude"))>90||Math.abs(j.getDouble("longitude"))>180||!Double.isFinite(j.getDouble("latitude"))||!Double.isFinite(j.getDouble("longitude"))))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid photo coordinates");
  }
  static void save(TrailDb db,String metadata)throws Exception {
    JSONObject j=new JSONObject(metadata);validate(j);SQLiteDatabase d=db.getWritableDatabase();
    Long stop=null;
    if(j.has("latitude")&&Math.abs(j.getLong("captured_ms")-j.optLong("fix_ms",0))<=120000)stop=stopAt(d,j.getLong("captured_ms"),j.getDouble("latitude"),j.getDouble("longitude"));
    j.put("stop_id",stop==null?JSONObject.NULL:stop);
    ContentValues v=new ContentValues();v.put("id",j.getString("id"));if(stop==null)v.putNull("stop_id");else v.put("stop_id",stop);
    v.put("captured_ms",j.getLong("captured_ms"));for(String key:new String[]{"latitude","longitude","accuracy_m"})if(j.has(key))v.put(key,j.getDouble(key));
    v.put("fix_ms",j.optLong("fix_ms",0));v.put("uri",j.getString("uri"));v.put("filename",j.getString("filename"));v.put("metadata_json",j.toString());
    d.insertWithOnConflict("photos",null,v,SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE);
  }
  static String list(TrailDb db,long stop)throws Exception {
    JSONArray out=new JSONArray();
    try(Cursor c=db.getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("SELECT metadata_json,stop_id FROM photos"+(stop>0?" WHERE stop_id=?":"")+" ORDER BY captured_ms DESC",stop>0?new String[]{""+stop}:null)){
      while(c.moveToNext())out.put(new JSONObject(c.getString(0)).put("stop_id",c.isNull(1)?JSONObject.NULL:c.getLong(1)));
    }
    return out.toString();
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import java.util.*;
import org.json.*;

/** Persisted document references only; selected audio is never copied into the journal. */
public final class ResonationsPlaylist {
  public record Track(String uri,String name) {}
  public static List<Track> decode(String json){
    List<Track> tracks=new ArrayList<>();Set<String> seen=new HashSet<>();
    try{JSONArray list=new JSONArray(json);for(int i=0;i<list.length();i++){
      JSONObject item=list.optJSONObject(i);if(item==null)continue;
      String uri=item.optString("uri"),name=item.optString("name","Audio");
      if(uri.startsWith("content://")&&seen.add(uri))tracks.add(new Track(uri,name));
    }}catch(JSONException ignored){}return List.copyOf(tracks);
  }
  public static String encode(List<Track> tracks){JSONArray list=new JSONArray();for(Track track:tracks)try{list.put(new JSONObject().put("uri",track.uri()).put("name",track.name()));}catch(JSONException ignored){}return list.toString();}
  public static List<String> visibleNames(List<Track> tracks){List<String> lines=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<Math.min(3,tracks.size());i++)lines.add(tracks.get(i).name());if(tracks.size()>3)lines.add("…");return List.copyOf(lines);}
  public static int next(int index,int size){return size==0?0:Math.floorMod(index+1,size);}
}

package in.otrail;

import android.app.*;
import android.content.*;
import android.media.*;
import android.media.session.*;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet;

/** Independent user-started media playback; never participates in tracker startup or GPS writes. */
public final class ResonationsService extends Service {
  static final String PLAY="in.otrail.RESONATIONS_PLAY", PAUSE="in.otrail.RESONATIONS_PAUSE";
  static final Set<Runnable> listeners=new CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
  static boolean active;static String message="";
  private MediaPlayer player;private AudioManager audio;private AudioFocusRequest focus;private MediaSession session;
  private List<ResonationsPlaylist.Track> tracks=List.of();private int index,failed;private boolean prepared;
  static android.content.SharedPreferences prefs(Context c){return c.getSharedPreferences("resonations",0);}
  static List<ResonationsPlaylist.Track> tracks(Context c){return ResonationsPlaylist.decode(prefs(c).getString("playlist","[]"));}
  static void changed(){for(Runnable r:listeners)r.run();}
  @Override public void onCreate(){super.onCreate();audio=(AudioManager)getSystemService(AUDIO_SERVICE);session=new MediaSession(this,"Resonations");session.setCallback(new MediaSession.Callback(){@Override public void onPause(){pause();}@Override public void onStop(){pause();}});((NotificationManager)getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE)).createNotificationChannel(new NotificationChannel("resonations","Resonations audio",NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));}
  @Override public int onStartCommand(Intent intent,int flags,int id){
    if(intent==null||PAUSE.equals(intent.getAction())){pause();return START_NOT_STICKY;}
    if(active)return START_NOT_STICKY;
    tracks=tracks(this);if(tracks.isEmpty()){stopSelf();return START_NOT_STICKY;}
    index=Math.floorMod(prefs(this).getInt("index",0),tracks.size());
    startForeground(24,notification("Preparing audio"));
    AudioAttributes attributes=new AudioAttributes.Builder().setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA).setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC).build();
    focus=new AudioFocusRequest.Builder(AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN).setAudioAttributes(attributes).setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(change->{if(change<0)pause();},new Handler(getMainLooper())).build();
    if(audio.requestAudioFocus(focus)!=AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED){message="Audio busy · tap Play to retry";pause();return START_NOT_STICKY;}
    active=true;session.setActive(true);session.setPlaybackState(new PlaybackState.Builder().setActions(PlaybackState.ACTION_PAUSE|PlaybackState.ACTION_STOP).setState(PlaybackState.STATE_BUFFERING,0,1).build());failed=0;load(prefs(this).getInt("position",0),attributes);return START_NOT_STICKY;
  }
  private Notification notification(String text){
    PendingIntent open=PendingIntent.getActivity(this,24,new Intent(this,MainActivity.class),PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE|PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
    PendingIntent pause=PendingIntent.getService(this,25,new Intent(this,ResonationsService.class).setAction(PAUSE),PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE|PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
    return new Notification.Builder(this,"resonations").setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_media_play).setContentTitle("Resonations · looping").setContentText(text).setContentIntent(open).setOngoing(true).setStyle(new Notification.MediaStyle().setMediaSession(session.getSessionToken()).setShowActionsInCompactView(0)).addAction(new Notification.Action.Builder(null,"Pause",pause).build()).build();
  }
  private void load(int position,AudioAttributes attributes){
    release();if(!active)return;message="Loading · "+tracks.get(index).name();changed();
    MediaPlayer current=new MediaPlayer();player=current;current.setAudioAttributes(attributes);current.setWakeMode(this,PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK);
    current.setOnPreparedListener(p->{if(player!=p||!active)return;prepared=true;try{if(p.getDuration()<=0){skip(attributes);return;}if(position>0&&position<p.getDuration())p.seekTo(position);p.start();}catch(RuntimeException error){skip(attributes);return;}message=tracks.get(index).name();session.setMetadata(new MediaMetadata.Builder().putString(MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_TITLE,message).putLong(MediaMetadata.METADATA_KEY_DURATION,p.getDuration()).build());session.setPlaybackState(new PlaybackState.Builder().setActions(PlaybackState.ACTION_PAUSE|PlaybackState.ACTION_STOP).setState(PlaybackState.STATE_PLAYING,position,1).build());prefs(this).edit().putInt("index",index).putInt("position",0).apply();((NotificationManager)getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE)).notify(24,notification(message));changed();});
    current.setOnCompletionListener(p->{if(player!=p||!active)return;failed=0;index=ResonationsPlaylist.next(index,tracks.size());load(0,attributes);});
    current.setOnErrorListener((p,what,extra)->{if(player==p)skip(attributes);return true;});
    try{current.setDataSource(this,Uri.parse(tracks.get(index).uri()));current.prepareAsync();}catch(Exception error){skip(attributes);}
  }
  private void skip(AudioAttributes attributes){
    if(++failed>=tracks.size()){message="Files unavailable or unsupported · choose again";prefs(this).edit().putInt("position",0).apply();pause();return;}
    index=ResonationsPlaylist.next(index,tracks.size());new Handler(getMainLooper()).post(()->{if(active)load(0,attributes);});
  }
  private void pause(){if(prepared&&player!=null)try{prefs(this).edit().putInt("index",index).putInt("position",player.getCurrentPosition()).apply();}catch(IllegalStateException ignored){}active=false;release();if(focus!=null){audio.abandonAudioFocusRequest(focus);focus=null;}stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE);changed();stopSelf();}
  private void release(){prepared=false;if(player!=null){MediaPlayer old=player;player=null;old.setOnPreparedListener(null);old.setOnCompletionListener(null);old.setOnErrorListener(null);old.release();}}
  @Override public void onDestroy(){if(session!=null){session.setActive(false);session.release();}active=false;release();if(focus!=null)audio.abandonAudioFocusRequest(focus);changed();super.onDestroy();}
  @Override public IBinder onBind(Intent intent){return null;}
}

package in.otrail;

import android.content.*;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import org.json.*;

/** Separate, replaceable source cache. It never changes the trail journal. */
public final class RoadContext extends SQLiteOpenHelper {
  public record Landmark(String key,String name,String kind,double lat,double lon,double meters){}
  public record Snapshot(String road,List<Landmark> landmarks,long fetched,boolean cached,String note){}
  public RoadContext(Context c){super(c,"road-cache.db",null,1);setWriteAheadLoggingEnabled(true);}
  public void onCreate(SQLiteDatabase db){db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE areas(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,fetched_ms INTEGER,payload TEXT NOT NULL)");}
  public void onUpgrade(SQLiteDatabase d,int old,int next){}
  private record Area(JSONObject payload,long fetched){}
  private Area area(double lat,double lon) throws Exception {
    Area best=null;double distance=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    try(Cursor c=getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("SELECT latitude,longitude,fetched_ms,payload FROM areas WHERE latitude BETWEEN ? AND ? AND longitude BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY fetched_ms DESC",new String[]{""+(lat-.025),""+(lat+.025),""+(lon-.03),""+(lon+.03)})) {
      while(c.moveToNext()){double d=StopDetector.distance(lat,lon,c.getDouble(0),c.getDouble(1));if(d<1200&&d<distance){distance=d;best=new Area(new JSONObject(c.getString(3)),c.getLong(2));}}
    }
    return best;
  }
  public Snapshot cached(double lat,double lon,double bearing) throws Exception {
    Area area=area(lat,lon);return area==null?new Snapshot("",List.of(),0,true,"Road data not cached here"):parse(area.payload(),lat,lon,bearing,area.fetched(),true);
  }
  public Snapshot fetch(double lat,double lon,double bearing) throws Exception {
    if(lat<6||lat>38||lon<68||lon>98)throw new IOException("Road lookup is limited to India");
    String around=String.format(Locale.US,"(around:2500,%.6f,%.6f)",lat,lon);
    String roads="way"+around+"[highway~\"^(motorway|trunk|primary|secondary|tertiary|unclassified|residential|service|living_street|motorway_link|trunk_link|primary_link|secondary_link|tertiary_link)$\"];";
    String query="[out:json][timeout:20];("+roads+");out tags geom 1800;(nwr"+around+"[amenity=place_of_worship];nwr"+around+"[tourism~\"^(attraction|museum|viewpoint|artwork|information)$\"];nwr"+around+"[historic];nwr"+around+"[natural=peak];);out tags center 1200;";
    HttpURLConnection connection=(HttpURLConnection)new URL("https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter").openConnection();connection.setRequestMethod("POST");connection.setDoOutput(true);connection.setConnectTimeout(12000);connection.setReadTimeout(30000);connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type","application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8");connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent","oTraiL/0.3.0 (personal India navigator)");
    JSONObject payload;
    try {
      try(OutputStream out=connection.getOutputStream()){out.write(("data="+URLEncoder.encode(query,"UTF-8")).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}
      if(connection.getResponseCode()!=200)throw new IOException("Road service HTTP "+connection.getResponseCode()+" · cache retained");
      ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream();try(InputStream in=connection.getInputStream()){byte[] b=new byte[8192];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){if(out.size()+n>6_000_000)throw new IOException("Road response too large");out.write(b,0,n);}}
      payload=new JSONObject(out.toString("UTF-8"));if(payload.has("remark"))throw new IOException("Road service returned an incomplete area");
    }finally{connection.disconnect();}
    long now=System.currentTimeMillis();cache(lat,lon,payload,now);return parse(payload,lat,lon,bearing,now,false);
  }
  void cache(double lat,double lon,JSONObject payload,long now) {
    ContentValues v=new ContentValues();v.put("key",Math.round(lat*1000)+":"+Math.round(lon*1000));v.put("latitude",lat);v.put("longitude",lon);v.put("fetched_ms",now);v.put("payload",payload.toString());getWritableDatabase().insertWithOnConflict("areas",null,v,SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE);
  }
  static Snapshot parse(JSONObject payload,double lat,double lon,double bearing,long fetched,boolean cached) throws Exception {
    JSONArray elements=payload.getJSONArray("elements");List<JSONObject> roads=new ArrayList<>();JSONObject selected=null;double best=70;
    for(int i=0;i<elements.length();i++){JSONObject e=elements.getJSONObject(i);JSONObject t=e.optJSONObject("tags");JSONArray g=e.optJSONArray("geometry");if(t==null||!t.has("highway")||g==null||g.length()<2)continue;roads.add(e);double d=RoadGeometry.match(g,lat,lon).distance();if(d<best){best=d;selected=e;}}
    if(selected==null)return new Snapshot("",List.of(),fetched,cached,"No mapped road within 70 m of this point");
    String identity=RoadGeometry.identity(selected);List<Landmark> pois=new ArrayList<>();Set<String> seen=new HashSet<>();
    for(int i=0;i<elements.length();i++) {
      JSONObject e=elements.getJSONObject(i),t=e.optJSONObject("tags");if(t==null||t.has("highway"))continue;
      JSONObject point=e.has("lat")?e:e.optJSONObject("center");if(point==null)continue;
      double y=point.getDouble("lat"),x=point.getDouble("lon"),distance=StopDetector.distance(lat,lon,y,x);if(distance>2500)continue;
      if(Double.isFinite(bearing)){double forward=(y-lat)*111320*Math.cos(Math.toRadians(bearing))+(x-lon)*111320*Math.cos(Math.toRadians(lat))*Math.sin(Math.toRadians(bearing));if(forward< -100)continue;}
      double same=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY,other=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      for(JSONObject r:roads) {
        double d=RoadGeometry.match(r.getJSONArray("geometry"),y,x).distance();
        if(RoadGeometry.identity(r).equals(identity))same=Math.min(same,d);
        else if(r.getJSONObject("tags").has("ref")||r.getJSONObject("tags").has("name"))other=Math.min(other,d);
      }
      if(same>100||other+20<same)continue;
      String religion=t.optString("religion"),kind=t.optString("amenity",t.optString("tourism",t.optString("historic","landmark")));
      if(kind.equals("place_of_worship"))kind=religion.isBlank()?"Religious place":religion.equals("hindu")?"Temple":religion.equals("muslim")?"Mosque":religion.equals("christian")?"Church":religion.equals("sikh")?"Gurdwara":religion+" religious place";
      String key=e.optString("type")+"/"+e.optLong("id"),name=t.optString("name",t.optString("name:en",kind));
      if(seen.add(key))pois.add(new Landmark(key,name,kind,y,x,distance));
    }
    pois.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble(Landmark::meters));return new Snapshot(RoadGeometry.label(selected),List.copyOf(pois),fetched,cached,"© OpenStreetMap contributors · roadside proximity, access not verified");
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.app.*;

/** Cache-first UI work is isolated from the GPS writer and navigation engine. */
final class RoadControls implements AutoCloseable {
  private final Activity activity;
  private final ExecutorService worker=Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
  private TextView label;private MapView map;
  private RoadContext.Snapshot current;
  java.util.function.Consumer<DestinationSearch.Result> navigateTo;
  private final List<Marker> markers=new ArrayList<>();
  private long lastUpdate,lastNetwork;private double lastLat=Double.NaN,lastLon;
  private boolean loading,closed,enabled;private long tapTicket;
  RoadControls(Activity a){activity=a;}
  String roadName(){return current==null?"":current.road();}
  void attach(TextView label,MapView map){this.label=label;this.map=map;markers.clear();label.setText(UiConfig.text("road_landmarks_shown_while_on_the_move"));label.setOnClickListener(v->showList());}
  void update(TrailDb.Fix fix,TrailDb.Fix previous,boolean moving,boolean offline,boolean history) {
    if(closed||label==null)return;
    enabled=!history&&moving;
    if(history||!moving){label.setText(history?UiConfig.text("tap_a_road_for_its_cached_name"):UiConfig.text("road_landmarks_shown_while_on_the_move"));hide();return;}
    render();long now=System.currentTimeMillis();
    if(loading||now-lastUpdate<15000 && Double.isFinite(lastLat)&&StopDetector.distance(lastLat,lastLon,fix.lat(),fix.lon())<100)return;
    loading=true;lastUpdate=now;lastLat=fix.lat();lastLon=fix.lon();
    double bearing=Double.NaN;
    if(previous!=null&&StopDetector.distance(previous.lat(),previous.lon(),fix.lat(),fix.lon())>5){bearing=Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2((fix.lon()-previous.lon())*Math.cos(Math.toRadians(fix.lat())),fix.lat()-previous.lat()));}
    final double heading=bearing;
    worker.execute(()->{
      try(RoadContext cache=new RoadContext(activity)) {
        RoadContext.Snapshot saved=cache.cached(fix.lat(),fix.lon(),heading);post(saved);
        if(!offline&&(saved.fetched()==0||now-saved.fetched()>7L*86400000)&&now-lastNetwork>120000) {
          lastNetwork=now;
          try{post(cache.fetch(fix.lat(),fix.lon(),heading));}
          catch(Exception e){activity.runOnUiThread(()->{if(label!=null&&!closed)label.append(UiConfig.text("update_unavailable_cache_kept"));});}
        }
      }catch(Exception e){activity.runOnUiThread(()->{if(label!=null&&!closed)label.setText(UiConfig.text("road_cache_unavailable_tap_road_to_retry"));});}
      finally{activity.runOnUiThread(()->loading=false);}
    });
  }
  private void post(RoadContext.Snapshot snapshot){activity.runOnUiThread(()->{if(closed||activity.isDestroyed())return;current=snapshot;render();});}
  private void render(){
    if(label==null)return;
    if(!enabled){hide();return;}
    if(current==null){label.setText(UiConfig.text("looking_up_road_cache_first"));return;}
    label.setText(current.road().isBlank()?current.note():current.road()+" · "+current.landmarks().size()+UiConfig.text("roadside_landmarks_ahead")+(current.cached()?"cached":"updated"));
    hide();if(map==null)return;
    for(RoadContext.Landmark p:current.landmarks().subList(0,Math.min(40,current.landmarks().size()))) {
      Marker m=new Marker(map);m.setId("roadpoi:"+p.key());m.setPosition(new GeoPoint(p.lat(),p.lon()));m.setTitle(p.name());m.setSnippet(p.kind()+" · "+Math.round(p.meters())+UiConfig.text("m_openstreetmap_contributors"));
      GradientDrawable icon=new GradientDrawable();icon.setShape(GradientDrawable.OVAL);icon.setColor(AppStyle.ORANGE);icon.setStroke(2,AppStyle.INK);icon.setSize(18,18);m.setIcon(icon);m.setAnchor(.5f,.5f);
      m.setOnMarkerClickListener((marker,view)->{if(navigateTo!=null){navigateTo.accept(new DestinationSearch.Result(p.name(),new RoutePlan.Point(p.lat(),p.lon())));return true;}new AppDialogs(activity).setTitle(p.name()).setMessage(p.kind()+"\n"+Math.round(p.meters())+UiConfig.text("m_away_mapped_alongside")+current.road()+UiConfig.text("access_and_opening_hours_are_not_verified")).setPositiveButton(UiConfig.text("close"),null).show();return true;});map.getOverlays().add(m);markers.add(m);
    }
    map.invalidate();
  }
  private void hide(){if(map!=null)map.getOverlays().removeAll(markers);markers.clear();}
  private void showList(){if(current==null||current.road().isBlank()){Toast.makeText(activity,UiConfig.text("tap_a_road_on_the_map_to_identify_it"),Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();return;}String[] names=current.landmarks().stream().map(p->p.name()+" · "+p.kind()+" · "+Math.round(p.meters())+UiConfig.text("m_2")).toArray(String[]::new);new AppDialogs(activity).setTitle(current.road()).setItems(names,(d,index)->{RoadContext.Landmark p=current.landmarks().get(index);if(navigateTo!=null){navigateTo.accept(new DestinationSearch.Result(p.name(),new RoutePlan.Point(p.lat(),p.lon())));return;}if(map!=null){map.getController().setCenter(new GeoPoint(p.lat(),p.lon()));map.getController().setZoom(17.0);}}).setMessage(names.length==0?UiConfig.text("no_mapped_roadside_landmarks_cached_here_coverage_depends_on_ope"):null).setPositiveButton(UiConfig.text("close"),null).show();}
  void tapped(double lat,double lon,boolean offline){
    long ticket=++tapTicket;TextView text=new TextView(activity);text.setPadding(24,16,24,16);text.setText(UiConfig.text("checking_cached_road_names"));
    AlertDialog dialog=new AppDialogs(activity).setTitle(UiConfig.text("road_at_this_point")).setView(text).setPositiveButton(UiConfig.text("close"),null).show();
    worker.execute(()->{
      try(RoadContext cache=new RoadContext(activity)) {
        RoadContext.Snapshot saved=cache.cached(lat,lon,Double.NaN);
        activity.runOnUiThread(()->{if(dialog.isShowing()&&ticket==tapTicket)text.setText(describe(saved,offline));});
        long now=System.currentTimeMillis();
        if(!offline&&now-lastNetwork>5000){lastNetwork=now;RoadContext.Snapshot fresh=cache.fetch(lat,lon,Double.NaN);activity.runOnUiThread(()->{if(dialog.isShowing()&&ticket==tapTicket)text.setText(describe(fresh,false));});}
      }catch(Exception e){activity.runOnUiThread(()->{if(dialog.isShowing())text.append(UiConfig.text("online_update_unavailable_any_cached_name_above_is_retained"));});}
    });
  }
  private static String describe(RoadContext.Snapshot s,boolean offline){return (s.road().isBlank()?s.note():s.road())+"\n"+(s.fetched()>0?(s.cached()?UiConfig.text("cached"):UiConfig.text("updated"))+new java.util.Date(s.fetched()):offline?UiConfig.text("offline_connect_to_fetch_this_area"):UiConfig.text("checking_online_source"))+UiConfig.text("openstreetmap_contributors");}
  public void close(){closed=true;worker.shutdownNow();}
}

package in.otrail;

import org.json.*;

public final class RoadGeometry {
  public record Match(double distance,double along){}
  public static Match match(JSONArray shape,double lat,double lon) throws Exception {
    double best=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY,along=0,total=0,scale=Math.cos(Math.toRadians(lat));
    for(int i=1;i<shape.length();i++) {
      JSONObject a=shape.getJSONObject(i-1),b=shape.getJSONObject(i);
      double ax=(a.getDouble("lon")-lon)*111320*scale,ay=(a.getDouble("lat")-lat)*111320;
      double bx=(b.getDouble("lon")-lon)*111320*scale,by=(b.getDouble("lat")-lat)*111320;
      double dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy),t=len==0?0:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,-(ax*dx+ay*dy)/(len*len)));
      double d=Math.hypot(ax+t*dx,ay+t*dy);if(d<best){best=d;along=total+t*len;}total+=len;
    }
    return new Match(best,along);
  }
  public static String identity(JSONObject road) {
    JSONObject tags=road.optJSONObject("tags");if(tags==null)return "way/"+road.optLong("id");
    String ref=tags.optString("ref").trim(),name=tags.optString("name").trim();
    return !ref.isEmpty()?"ref:"+ref.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9;]","").toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT):!name.isEmpty()?"name:"+name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT):"way/"+road.optLong("id");
  }
  public static String label(JSONObject road) {
    JSONObject t=road.optJSONObject("tags");if(t==null)return "Unnamed road";
    String ref=t.optString("ref"),name=t.optString("name");
    return !ref.isBlank()?ref+(name.isBlank()?"":" · "+name):!name.isBlank()?name:"Unnamed "+t.optString("highway","road").replace('_',' ')+" road";
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import java.util.*;

/** Immutable geometry shared by online and future offline routing providers. */
public final class RoutePlan {
  public record Point(double lat, double lon) {
    public Point {
      if (!Double.isFinite(lat)
          || !Double.isFinite(lon)
          || Math.abs(lat) > 90
          || Math.abs(lon) > 180) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid route coordinate");
    }
  }

  public record Step(double along, String instruction) {}

  public record Match(double along, double distance) {}

  public final List<Point> points;
  public final List<Step> steps;
  public final double distance, duration;
  public final double[] cumulative;

  public RoutePlan(List<Point> points, List<Step> steps, double distance, double duration) {
    if (points.size() < 2
        || !Double.isFinite(distance)
        || !Double.isFinite(duration)
        || distance < 0
        || duration < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid route");
    this.points = List.copyOf(points);
    this.steps = List.copyOf(steps);
    this.distance = distance;
    this.duration = duration;
    cumulative = new double[points.size()];
    for (int i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
      cumulative[i] = cumulative[i - 1] + metres(points.get(i - 1), points.get(i));
    double previous = -1;
    for (Step s : steps) {
      if (!Double.isFinite(s.along) || s.along < previous || s.along < 0 || s.instruction == null)
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid route step");
      previous = s.along;
    }
  }

  public double length() {
    return cumulative[cumulative.length - 1];
  }

  public static double metres(Point a, Point b) {
    return StopDetector.distance(a.lat, a.lon, b.lat, b.lon);
  }

  public Match match(Point p, double minAlong, double maxAlong) {
    double best = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, along = 0;
    double scale = Math.cos(Math.toRadians(p.lat));
    for (int i = 1; i < points.size(); i++) {
      if (cumulative[i] < minAlong || cumulative[i - 1] > maxAlong) continue;
      Point a = points.get(i - 1), b = points.get(i);
      double ax = (a.lon - p.lon) * 111320 * scale,
          ay = (a.lat - p.lat) * 111320,
          bx = (b.lon - p.lon) * 111320 * scale,
          by = (b.lat - p.lat) * 111320;
      double dx = bx - ax,
          dy = by - ay,
          denom = dx * dx + dy * dy,
          t = denom == 0 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(ax * dx + ay * dy) / denom));
      double at = cumulative[i - 1] + t * (cumulative[i] - cumulative[i - 1]);
      if (at < minAlong || at > maxAlong) continue;
      double distance = Math.hypot(ax + t * dx, ay + t * dy);
      if (distance < best) {
        best = distance;
        along = at;
      }
    }
    return new Match(along, best);
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.app.DownloadManager;
import android.content.*;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Environment;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import btools.mapaccess.PhysicalFile;

/** DownloadManager owns network jobs. Validation and replacement never run on the UI thread. */
public final class RoutingPacks {
  public record State(String note,long bytes,long total,boolean busy,boolean ready) {}
  private static final ExecutorService worker=Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
  private static final Set<String> installing=ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
  private final Context c;
  private final SharedPreferences prefs;
  private final DownloadManager dm;
  public RoutingPacks(Context c) {
    this.c=c.getApplicationContext();prefs=c.getSharedPreferences("routing-packs",0);
    dm=(DownloadManager)c.getSystemService(Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE);
  }
  public static List<String> indiaTiles() {
    List<String> names=new ArrayList<>();
    for(int lat=5;lat<=35;lat+=5) for(int lon=65;lon<=95;lon+=5)
      if(!(lat>=30&&lon>=85) && !(lat<=20&&lon==65) && !(lat<=15&&lon>=85)) names.add("E"+lon+"_N"+lat);
    return names;
  }
  File target(String key) {
    return new File(OfflineRouting.root(c),key.equals("valhalla")?"valhalla/india.tar":"segments4/"+key+".rd5");
  }
  public void download(String key,String url,String sha) throws Exception {
    if(!key.equals("valhalla") && !indiaTiles().contains(key))throw new IOException("Choose an India tile");
    Uri uri=Uri.parse(url.trim());
    if(!"https".equals(uri.getScheme()) || uri.getHost()==null || uri.getUserInfo()!=null)throw new IOException("Use an HTTPS graph-pack URL");
    if(!sha.isEmpty()&&!sha.matches("[a-fA-F0-9]{64}"))throw new IOException("SHA-256 must have 64 hexadecimal characters");
    if(prefs.getLong(key+".job",-1)!=-1 || installing.contains(key))throw new IOException("Already queued or validating");
    String filename=key.equals("valhalla")?"india-valhalla.tar":key+".rd5";
    DownloadManager.Request r=new DownloadManager.Request(uri).setTitle("oTraiL · "+filename)
      .setDescription("Offline routing graph · Wi-Fi or cellular")
      .setAllowedOverMetered(true).setAllowedOverRoaming(false)
      .setNotificationVisibility(DownloadManager.Request.VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_COMPLETED)
      .setDestinationInExternalPublicDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS,"oTraiL/"+System.currentTimeMillis()+"-"+filename);
    long id=dm.enqueue(r);
    prefs.edit().putLong(key+".job",id).putString(key+".sha",sha.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)).putString(key+".note","Queued").apply();
    log(key,"QUEUED","Phone download requested");
  }
  public void cancel(String key) {
    long job=prefs.getLong(key+".job",-1);
    if(job!=-1)dm.remove(job);
    prefs.edit().remove(key+".job").putString(key+".note","Cancelled · previous graph retained").apply();
  }
  public State state(String key) {
    File file=target(key);long id=prefs.getLong(key+".job",-1);
    if(installing.contains(key))return new State("Validating graph · previous version retained until ready",0,0,true,file.isFile());
    if(id==-1)return new State(prefs.getString(key+".note",file.isFile()?"Ready offline":"Not downloaded"),file.length(),file.length(),false,file.isFile());
    try(Cursor q=dm.query(new DownloadManager.Query().setFilterById(id))) {
      if(!q.moveToFirst()) { prefs.edit().remove(key+".job").putString(key+".note","Download removed; retry").apply();return state(key); }
      int status=q.getInt(q.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_STATUS));
      long bytes=q.getLong(q.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_BYTES_DOWNLOADED_SO_FAR)),total=q.getLong(q.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_TOTAL_SIZE_BYTES));
      if(status==DownloadManager.STATUS_SUCCESSFUL) {
        if(installing.add(key)) worker.execute(()->{
          try(InputStream in=new android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(dm.openDownloadedFile(id))) {
            install(key,in,prefs.getString(key+".sha",""));
            prefs.edit().remove(key+".job").putString(key+".note","Ready offline").apply();
          }catch(Exception e){prefs.edit().remove(key+".job").putString(key+".note","Validation failed: "+e.getMessage()).apply();log(key,"FAILED",e.toString());}
          finally{installing.remove(key);}
        });
        return new State("Validating downloaded graph",bytes,total,true,file.isFile());
      }
      if(status==DownloadManager.STATUS_FAILED) {
        prefs.edit().remove(key+".job").putString(key+".note","Failed · Android reason "+q.getInt(q.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DownloadManager.COLUMN_REASON))).apply();return state(key);
      }
      String note=status==DownloadManager.STATUS_RUNNING?"Downloading":status==DownloadManager.STATUS_PENDING?"Queued by Android":"Paused · network/server retry";
      return new State(note,bytes,total,true,file.isFile());
    }
  }
  public void complete() { for(String key:indiaTiles())state(key);state("valhalla"); }
  public void importFile(String key,Uri uri) throws Exception {
    if(!key.equals("valhalla") && !indiaTiles().contains(key)) throw new IOException("Unrecognized India tile name");
    if(!installing.add(key))throw new IOException("Validation already in progress");
    try(InputStream in=c.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)){install(key,in,"");prefs.edit().putString(key+".note","Ready offline · imported").apply();}
    finally{installing.remove(key);}
  }
  private void install(String key,InputStream in,String sha) throws Exception {
    File file=target(key);file.getParentFile().mkdirs();File part=new File(file.getParentFile(),file.getName()+".candidate");
    try {
      MessageDigest digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
      try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(part)) {
        byte[] b=new byte[65536];int n;
        while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){out.write(b,0,n);digest.update(b,0,n);}out.getFD().sync();
      }
      if(part.length()<512)throw new IOException("Graph file is empty or too small");
      StringBuilder sum=new StringBuilder();for(byte b:digest.digest())sum.append(String.format(Locale.ROOT,"%02x",b&255));
      if(!sha.isEmpty()&&!sha.equals(sum.toString()))throw new IOException("Graph checksum mismatch");
      if(key.equals("valhalla"))validateTar(part);
      else PhysicalFile.checkFileIntegrity(part);
      // Routes also synchronize on this lock so a native mmap cannot race graph replacement.
      synchronized(OfflineRouting.class) { Files.move(part.toPath(),file.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING); }
      log(key,"SUCCESS","Validated offline routing graph · "+file.length()+" bytes · SHA-256 "+sum);
    }finally{part.delete();}
  }
  static void validateTar(File file) throws Exception {
    boolean graph=false;long pos=0;
    try(RandomAccessFile in=new RandomAccessFile(file,"r")) {
      byte[] header=new byte[512];
      while(pos+512<=in.length()) {
        in.seek(pos);in.readFully(header);boolean empty=true;for(byte b:header)if(b!=0){empty=false;break;}if(empty)break;
        long stored=octal(header,148,8),sum=0;
        for(int i=0;i<512;i++)sum+=(i>=148&&i<156)?32:(header[i]&255);
        if(stored!=sum)throw new IOException("Invalid tar header checksum");
        String name=new String(header,0,100,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8).split("\u0000",2)[0];
        long length=octal(header,124,12);
        if(name.endsWith(".gph")&&length>0)graph=true;
        if(length<0||length>in.length()-pos-512)throw new IOException("Truncated graph archive");
        pos+=512+((length+511)/512)*512;
      }
    }
    if(!graph)throw new IOException("Expected an uncompressed Valhalla .tar containing .gph tiles");
  }
  private static long octal(byte[] b,int start,int length)throws IOException {
    String s=new String(b,start,length,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII).replace("\u0000","").trim();
    try{return s.isEmpty()?0:Long.parseLong(s,8);}catch(NumberFormatException e){throw new IOException("Invalid tar size",e);}
  }
  private void log(String key,String status,String detail){try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(c)){db.log("Routing · "+key,status,detail);}}
}

package in.otrail;

/** Anchored dwell detection. Raw fixes are kept separately; uncertain movement is provisional. */
public final class StopDetector {
  public static final long MIN_STOP_MS=120_000, MAX_GAP_MS=60_000;
  public static final double RADIUS_METERS=35;
  private long start,last,lastInput,stableSince,candidateStart,candidateDeparture,candidateLast;
  private double latitude,longitude,candidateLat,candidateLon,firstLat,firstLon,path;
  private int stableCount,candidateCount,preciseCount;
  private boolean stopped,uncertain,reliable;
  public long persistedStopId=-1;
  public record Event(boolean opened,boolean closed,long arrival,long departure,double lat,double lon) {}

  public Event accept(long time,double lat,double lon,float accuracy,float speed) {
    if(time<=lastInput)return null;
    lastInput=time;reliable=false;
    if(!Double.isFinite(lat)||!Double.isFinite(lon)||!Float.isFinite(accuracy)||accuracy>50||accuracy<0) {
      uncertain=true;stableCount=0;clearDeparture();
      if(!stopped){start=last=0;}
      return null; // Loss of signal is not evidence of departure.
    }
    if(start==0){seed(time,lat,lon);return null;}
    double displacement=distance(latitude,longitude,lat,lon);
    if(stopped) {
      double tolerance=RADIUS_METERS+Math.min(50,accuracy*2);
      if(displacement<=tolerance) {
        clearDeparture();
        reliable=accuracy<=20&&displacement<=RADIUS_METERS+accuracy&&speed<=1.5f;
        uncertain=!reliable;
        if(reliable){if(time-last>MAX_GAP_MS)stableCount=0;last=time;stable(time);uncertain=!stableSignal();}else stableCount=0;
        return null;
      }
      uncertain=true;stableCount=0;
      if(candidateStart==0||time-candidateLast>MAX_GAP_MS)beginDeparture(time,lat,lon);
      else {
        double step=distance(candidateLat,candidateLon,lat,lon);
        double seconds=(time-candidateLast)/1000.0;
        double positionSpeed=step/Math.max(1,seconds);
        // Teleports and contradictory speed/position estimates restart the evidence window.
        if(positionSpeed>60||positionSpeed>8&&speed<1.5f)beginDeparture(time,lat,lon);
        else {path+=step;candidateLat=lat;candidateLon=lon;candidateLast=time;candidateCount++;}
      }
      if(accuracy<=10&&speed>1.5f)preciseCount++;
      double net=distance(firstLat,firstLon,lat,lon);
      long elapsed=time-candidateStart;
      boolean coherent=net>=60&&net/Math.max(1,path)>=.65;
      boolean confirmed=coherent&&((elapsed>=20_000&&preciseCount>=4)
          ||(elapsed>=90_000&&candidateCount>=12&&net>=200));
      if(!confirmed)return null;
      Event event=new Event(false,true,start,candidateDeparture,latitude,longitude);
      seed(time,lat,lon);stopped=false;uncertain=false;clearDeparture();
      return event;
    }
    // Ignore a claimed speed spike at an unchanged coordinate, but do not join uncertain gaps.
    boolean moving=displacement>RADIUS_METERS||speed>1.5f&&displacement>Math.max(5,accuracy);
    if(moving||time-last>MAX_GAP_MS){seed(time,lat,lon);return null;}
    last=time;reliable=accuracy<=20;uncertain=!reliable;
    if(reliable)stable(time);else stableCount=0;
    if(time-start>MIN_STOP_MS&&reliable){stopped=true;return new Event(true,false,start,time,latitude,longitude);}
    return null;
  }
  private void stable(long time){if(stableCount++==0)stableSince=time;}
  private void beginDeparture(long time,double lat,double lon){candidateStart=candidateLast=time;candidateDeparture=last;firstLat=candidateLat=lat;firstLon=candidateLon=lon;candidateCount=1;preciseCount=0;path=0;}
  private void clearDeparture(){candidateStart=candidateLast=0;candidateCount=preciseCount=0;path=0;}
  /** Replay/restore uses observed timestamps; a stable return confirms continuity before DB repair. */
  public void restore(long arrival,long observed,double lat,double lon,boolean open){reset();start=arrival;last=lastInput=observed;latitude=lat;longitude=lon;stopped=open;uncertain=true;}
  public boolean isStopped(){return stopped;}
  public boolean isUncertain(){return uncertain;}
  public boolean hasReliableObservation(){return reliable;}
  public boolean stableSignal(){return reliable&&stableCount>=3&&last-stableSince>=10_000;}
  public long observationTime(){return last;}
  public long arrival(){return start;}
  public double latitude(){return latitude;}
  public double longitude(){return longitude;}
  public void reset(){start=last=lastInput=stableSince=0;stopped=uncertain=reliable=false;persistedStopId=-1;stableCount=0;clearDeparture();}
  private void seed(long time,double lat,double lon){start=last=time;latitude=lat;longitude=lon;stableCount=0;}
  public static double distance(double a,double b,double c,double d){double p=Math.toRadians(c-a),q=Math.toRadians(d-b);double h=Math.sin(p/2)*Math.sin(p/2)+Math.cos(Math.toRadians(a))*Math.cos(Math.toRadians(c))*Math.sin(q/2)*Math.sin(q/2);return 6371000*2*Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(h),Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-h)));}
}

package in.otrail;

import android.content.Context;
import android.location.Address;
import android.location.Geocoder;
import android.os.Build;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

/** A separate, throttled queue: address services never run on the GPS writer or UI thread. */
public final class StopGeocoder implements AutoCloseable {
  interface Lookup {
    Address find(double latitude, double longitude) throws Exception;
  }

  private static StopGeocoder instance;
  private final Context app;
  private final Lookup lookup;
  private final long delayMs;
  private final ScheduledExecutorService worker = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
  private boolean running, requested, closed;
  // A stalled legacy binder call cannot create an unbounded number of replacement threads.
  private static final ExecutorService LEGACY =
      new ThreadPoolExecutor(
          0,
          1,
          30,
          TimeUnit.SECONDS,
          new SynchronousQueue<>(),
          r -> {
            Thread t = new Thread(r, "legacy-geocoder");
            t.setDaemon(true);
            return t;
          });

  StopGeocoder(Context context, Lookup lookup) {
    this(context, lookup, 1000);
  }

  StopGeocoder(Context context, Lookup lookup, long delayMs) {
    this.app = context.getApplicationContext();
    this.lookup = lookup;
    this.delayMs = delayMs;
  }

  private static synchronized StopGeocoder get(Context c) {
    if (instance == null) {
      Context app = c.getApplicationContext();
      instance = new StopGeocoder(app, (lat, lon) -> lookupAddress(app, lat, lon));
    }
    return instance;
  }

  public static void enqueue(Context c, long stopId) {
    if (stopId > 0) get(c).request();
  }

  public static void backfill(Context c) {
    get(c).request();
  }

  synchronized void request() {
    if (closed) return;
    requested = true;
    if (!running) {
      running = true;
      worker.execute(this::next);
    }
  }

  private void next() {
    synchronized (this) {
      if (closed) return;
      requested = false;
    }
    boolean found = false;
    try (TrailDb db = new TrailDb(app)) {
      List<Long> ids = db.pendingStopIds(1);
      if (!ids.isEmpty()) {
        found = true;
        resolve(db, ids.get(0));
      }
    } catch (Exception ignored) {
      /* Database/lookup failures must not stop GPS recording. */
    }
    synchronized (this) {
      if (closed) return;
      if (found || requested) worker.schedule(this::next, delayMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
      else running = false;
    }
  }

  private void resolve(TrailDb db, long id) {
    TrailDb.Stop stop = db.stopById(id);
    if (stop == null || "RESOLVED".equals(stop.geocodeStatus())) return;
    if ("FAILED".equals(stop.geocodeStatus())
        && System.currentTimeMillis() - stop.geocodeAttempt() < TrailDb.GEOCODE_RETRY_MS) return;
    try {
      Address a = lookup.find(stop.lat(), stop.lon());
      if (a == null) {
        db.markGeocodeFailed(id);
        return;
      }
      String locality = first(a.getLocality(), a.getSubLocality()),
          district = first(a.getSubAdminArea()),
          state = first(a.getAdminArea()),
          country = first(a.getCountryName());
      String
          place = first(a.getSubLocality(), locality, a.getFeatureName(), district, state, country),
          road = first(a.getThoroughfare()),
          pin = first(a.getPostalCode());
      if (first(place, locality, district, state, country, road, pin) == null) {
        db.markGeocodeFailed(id);
        return;
      }
      db.saveStopAddress(id, place, locality, district, state, country, pin, road);
    } catch (Exception e) {
      db.markGeocodeFailed(id);
    }
  }

  static Address lookupAddress(Context c, double lat, double lon) throws Exception {
    if (!Geocoder.isPresent()) return null;
    Geocoder g = new Geocoder(c, Locale.getDefault());
    List<Address> addresses;
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
      CountDownLatch done = new CountDownLatch(1);
      AtomicReference<List<Address>> result = new AtomicReference<>();
      g.getFromLocation(
          lat,
          lon,
          1,
          new Geocoder.GeocodeListener() {
            @Override
            public void onGeocode(List<Address> a) {
              result.set(a);
              done.countDown();
            }

            @Override
            public void onError(String message) {
              done.countDown();
            }
          });
      if (!done.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) return null;
      addresses = result.get();
    } else {
      Future<List<Address>> request = LEGACY.submit(() -> legacyLookup(g, lat, lon));
      try {
        addresses = request.get(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
      } finally {
        request.cancel(true);
      }
    }
    return addresses == null || addresses.isEmpty() ? null : addresses.get(0);
  }

  @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
  private static List<Address> legacyLookup(Geocoder g, double lat, double lon) throws Exception {
    return g.getFromLocation(lat, lon, 1);
  }

  private static String first(String... values) {
    for (String s : values) if (s != null && !s.isBlank()) return s;
    return null;
  }

  @Override
  public synchronized void close() {
    closed = true;
    worker.shutdownNow();
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.graphics.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.osmdroid.util.GeoPoint;
import org.osmdroid.views.MapView;
import org.osmdroid.views.overlay.Overlay;

/** Display-only long-stop annotations; collision emphasis uses projected city-label bounds. */
final class StopLabelsOverlay extends Overlay {
  private List<TrailDb.Stop> stops=List.of();
  private List<CityPlaces.Place> cities=List.of();
  private DriveMetrics.Result metrics;
  private boolean liveBubble;
  void liveBubble(boolean visible){liveBubble=visible;}
  void update(List<TrailDb.Stop> stops,DriveMetrics.Result metrics,List<CityPlaces.Place> cities){this.stops=stops;this.metrics=metrics;this.cities=cities;}
  static boolean longStop(TrailDb.Stop stop){return stop.observed()-stop.arrival()>=UiConfig.LONG_STOP_MINUTES*60_000L;}
  @Override public void draw(Canvas canvas,MapView map,boolean shadow){
    if(shadow||map.getZoomLevelDouble()<UiConfig.LONG_STOP_LABEL_MIN_ZOOM
        ||!org.osmdroid.views.overlay.infowindow.InfoWindow.getOpenedInfoWindowsOn(map).isEmpty())return;
    float density=map.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density,sp=map.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().scaledDensity;
    Paint text=new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);text.setTextSize(UiConfig.LONG_STOP_LABEL_SIZE_SP*sp);
    text.setTypeface(Typeface.create(UiConfig.BODY_FONT,Typeface.ITALIC));
    List<RectF> cityBounds=new ArrayList<>();Point point=new Point();
    Paint city=new Paint(text);city.setTextSize(OfflineMapTheme.citySize(25,(int)map.getZoomLevelDouble())*density);
    for(CityPlaces.Place place:cities){
      map.getProjection().toPixels(new GeoPoint(place.lat(),place.lon()),point);
      float half=city.measureText(place.name())/2+5*density;
      cityBounds.add(new RectF(point.x-half,point.y-city.getTextSize(),point.x+half,point.y+city.getTextSize()));
    }
    Paint background=new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);background.setColor(UiConfig.LONG_STOP_LABEL_BACKGROUND);
    Paint border=new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);border.setColor(UiConfig.LONG_STOP_COLOR);border.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);border.setStrokeWidth(density);
    List<RectF> occupied=new ArrayList<>();
    int shown=0;
    for(int i=stops.size()-1;i>=0&&shown<UiConfig.LONG_STOP_LABEL_LIMIT;i--){
      TrailDb.Stop stop=stops.get(i);if(liveBubble&&i==stops.size()-1)continue;if(!longStop(stop))continue;
      map.getProjection().toPixels(new GeoPoint(stop.lat(),stop.lon()),point);
      if(point.x<0||point.y<0||point.x>map.getWidth()||point.y>map.getHeight())continue;
      String name=stop.locality()!=null?stop.locality():stop.placeName()!=null?stop.placeName():"Stop #"+stop.id();
      if(name.length()>26)name=name.substring(0,25)+"…";
      long minutes=(stop.observed()-stop.arrival())/60000;
      DriveMetrics.Leg leg=metrics==null?null:metrics.stops().get(stop.id());
      String detail=String.format(Locale.US,"%dh %02dm%s",minutes/60,minutes%60,leg==null?"":String.format(Locale.US," · %.2f km",leg.meters()/1000));
      text.setTypeface(Typeface.create(UiConfig.BODY_FONT,Typeface.ITALIC));
      float width=Math.max(text.measureText(name),text.measureText(detail))+14*density,height=text.getTextSize()*2.5f+8*density;
      float left=Math.max(2*density,Math.min(map.getWidth()-width-2*density,point.x-width/2));
      float bottom=point.y-15*density;
      RectF bounds=new RectF(left,bottom-height,left+width,bottom);
      boolean overlap=false;
      for(RectF cityBox:cityBounds)if(RectF.intersects(bounds,cityBox)){
        overlap=true;bounds.offset(0,Math.min(0,cityBox.top-5*density-bounds.bottom));break;
      }
      if(bounds.top<0)bounds.offset(0,-bounds.top+2*density);
      if(overlap)text.setTypeface(Typeface.create(UiConfig.BODY_FONT,Typeface.BOLD_ITALIC));
      // Automatic annotations must never pile up like open popup windows.
      boolean crowded=false;
      RectF padded=new RectF(bounds);padded.inset(-6*density,-6*density);
      for(RectF used:occupied)if(RectF.intersects(padded,used)){crowded=true;break;}
      if(crowded)continue;
      occupied.add(padded);
      canvas.drawRoundRect(bounds,6*density,6*density,background);canvas.drawRoundRect(bounds,6*density,6*density,border);
      text.setColor(UiConfig.LONG_STOP_COLOR);
      canvas.drawText(name,bounds.left+7*density,bounds.top+text.getTextSize()+3*density,text);
      canvas.drawText(detail,bounds.left+7*density,bounds.top+text.getTextSize()*2.25f+3*density,text);shown++;
    }
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.*;
import android.content.*;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.location.*;
import android.os.*;

public final class TrackingService extends Service implements LocationListener {
  public static final long FIX_INTERVAL_MS = 13000;
  private LocationManager manager;
  private TrailDb db;
  private long trip = -1;
  private final StopDetector detector = new StopDetector();
  private long lastElapsed;
  private final java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService gpsWriter =
      java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
  private final java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService backupWorker =
      java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();

  @Override
  public void onCreate() {
    super.onCreate();
    db = new TrailDb(this);
    manager = (LocationManager) getSystemService(LOCATION_SERVICE);
    ((NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE))
        .createNotificationChannel(
            new NotificationChannel(
                "tracking", "GPS trail recording", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));
  }

  @Override
  public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
    if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)
        != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
      stopSelf();
      return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }
    PendingIntent open =
        PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            0,
            new Intent(this, MainActivity.class),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE | PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
    Notification n =
        new Notification.Builder(this, "tracking")
            .setContentTitle("oTraiL · always recording")
            .setContentText("High-accuracy GPS every 13 seconds · recording continues when the app is closed")
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_mylocation)
            .setContentIntent(open)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .build();
    startForeground(10, n);
    if (trip == -1) {
      trip = db.begin();
      StopGeocoder.backfill(this);
      backupWorker.scheduleWithFixedDelay(() -> {
        try { db.driveMetrics(); } catch (Exception e) { db.log("Drive metrics", "ERROR", e.toString()); }
      }, 10, 60, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS);
      backupWorker.scheduleWithFixedDelay(
          () -> StopGeocoder.backfill(this), 1, 1, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.HOURS);
      backupWorker.scheduleWithFixedDelay(
          () -> {
            try {
              new TrailBackup(this).save(db, false);
            } catch (Exception e) {
              db.log("Trail backup", "FAILED", e.toString());
            }
          },
          30,
          60,
          java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS);
      db.restoreDetector(trip, detector);
      try {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) {
          LocationRequest request = new LocationRequest.Builder(FIX_INTERVAL_MS)
              .setQuality(LocationRequest.QUALITY_HIGH_ACCURACY)
              .setMinUpdateIntervalMillis(FIX_INTERVAL_MS)
              .setMaxUpdateDelayMillis(0)
              .build();
          manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, request,
              getMainExecutor(), this);
        } else {
          manager.requestLocationUpdates(
              LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, FIX_INTERVAL_MS, 0, this, Looper.getMainLooper());
        }
      } catch (SecurityException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
        db.log("GPS", "ERROR", e.toString());
        db.finish(trip);
        stopSelf();
      }
    }
    return START_STICKY;
  }

  @Override
  public void onLocationChanged(Location l) {
    Location fix = new Location(l);
    try {
      gpsWriter.execute(() -> storeFix(fix));
    } catch (java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException ignored) {
    }
  }

  private void storeFix(Location l) {
    if (trip == -1
        || !l.hasAccuracy()
        || l.getAccuracy() > 100
        || l.getElapsedRealtimeNanos() <= lastElapsed
        || SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() - l.getElapsedRealtimeNanos() > 30_000_000_000L)
      return;
    lastElapsed = l.getElapsedRealtimeNanos();
    long active = db.activeTrip();
    if (active != trip) {
      trip = active == -1 ? db.begin() : active;
      detector.reset();
      db.restoreDetector(trip, detector);
    }
    long newStopId = db.record(trip, l, detector);
    try {
      if(!detector.isUncertain())NavigationManager.get(this).update(l);
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
      db.log("Navigation", "ERROR", e.toString());
    }
    if (newStopId > 0) StopGeocoder.enqueue(this, newStopId);
  }

  @Override
  public void onProviderDisabled(String p) {
    db.log("GPS", "UNAVAILABLE", "GPS disabled; no stops inferred without fixes.");
  }

  @Override
  public void onDestroy() {
    manager.removeUpdates(this);
    gpsWriter.execute(
        () -> {
          backupWorker.execute(() -> db.close());
          backupWorker.shutdown();
        });
    gpsWriter.shutdown();
    super.onDestroy();
  }

  @Override
  public IBinder onBind(Intent i) {
    return null;
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.*;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;

/** Shared startup path for UI, boot and application replacement. */
public final class TrackingStartup {
    private TrackingStartup() {}
    public static boolean hasLocation(Context c) { return c.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)==PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED; }
    public static boolean rebootReady(Context c) { return hasLocation(c)&&c.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)==PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED; }
    public static boolean start(Context c, boolean fromBackground) {
        if (!hasLocation(c) || fromBackground&&!rebootReady(c)) return false;
        try { c.startForegroundService(new Intent(c,TrackingService.class)); return true; }
        catch (IllegalStateException | SecurityException e) { try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(c)){db.log("Always-on tracker","START BLOCKED",e.toString());}return false; }
    }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.content.*;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.provider.DocumentsContract;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

/** User-selected SAF documents work with local storage and Google Drive's document provider. */
public final class TrailBackup {
    private final Context c;private final SharedPreferences prefs;
    public static final long INTERVAL_MS=15*60*1000;
    private static final Object LOCK=new Object();
    public TrailBackup(Context c){this.c=c.getApplicationContext();prefs=c.getSharedPreferences("trail_backup",0);}
    public void configure(Uri uri,int flags){
        c.getContentResolver().takePersistableUriPermission(uri,flags&(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION|Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION));
        prefs.edit().putString("document",uri.toString()).putLong("last_success",0).putString("status","Backup location configured").apply();
    }
    public boolean configured(){return prefs.contains("document");}
    public String status(){long time=prefs.getLong("last_success",0);return prefs.getString("status","Choose a backup file in Google Drive or a persistent phone folder.")+(time==0?"":"\nLast successful write: "+new java.util.Date(time))+"\nAutomatic backup: every 15 minutes while tracking. Backup now saves immediately. A Drive write may sync later when connectivity returns.";}
    public void save(TrailDb db,boolean force)throws Exception{
        synchronized(LOCK){if(!configured()||!force&&System.currentTimeMillis()-prefs.getLong("last_success",0)<INTERVAL_MS)return;
            Uri uri=Uri.parse(prefs.getString("document",""));
            // Keep a complete local candidate before touching a remote document.
            File candidate=new File(c.getCacheDir(),"trail-backup-candidate.json");
            try{try(Writer w=new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(new FileOutputStream(candidate),StandardCharsets.UTF_8),65536)){db.writeBackup(w);}
                try(InputStream in=new FileInputStream(candidate);OutputStream out=c.getContentResolver().openOutputStream(uri,"wt")){if(out==null)throw new IOException("Backup provider did not open the file");copy(in,out);}
                prefs.edit().putLong("last_success",System.currentTimeMillis()).putString("status","Trail backup saved to selected document").apply();
            }catch(Exception e){prefs.edit().putString("status","Backup needs attention: "+e.getMessage()).apply();throw e;}finally{candidate.delete();}
        }
    }
    public void restore(TrailDb db,Uri uri)throws Exception{
        synchronized(LOCK){try(InputStream in=c.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)){if(in==null)throw new IOException("Cannot open backup");db.restoreBackup(new InputStreamReader(in,StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}db.log("Trail backup","RESTORED","Normalized trail snapshot restored from user-selected document");}
    }
    static void copy(InputStream in,OutputStream out)throws IOException{byte[] b=new byte[65536];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1)out.write(b,0,n);}
}
