package in.otrail;

import android.content.*;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.*;
import android.location.Location;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.json.*;

public final class TrailDb implements AutoCloseable {
  private final Context context;
  private static final Map<String,Shared> CONNECTIONS=new HashMap<>();
  private final String databasePath;
  private final Shared shared;
  private boolean closed;

  /** One SQLite pool per database file, shared by GPS, UI, geocoder and backup workers. */
  private static final class Shared {
    final SQLiteOpenHelper helper;
    int users;
    Shared(Context context,TrailDb schema) {
      helper=new SQLiteOpenHelper(context,"trails.db",null,4) {
        @Override public void onConfigure(SQLiteDatabase db){schema.onConfigure(db);}
        @Override public void onCreate(SQLiteDatabase db){schema.onCreate(db);}
        @Override public void onUpgrade(SQLiteDatabase db,int oldVersion,int newVersion){schema.onUpgrade(db,oldVersion,newVersion);}
      };
      helper.setWriteAheadLoggingEnabled(true);
    }
  }

  public TrailDb(Context c) {
    context=c.getApplicationContext();
    databasePath=context.getDatabasePath("trails.db").getAbsolutePath();
    synchronized(CONNECTIONS) {
      Shared existing=CONNECTIONS.get(databasePath);
      if(existing==null){existing=new Shared(context,this);CONNECTIONS.put(databasePath,existing);}
      shared=existing;
      shared.users++;
    }
  }
  public synchronized SQLiteDatabase getReadableDatabase() {
    if(closed)throw new IllegalStateException("Trail database handle is closed");
    return shared.helper.getReadableDatabase();
  }
  public synchronized SQLiteDatabase getWritableDatabase() {
    if(closed)throw new IllegalStateException("Trail database handle is closed");
    return shared.helper.getWritableDatabase();
  }
  @Override public synchronized void close() {
    if(closed)return;
    closed=true;
    synchronized(CONNECTIONS) {
      if(--shared.users==0){shared.helper.close();CONNECTIONS.remove(databasePath);}
    }
  }

  public void onConfigure(SQLiteDatabase db) {
    db.setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(true);
  }

  public void onCreate(SQLiteDatabase d) {
    d.execSQL(
        "CREATE TABLE trips(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, started_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, ended_ms"
            + " INTEGER)");
    d.execSQL(
        "CREATE TABLE fixes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, trip_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trips(id),"
            + " time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, latitude REAL NOT NULL, longitude REAL NOT NULL,"
            + " accuracy_m REAL NOT NULL, speed_mps REAL NOT NULL, altitude_m REAL, bearing_deg"
            + " REAL, source TEXT NOT NULL)");
    d.execSQL("CREATE INDEX fixes_trip_time ON fixes(trip_id,time_ms)");
    d.execSQL(
        "CREATE TABLE stops(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, trip_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trips(id),"
            + " arrival_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, departure_ms INTEGER, observed_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,"
            + " latitude REAL NOT NULL, longitude REAL NOT NULL, place_name TEXT, locality TEXT,"
            + " district TEXT, state TEXT, country TEXT, postal_code TEXT, road TEXT,"
            + " geocode_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', geocode_attempt_ms INTEGER NOT NULL"
            + " DEFAULT 0)");
    createGeocodeIndex(d);
    d.execSQL(
        "CREATE TABLE sync_logs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT"
            + " NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL)");
    HistoricPlaces.createSchema(d);
    createMetrics(d);
    PhotoIndex.schema(d);
  }

  private static final String[] ADDRESS_FIELDS = {
    "place_name", "locality", "district", "state", "country", "postal_code", "road"
  };

  private static void createGeocodeIndex(SQLiteDatabase d) {
    d.execSQL("CREATE INDEX stops_geocode_queue ON stops(geocode_status,geocode_attempt_ms)");
  }

  public void onUpgrade(SQLiteDatabase d, int oldVersion, int newVersion) {
    if (oldVersion < 2) {
      long trips = tableCount(d, "trips"),
          fixes = tableCount(d, "fixes"),
          stops = tableCount(d, "stops");
      for (String field : ADDRESS_FIELDS)
        d.execSQL("ALTER TABLE stops ADD COLUMN " + field + " TEXT");
      d.execSQL("ALTER TABLE stops ADD COLUMN geocode_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'");
      d.execSQL("ALTER TABLE stops ADD COLUMN geocode_attempt_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0");
      createGeocodeIndex(d);
      HistoricPlaces.createSchema(d);
      if (tableCount(d, "trips") != trips
          || tableCount(d, "fixes") != fixes
          || tableCount(d, "stops") != stops)
        throw new IllegalStateException("Migration changed journal counts");
      ContentValues audit = new ContentValues();
      audit.put("time_ms", System.currentTimeMillis());
      audit.put("provider", "Database migration");
      audit.put("status", "SUCCESS");
      audit.put(
          "detail",
          "v1 → v2; preserved "
              + trips
              + " trips, "
              + fixes
              + " fixes, "
              + stops
              + " stops; added address fields and display caches");
      d.insertOrThrow("sync_logs", null, audit);
    }
    if (oldVersion < 3) createMetrics(d);
    if (oldVersion < 4) PhotoIndex.schema(d);
  }

  private static void createMetrics(SQLiteDatabase d) {
    d.execSQL("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stop_drive_metrics(stop_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES stops(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,start_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,end_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,distance_m REAL NOT NULL,observed_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,missing_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,average_kmh REAL NOT NULL)");
  }
  private long metricsSignature=Long.MIN_VALUE;
  private DriveMetrics.Result metricsCache;
  public synchronized DriveMetrics.Result driveMetrics() {
    Fix latest=latestFix();List<Stop> stops=stops(-1);
    long signature=latest==null?0:latest.id();
    for(Stop s:stops)signature=31*signature+Objects.hash(s.id(),s.arrival(),s.departure(),s.observed());
    if(metricsCache!=null&&signature==metricsSignature)return metricsCache;
    List<Fix> fixes=fixes(-1);
    List<DriveMetrics.Point> points=new ArrayList<>();for(Fix f:fixes)points.add(new DriveMetrics.Point(f.time(),f.lat(),f.lon(),f.accuracy(),f.speed()));
    List<DriveMetrics.Stop> dwell=new ArrayList<>();for(Stop s:stops)dwell.add(new DriveMetrics.Stop(s.id(),s.arrival(),s.departure(),s.observed()));
    DriveMetrics.Result result=DriveMetrics.calculate(points,dwell);
    SQLiteDatabase d=getWritableDatabase();d.beginTransaction();
    try {
      for(DriveMetrics.Leg leg:result.stops().values()) {
        ContentValues v=new ContentValues();v.put("stop_id",leg.stopId());v.put("start_ms",leg.start());v.put("end_ms",leg.end());v.put("distance_m",leg.meters());v.put("observed_ms",leg.observedMs());v.put("missing_ms",leg.missingMs());v.put("average_kmh",leg.averageKmh());
        d.insertWithOnConflict("stop_drive_metrics",null,v,SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE);
      }
      d.setTransactionSuccessful();
    }finally{d.endTransaction();}
    metricsSignature=signature;metricsCache=result;return result;
  }

  private static long tableCount(SQLiteDatabase d, String table) {
    try (Cursor c = d.rawQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM " + table, null)) {
      c.moveToFirst();
      return c.getLong(0);
    }
  }

  public synchronized long activeTrip() {
    try (Cursor c =
        getReadableDatabase()
            .rawQuery(
                "SELECT id FROM trips WHERE ended_ms IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", null)) {
      return c.moveToFirst() ? c.getLong(0) : -1;
    }
  }

  public synchronized long begin() {
    long id = activeTrip();
    if (id != -1) return id;
    ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
    v.put("started_ms", System.currentTimeMillis());
    return getWritableDatabase().insertOrThrow("trips", null, v);
  }

  public synchronized void finish(long trip) {
    SQLiteDatabase d = getWritableDatabase();
    d.beginTransaction();
    try {
      d.execSQL(
          "UPDATE stops SET departure_ms=observed_ms WHERE trip_id=? AND departure_ms IS NULL",
          new Object[] {trip});
      d.execSQL(
          "UPDATE trips SET ended_ms=? WHERE id=?",
          new Object[] {System.currentTimeMillis(), trip});
      d.setTransactionSuccessful();
    } finally {
      d.endTransaction();
    }
  }

  public synchronized void restoreDetector(long trip, StopDetector detector) {
    Fix latest=latestFix();detector.reset();
    if(latest==null)return;
    long since=latest.time()-6*60*60*1000L;
    // Re-evaluate saved observations after a restart, including previously rejected GPS excursions.
    try(Cursor c=getReadableDatabase().rawQuery(
        "SELECT time_ms,latitude,longitude,accuracy_m,speed_mps FROM fixes WHERE time_ms>=? ORDER BY time_ms,id",new String[]{Long.toString(since)})) {
      if(c.moveToFirst()) {
        long first=c.getLong(0);
        for(Stop stop:stops(-1))if(stop.arrival()<=first&&stop.observed()>=first
            &&StopDetector.distance(stop.lat(),stop.lon(),c.getDouble(1),c.getDouble(2))<=RADIUS_FOR_RECOVERY) {
          detector.restore(stop.arrival(),first-1,stop.lat(),stop.lon(),true);break;
        }
        do {detector.accept(c.getLong(0),c.getDouble(1),c.getDouble(2),c.getFloat(3),c.getFloat(4));}while(c.moveToNext());
      }
    }
    if(detector.isStopped()) {
      long nearest=Long.MAX_VALUE;
      for(Stop stop:stops(-1)) {
        long delta=Math.abs(stop.arrival()-detector.arrival());
        if(stop.arrival()<=detector.arrival()+120_000&&stop.observed()>=detector.arrival()
            &&StopDetector.distance(stop.lat(),stop.lon(),detector.latitude(),detector.longitude())<=RADIUS_FOR_RECOVERY&&delta<nearest) {
          detector.persistedStopId=stop.id();nearest=delta;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  private static final double RADIUS_FOR_RECOVERY=60;

  public synchronized long record(long trip, Location l, StopDetector detector) {
    long newStopId = -1;
    SQLiteDatabase d = getWritableDatabase();
    d.beginTransaction();
    try {
      ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
      v.put("trip_id", trip);
      v.put("time_ms", l.getTime());
      v.put("latitude", l.getLatitude());
      v.put("longitude", l.getLongitude());
      v.put("accuracy_m", l.getAccuracy());
      v.put("speed_mps", l.hasSpeed() ? l.getSpeed() : 0);
      if (l.hasAltitude()) v.put("altitude_m", l.getAltitude());
      if (l.hasBearing()) v.put("bearing_deg", l.getBearing());
      v.put("source", l.getProvider());
      d.insertOrThrow("fixes", null, v);
      StopDetector.Event e =
          detector.accept(
              l.getTime(),
              l.getLatitude(),
              l.getLongitude(),
              l.getAccuracy(),
              l.hasSpeed() ? l.getSpeed() : 0);
      if (e != null && e.closed())
        d.execSQL(
            "UPDATE stops SET departure_ms=? WHERE id=? OR (trip_id=? AND departure_ms IS NULL)",
            new Object[] {e.departure(), detector.persistedStopId, trip});
      if ((e != null && e.opened()) || (detector.isStopped() && detector.persistedStopId<0 && detector.stableSignal())) {
        ContentValues s = new ContentValues();
        s.put("trip_id", trip);
        s.put("arrival_ms", detector.arrival());
        s.put("observed_ms", l.getTime());
        s.put("latitude", detector.latitude());
        s.put("longitude", detector.longitude());
        newStopId = d.insertOrThrow("stops", null, s);
        detector.persistedStopId = newStopId;
      }
      if(detector.isStopped()&&detector.persistedStopId>0&&detector.stableSignal()) {
        try(Cursor old=d.rawQuery("SELECT arrival_ms,departure_ms FROM stops WHERE id=?",new String[]{Long.toString(detector.persistedStopId)})) {
          if(old.moveToFirst()&&(!old.isNull(1)||old.getLong(0)>detector.arrival()))
            log("Stop continuity","RECOVERED","stop="+detector.persistedStopId+"; previous_arrival_ms="+old.getLong(0)+"; previous_departure_ms="+(old.isNull(1)?"null":old.getLong(1))+"; stable return confirms original arrival_ms="+detector.arrival()+"; raw GPS retained");
        }
        d.execSQL("UPDATE stops SET arrival_ms=MIN(arrival_ms,?),observed_ms=?,departure_ms=NULL WHERE id=?",
            new Object[]{detector.arrival(),detector.observationTime(),detector.persistedStopId});
        // Replay confirmed one continuous dwell. Later open rows cannot also be active,
        // even if their anchors drifted outside the recovery radius.
        // Retain its ID/content; only the recovered canonical stop remains open.
        try(Cursor other=d.rawQuery("SELECT id,latitude,longitude,observed_ms FROM stops WHERE departure_ms IS NULL AND id!=? AND arrival_ms>=?",
            new String[]{Long.toString(detector.persistedStopId),Long.toString(detector.arrival())})) {
          while(other.moveToNext()) {
            d.execSQL("UPDATE stops SET departure_ms=observed_ms WHERE id=?",new Object[]{other.getLong(0)});
            log("Stop continuity","SUPERSEDED","stop="+other.getLong(0)+"; retained record and observed_ms="+other.getLong(3)+"; continuing canonical stop="+detector.persistedStopId);
          }
        }
      }
      d.setTransactionSuccessful();
    } finally {
      d.endTransaction();
    }
    context.getSharedPreferences("tracking_signal",0).edit()
        .putBoolean("uncertain",detector.isUncertain()).putLong("fix_ms",l.getTime())
        .putLong("last_reliable_ms",detector.observationTime())
        .putLong("stop_arrival_ms",detector.isStopped()?detector.arrival():0)
        .putLong("stop_id",detector.persistedStopId).apply();
    return newStopId;
  }

  public record Fix(
      long id, long trip, long time, double lat, double lon, float accuracy, float speed) {}

  public record Stop(
      long id,
      long trip,
      long arrival,
      long departure,
      long observed,
      double lat,
      double lon,
      String placeName,
      String locality,
      String district,
      String state,
      String country,
      String postalCode,
      String road,
      String geocodeStatus,
      long geocodeAttempt) {}

  private static final String STOP_COLUMNS =
      "id,trip_id,arrival_ms,departure_ms,observed_ms,latitude,longitude,place_name,locality,district,state,country,postal_code,road,geocode_status,geocode_attempt_ms";

  private static Stop readStop(Cursor c) {
    return new Stop(
        c.getLong(0),
        c.getLong(1),
        c.getLong(2),
        c.isNull(3) ? 0 : c.getLong(3),
        c.getLong(4),
        c.getDouble(5),
        c.getDouble(6),
        c.getString(7),
        c.getString(8),
        c.getString(9),
        c.getString(10),
        c.getString(11),
        c.getString(12),
        c.getString(13),
        c.getString(14),
        c.getLong(15));
  }

  public Float course(long fixId) {
    try(Cursor c=getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("SELECT bearing_deg FROM fixes WHERE id=?",new String[]{Long.toString(fixId)})){
      return c.moveToFirst()&&!c.isNull(0)?c.getFloat(0):null;
    }
  }
  public Fix latestFix() {
    try (Cursor c =
        getReadableDatabase()
            .rawQuery(
                "SELECT id,trip_id,time_ms,latitude,longitude,accuracy_m,speed_mps FROM fixes ORDER"
                    + " BY time_ms DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1",
                null)) {
      return c.moveToFirst()
          ? new Fix(
              c.getLong(0),
              c.getLong(1),
              c.getLong(2),
              c.getDouble(3),
              c.getDouble(4),
              c.getFloat(5),
              c.getFloat(6))
          : null;
    }
  }

  public record TripSummary(long id, long first, long count) {}
  public List<TripSummary> tripSummaries() {
    List<TripSummary> out = new ArrayList<>();
    try (Cursor c = getReadableDatabase().rawQuery(
        "SELECT t.id,COALESCE(MIN(f.time_ms),t.started_ms),COUNT(f.id) FROM trips t LEFT JOIN fixes f ON f.trip_id=t.id GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY t.id DESC", null)) {
      while(c.moveToNext()) out.add(new TripSummary(c.getLong(0),c.getLong(1),c.getLong(2)));
    }
    return out;
  }

  public List<Fix> fixes(long trip) {
    List<Fix> out = new ArrayList<>();
    try (Cursor c =
        getReadableDatabase()
            .rawQuery(
                "SELECT id,trip_id,time_ms,latitude,longitude,accuracy_m,speed_mps FROM fixes"
                    + (trip < 0 ? "" : " WHERE trip_id=?")
                    + " ORDER BY time_ms,id",
                trip < 0 ? null : new String[] {"" + trip})) {
      while (c.moveToNext())
        out.add(
            new Fix(
                c.getLong(0),
                c.getLong(1),
                c.getLong(2),
                c.getDouble(3),
                c.getDouble(4),
                c.getFloat(5),
                c.getFloat(6)));
    }
    return out;
  }

  public List<Stop> stops(long trip) {
    List<Stop> out = new ArrayList<>();
    try (Cursor c =
        getReadableDatabase()
            .rawQuery(
                "SELECT "
                    + STOP_COLUMNS
                    + " FROM stops"
                    + (trip < 0 ? "" : " WHERE trip_id=?")
                    + " ORDER BY arrival_ms,id",
                trip < 0 ? null : new String[] {"" + trip})) {
      while (c.moveToNext()) out.add(readStop(c));
    }
    return out;
  }

  public Stop stopById(long id) {
    try (Cursor c =
        getReadableDatabase()
            .rawQuery(
                "SELECT " + STOP_COLUMNS + " FROM stops WHERE id=?", new String[] {"" + id})) {
      return c.moveToFirst() ? readStop(c) : null;
    }
  }

  public static final long GEOCODE_RETRY_MS = 24L * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  public List<Long> pendingStopIds(int limit) {
    List<Long> ids = new ArrayList<>();
    try (Cursor c =
        getReadableDatabase()
            .rawQuery(
                "SELECT id FROM stops WHERE geocode_status='PENDING' OR (geocode_status='FAILED'"
                    + " AND geocode_attempt_ms<?) ORDER BY arrival_ms,id LIMIT ?",
                new String[] {"" + (System.currentTimeMillis() - GEOCODE_RETRY_MS), "" + limit})) {
      while (c.moveToNext()) ids.add(c.getLong(0));
    }
    return ids;
  }

  public synchronized void saveStopAddress(
      long id,
      String placeName,
      String locality,
      String district,
      String state,
      String country,
      String postalCode,
      String road) {
    ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
    String[] values = {placeName, locality, district, state, country, postalCode, road};
    for (int i = 0; i < ADDRESS_FIELDS.length; i++) v.put(ADDRESS_FIELDS[i], values[i]);
    v.put("geocode_status", "RESOLVED");
    v.put("geocode_attempt_ms", System.currentTimeMillis());
    getWritableDatabase()
        .update("stops", v, "id=? AND geocode_status!='RESOLVED'", new String[] {"" + id});
  }

  public synchronized void markGeocodeFailed(long id) {
    ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
    v.put("geocode_status", "FAILED");
    v.put("geocode_attempt_ms", System.currentTimeMillis());
    getWritableDatabase()
        .update("stops", v, "id=? AND geocode_status!='RESOLVED'", new String[] {"" + id});
  }

  public List<Long> trips() {
    List<Long> out = new ArrayList<>();
    try (Cursor c = getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("SELECT id FROM trips ORDER BY id DESC", null)) {
      while (c.moveToNext()) out.add(c.getLong(0));
    }
    return out;
  }

  public synchronized void log(String provider, String status, String detail) {
    ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
    v.put("time_ms", System.currentTimeMillis());
    v.put("provider", provider);
    v.put("status", status);
    v.put("detail", detail);
    getWritableDatabase().insertOrThrow("sync_logs", null, v);
  }

  public void logInferredGaps(List<TrailSegments.Segment> segments) {
    for (TrailSegments.Segment s : segments)
      if (s.inferred()) {
        TrailSegments.Sample a = s.points().get(0), b = s.points().get(1);
        ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
        v.put("time_ms", System.currentTimeMillis());
        v.put("provider", "Trail gap");
        v.put("status", "ESTIMATED");
        v.put(
            "detail",
            "fixes="
                + a.id()
                + ".."
                + b.id()
                + "; duration_ms="
                + (b.time() - a.time())
                + "; method=straight_line; GPS samples unchanged");
        getWritableDatabase()
            .insertWithOnConflict("sync_logs", null, v, SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_IGNORE);
      }
  }

  public String logs() {
    StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
    try (Cursor c =
        getReadableDatabase()
            .rawQuery(
                "SELECT time_ms,provider,status,detail FROM sync_logs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 40",
                null)) {
      while (c.moveToNext())
        b.append(new Date(c.getLong(0)))
            .append("\n")
            .append(c.getString(1))
            .append(" · ")
            .append(c.getString(2))
            .append("\n")
            .append(c.getString(3))
            .append("\n\n");
    }
    return b.length() == 0 ? "No manual updates yet." : b.toString();
  }

  public void export(Writer w) throws Exception {
    // Stream each feature rather than assembling a multi-year trail in memory.
    w.write("{\"type\":\"FeatureCollection\",\"schema_version\":1,\"features\":[");
    boolean first = true;
    try (Cursor c =
        getReadableDatabase().rawQuery("SELECT * FROM fixes ORDER BY trip_id,time_ms,id", null)) {
      while (c.moveToNext()) {
        JSONObject props = new JSONObject();
        props.put("kind", "fix");
        String[] names = {
          "id",
          "trip_id",
          "time_ms",
          "accuracy_m",
          "speed_mps",
          "altitude_m",
          "bearing_deg",
          "source"
        };
        for (String name : names) {
          int i = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(name);
          props.put(
              name,
              c.isNull(i)
                  ? JSONObject.NULL
                  : c.getType(i) == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_STRING
                      ? c.getString(i)
                      : c.getType(i) == Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER ? c.getLong(i) : c.getDouble(i));
        }
        JSONObject f =
            feature(
                c.getDouble(c.getColumnIndexOrThrow("longitude")),
                c.getDouble(c.getColumnIndexOrThrow("latitude")),
                props);
        if (!first) w.write(",");
        w.write(f.toString());
        first = false;
      }
    }
    DriveMetrics.Result metrics=driveMetrics();
    for (long trip : trips())
      for (Stop s : stops(trip)) {
        JSONObject p =
            new JSONObject()
                .put("kind", "stop")
                .put("id", s.id())
                .put("trip_id", trip)
                .put("arrival_ms", s.arrival())
                .put("departure_ms", s.departure() == 0 ? JSONObject.NULL : s.departure())
                .put("observed_ms", s.observed())
                .put("duration_ms", s.observed() - s.arrival());
        DriveMetrics.Leg leg=metrics.stops().get(s.id());
        if(leg!=null)p.put("drive_since_previous_stop_m",leg.meters()).put("drive_average_kmh",leg.averageKmh()).put("drive_start_ms",leg.start()).put("drive_missing_ms",leg.missingMs());
        p.put("place_name", jsonValue(s.placeName()))
            .put("locality", jsonValue(s.locality()))
            .put("district", jsonValue(s.district()))
            .put("state", jsonValue(s.state()))
            .put("country", jsonValue(s.country()))
            .put("postal_code", jsonValue(s.postalCode()))
            .put("road", jsonValue(s.road()))
            .put("geocode_status", s.geocodeStatus());
        if (!first) w.write(",");
        w.write(feature(s.lon(), s.lat(), p).toString());
        first = false;
      }
    w.write("]}");
    w.flush();
  }

  private static final String[] BACKUP_TABLES = {"trips", "fixes", "stops", "sync_logs"};

  /** JSON snapshot preserves normalized tables, IDs, units and nullable values. */
  public void writeBackup(Writer output) throws Exception {
    android.util.JsonWriter w = new android.util.JsonWriter(output);
    SQLiteDatabase d = getReadableDatabase();
    // Android 15+ supports a real read snapshot: backups do not reserve the writer.
    if(android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=35)d.beginTransactionReadOnly();
    else d.beginTransactionNonExclusive();
    try {
      w.beginObject();
      w.name("otrail_backup_version").value(1);
      w.name("created_ms").value(System.currentTimeMillis());
      for (String table : BACKUP_TABLES) {
        w.name(table).beginArray();
        try (Cursor c = d.rawQuery("SELECT * FROM " + table + " ORDER BY id", null)) {
          while (c.moveToNext()) {
            w.beginObject();
            for (int i = 0; i < c.getColumnCount(); i++) {
              w.name(c.getColumnName(i));
              switch (c.getType(i)) {
                case Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_NULL:
                  w.nullValue();
                  break;
                case Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_INTEGER:
                  w.value(c.getLong(i));
                  break;
                case Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT:
                  w.value(c.getDouble(i));
                  break;
                default:
                  w.value(c.getString(i));
              }
            }
            w.endObject();
          }
        }
        w.endArray();
      }
      w.name("settings").beginObject();
      android.content.SharedPreferences ui = context.getSharedPreferences("MainActivity", 0);
      w.name("provider").value(ui.getInt("provider", 0));
      w.name("offline").value(ui.getBoolean("offline", false));
      android.content.SharedPreferences pack = context.getSharedPreferences("packs", 0);
      for (String key :
          new String[] {
            "mapsforge_status",
            "geofabrik_status",
            "mapsforge_retained",
            "geofabrik_retained",
            "raw_path"
          }) if (pack.contains(key)) w.name(key).value(pack.getString(key, ""));
      w.endObject();
      w.endObject();
      w.flush();
      d.setTransactionSuccessful();
    } finally {
      d.endTransaction();
    }
  }

  /** Merge history with new always-on fixes. Any parsing failure rolls back the whole restore. */
  public void restoreBackup(Reader input) throws Exception {
    android.util.JsonReader r = new android.util.JsonReader(input);
    android.content.ContentValues settings = new android.content.ContentValues();
    SQLiteDatabase d = getWritableDatabase();
    d.beginTransaction();
    try {
      r.beginObject();
      if (!r.hasNext() || !r.nextName().equals("otrail_backup_version") || r.nextInt() != 1)
        throw new IOException("Not a supported oTraiL backup");
      java.util.Set<String> restored = new java.util.HashSet<>();
      java.util.Map<Long, Long> tripIds = new java.util.HashMap<>();
      java.util.Set<Long> historicalTrips = new java.util.HashSet<>();
      while (r.hasNext()) {
        String table = r.nextName();
        if (table.equals("settings")) {
          r.beginObject();
          while (r.hasNext()) {
            String key = r.nextName();
            if (key.equals("provider")) {
              int value = r.nextInt();
              if (value < 0 || value > 2) throw new IOException("Invalid provider");
              settings.put(key, value);
            } else if (key.equals("offline")) settings.put(key, r.nextBoolean());
            else if (java.util.Arrays.asList(
                    "mapsforge_status",
                    "geofabrik_status",
                    "mapsforge_retained",
                    "geofabrik_retained",
                    "raw_path")
                .contains(key)) settings.put(key, r.nextString());
            else r.skipValue();
          }
          r.endObject();
          continue;
        }
        if (!java.util.Arrays.asList(BACKUP_TABLES).contains(table)) {
          r.skipValue();
          continue;
        }
        if (!restored.add(table)) throw new IOException("Duplicate table in backup");
        java.util.Set<String> allowed = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        try (Cursor columns = d.rawQuery("SELECT * FROM " + table + " LIMIT 0", null)) {
          java.util.Collections.addAll(allowed, columns.getColumnNames());
        }
        r.beginArray();
        while (r.hasNext()) {
          ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
          r.beginObject();
          while (r.hasNext()) {
            String field = r.nextName();
            if (!allowed.contains(field)) throw new IOException("Unknown backup field: " + field);
            if (r.peek() == android.util.JsonToken.NULL) {
              r.nextNull();
              v.putNull(field);
            } else {
              v.put(field, r.nextString());
            }
          }
          r.endObject();
          if (table.equals("trips")) {
            long original = v.getAsLong("id");
            long mapped = -1;
            try (Cursor existing =
                d.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT id FROM trips WHERE started_ms=? LIMIT 1",
                    new String[] {v.getAsString("started_ms")})) {
              if (existing.moveToFirst()) mapped = existing.getLong(0);
            }
            if (mapped == -1) {
              v.remove("id");
              if (v.get("ended_ms") == null) {
                v.put("ended_ms", v.getAsLong("started_ms"));
              }
              mapped = d.insertOrThrow(table, null, v);
              historicalTrips.add(mapped);
            }
            tripIds.put(original, mapped);
          } else if (table.equals("fixes") || table.equals("stops")) {
            Long mapped = tripIds.get(v.getAsLong("trip_id"));
            if (mapped == null) throw new IOException("Backup references an unknown trip");
            v.put("trip_id", mapped);
            v.remove("id");
            String time = table.equals("fixes") ? "time_ms" : "arrival_ms";
            boolean duplicate;
            try (Cursor existing =
                d.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT id FROM " + table + " WHERE trip_id=? AND " + time + "=? LIMIT 1",
                    new String[] {"" + mapped, v.getAsString(time)})) {
              duplicate = existing.moveToFirst();
            }
            if (!duplicate) {
              if (table.equals("stops") && v.get("departure_ms") == null
                  && historicalTrips.contains(mapped))
                v.put("departure_ms", v.getAsLong("observed_ms"));
              d.insertOrThrow(table, null, v);
            } else if (table.equals("stops")) mergeStopAddress(d, v);
          } else {
            v.remove("id");
            boolean duplicate;
            try (Cursor existing =
                d.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT id FROM sync_logs WHERE time_ms=? AND provider=? AND status=? AND"
                        + " detail=? LIMIT 1",
                    new String[] {
                      v.getAsString("time_ms"),
                      v.getAsString("provider"),
                      v.getAsString("status"),
                      v.getAsString("detail")
                    })) {
              duplicate = existing.moveToFirst();
            }
            if (!duplicate) d.insertOrThrow(table, null, v);
          }
        }
        r.endArray();
      }
      r.endObject();
      if (restored.size() != BACKUP_TABLES.length) throw new IOException("Incomplete trail backup");
      if (r.peek() != android.util.JsonToken.END_DOCUMENT)
        throw new IOException("Unexpected data after backup");
      for (long id : historicalTrips)
        d.execSQL(
            "UPDATE trips SET ended_ms=MAX(COALESCE(ended_ms,started_ms),COALESCE((SELECT"
                + " MAX(time_ms) FROM fixes WHERE trip_id=?),started_ms)) WHERE id=?",
            new Object[] {id, id});
      d.setTransactionSuccessful();
    } finally {
      d.endTransaction();
    }
    android.content.SharedPreferences.Editor ui =
        context.getSharedPreferences("MainActivity", 0).edit();
    if (settings.containsKey("provider")) ui.putInt("provider", settings.getAsInteger("provider"));
    if (settings.containsKey("offline")) ui.putBoolean("offline", settings.getAsBoolean("offline"));
    ui.apply();
    android.content.SharedPreferences.Editor pack = context.getSharedPreferences("packs", 0).edit();
    for (String key : settings.keySet())
      if (!key.equals("provider") && !key.equals("offline")) {
        String value = settings.getAsString(key);
        if (key.endsWith("_status") && value.startsWith("Ready"))
          value = "Previously downloaded · import retained file";
        pack.putString(key, value);
      }
    pack.apply();
  }

  // Merge only missing address fields; restore never replaces an existing label or stop timing.
  private static void mergeStopAddress(SQLiteDatabase d, ContentValues incoming) {
    try (Cursor c =
        d.rawQuery(
            "SELECT id,place_name,locality,district,state,country,postal_code,road,geocode_status"
                + " FROM stops WHERE trip_id=? AND arrival_ms=? LIMIT 1",
            new String[] {incoming.getAsString("trip_id"), incoming.getAsString("arrival_ms")})) {
      if (!c.moveToFirst()) return;
      ContentValues update = new ContentValues();
      boolean hasAddress = false;
      for (int i = 0; i < ADDRESS_FIELDS.length; i++) {
        String existing = c.getString(i + 1), value = incoming.getAsString(ADDRESS_FIELDS[i]);
        if ((existing == null || existing.isBlank()) && value != null && !value.isBlank())
          update.put(ADDRESS_FIELDS[i], value);
        if (existing != null && !existing.isBlank() || value != null && !value.isBlank())
          hasAddress = true;
      }
      if (hasAddress
          && "RESOLVED".equals(incoming.getAsString("geocode_status"))
          && !"RESOLVED".equals(c.getString(8))) {
        update.put("geocode_status", "RESOLVED");
        update.put("geocode_attempt_ms", System.currentTimeMillis());
      }
      if (update.size() > 0) d.update("stops", update, "id=?", new String[] {"" + c.getLong(0)});
    }
  }

  private static Object jsonValue(String s) {
    return s == null ? JSONObject.NULL : s;
  }

  private JSONObject feature(double lon, double lat, JSONObject p) throws JSONException {
    return new JSONObject()
        .put("type", "Feature")
        .put(
            "geometry",
            new JSONObject()
                .put("type", "Point")
                .put("coordinates", new JSONArray().put(lon).put(lat)))
        .put("properties", p);
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import java.util.*;

/** Thirty-one source-palette pass colors; the user-selected continuity color stays separate. */
public final class TrailPalette {
  public static final int CONTINUITY=UiConfig.CONTINUITY;
  public static final int[] COLORS=UiConfig.TRAIL_COLORS;
  public record Stroke(int color,int pass,List<TrailSegments.Sample> points){}
  private record Cell(int x,int y){}
  private record Visit(int pass,long time,double x,double y,double dx,double dy){}
  private static Cell cell(double x,double y){return new Cell((int)Math.floor(x/35),(int)Math.floor(y/35));}
  /** Display-only highlight. Preserve inferred green strokes and all historical colors. */
  public static List<Stroke> highlightCurrent(List<Stroke> strokes,long start){
    List<Stroke> result=new ArrayList<>();
    for(Stroke stroke:strokes){
      if(stroke.pass()==0){result.add(stroke);continue;}
      List<TrailSegments.Sample> points=stroke.points();
      if(points.size()<2){result.add(stroke);continue;}
      int split=1;while(split<points.size()&&points.get(split).time()<start)split++;
      if(split==points.size()){result.add(stroke);continue;}
      if(split>1)result.add(new Stroke(stroke.color(),stroke.pass(),List.copyOf(points.subList(0,split))));
      result.add(new Stroke(UiConfig.LIVE_TRAIL_COLOR,stroke.pass(),List.copyOf(points.subList(split-1,points.size()))));
    }
    return result;
  }
  public static List<Stroke> build(List<TrailSegments.Segment> segments) {
    Map<Cell,Visit> visits=new HashMap<>();List<Stroke> out=new ArrayList<>();
    for(TrailSegments.Segment segment:segments) {
      if(segment.inferred()){out.add(new Stroke(CONTINUITY,0,segment.points()));continue;}
      List<TrailSegments.Sample> p=segment.points();List<TrailSegments.Sample> run=new ArrayList<>();int active=1;double unmatched=0;
      for(int i=1;i<p.size();i++) {
        TrailSegments.Sample a=p.get(i-1),b=p.get(i);
        double ax=a.lon()*102000,ay=a.lat()*111000,bx=b.lon()*102000,by=b.lat()*111000;
        double length=Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay),dx=length==0?0:(bx-ax)/length,dy=length==0?0:(by-ay)/length;
        boolean moving=length>=12 && b.time()>a.time() && length/((b.time()-a.time())/1000.0)>=1;
        int pass=1;boolean matched=false;int count=Math.min(500,Math.max(1,(int)Math.ceil(length/12)));
        if(moving)for(int j=0;j<=count;j++) {
          double f=j/(double)count,x=ax+(bx-ax)*f,y=ay+(by-ay)*f;Cell c=cell(x,y);
          Visit closest=null;double nearest=28;
          for(int sx=-1;sx<=1;sx++)for(int sy=-1;sy<=1;sy++) {
            Visit v=visits.get(new Cell(c.x()+sx,c.y()+sy));if(v==null)continue;
            double dot=dx*v.dx()+dy*v.dy();if(Math.abs(dot)<.8)continue;
            double d=Math.hypot(x-v.x(),y-v.y());if(d<nearest){closest=v;nearest=d;}
          }
          if(closest!=null){long age=a.time()-closest.time();double dot=dx*closest.dx()+dy*closest.dy();
            boolean another=age>90000 || dot<-.8&&age>=10000;
            pass=Math.max(pass,closest.pass()+(another?1:0));matched=true;
          }
        }
        if(!moving)pass=active;
        else if(!matched){unmatched+=length;if(active>1&&unmatched<=80)pass=active;}
        else unmatched=0;
        if(moving)for(int j=0;j<=count;j++){double f=j/(double)count,x=ax+(bx-ax)*f,y=ay+(by-ay)*f;visits.put(cell(x,y),new Visit(pass,b.time(),x,y,dx,dy));}
        if(run.isEmpty()){run.add(a);active=pass;}
        if(active!=pass){if(run.size()>1)out.add(new Stroke(COLORS[(active-1)%COLORS.length],active,List.copyOf(run)));run=new ArrayList<>();run.add(a);active=pass;}
        run.add(b);
      }
      if(run.size()>1)out.add(new Stroke(COLORS[(active-1)%COLORS.length],active,List.copyOf(run)));
    }
    return out;
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import java.util.*;

/** Display-only geometry. Inferred edges never enter the GPS fixes table or GeoJSON export. */
public final class TrailSegments {
  public record Sample(long id, long trip, long time, double lat, double lon) {}

  public record Segment(boolean inferred, List<Sample> points) {}


  public static List<Segment> build(List<Sample> samples, int maxPoints) {
    List<Segment> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (samples.isEmpty()) return result;
    List<Sample> observed = new ArrayList<>();
    observed.add(samples.get(0));
    for (int i = 1; i < samples.size(); i++) {
      Sample a = samples.get(i - 1), b = samples.get(i);
      long elapsed = b.time - a.time;
      boolean contiguous = a.trip == b.trip && elapsed > 0 && elapsed <= StopDetector.MAX_GAP_MS;
      if (contiguous) observed.add(b);
      else {
        result.add(new Segment(false, thin(observed, maxPoints)));
        observed = new ArrayList<>();
        observed.add(b);
        double distance = StopDetector.distance(a.lat, a.lon, b.lat, b.lon);
        if (elapsed > 0
            && distance / (elapsed / 1000.0) <= 60) result.add(new Segment(true, List.of(a, b)));
      }
    }
    result.add(new Segment(false, thin(observed, maxPoints)));
    return result;
  }

  private static List<Sample> thin(List<Sample> points, int max) {
    if (points.size() <= Math.max(2, max)) return List.copyOf(points);
    List<Sample> out = new ArrayList<>();
    int step = Math.max(1, (points.size() + max - 1) / max);
    for (int i = 0; i < points.size() - 1; i += step) out.add(points.get(i));
    out.add(points.get(points.size() - 1));
    return out;
  }
}

    int configured=switch(originalSp) {
      case 10 -> CAPTION_SIZE_SP; case 11 -> SECONDARY_SIZE_SP; case 12 -> BODY_SIZE_SP;
      case 13 -> MODE_SIZE_SP; case 14 -> SUBHEADING_SIZE_SP; case 15 -> STATUS_SIZE_SP;
      case 18 -> HEADING_SIZE_SP; case 19 -> CARD_TITLE_SIZE_SP;
      case 25 -> SETTINGS_TITLE_SIZE_SP; case 27 -> APP_TITLE_SIZE_SP;
      default -> originalSp;
    };
    return configured * TEXT_SCALE;
  }

package in.otrail;

import android.content.*;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.MatrixCursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import android.provider.OpenableColumns;
import java.io.*;

/** A single private verified APK, read-only, shared only with an explicit URI grant. */
public final class UpdateApkProvider extends ContentProvider {
  @Override
  public boolean onCreate() {
    return true;
  }

  private File file(Uri uri) throws FileNotFoundException {
    if (!"/verified.apk".equals(uri.getPath())) throw new FileNotFoundException();
    File file = new File(getContext().getFilesDir(), "updates/verified.apk");
    if (!file.isFile()) throw new FileNotFoundException();
    return file;
  }

  @Override
  public ParcelFileDescriptor openFile(Uri uri, String mode) throws FileNotFoundException {
    if (!"r".equals(mode)) throw new FileNotFoundException("Read only");
    return ParcelFileDescriptor.open(file(uri), ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_ONLY);
  }

  @Override
  public String getType(Uri uri) {
    return "application/vnd.android.package-archive";
  }

  @Override
  public Cursor query(Uri uri, String[] projection, String selection, String[] args, String order) {
    try {
      File f = file(uri);
      String[] columns =
          projection == null
              ? new String[] {OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, OpenableColumns.SIZE}
              : projection;
      MatrixCursor c = new MatrixCursor(columns);
      Object[] values = new Object[columns.length];
      for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++)
        values[i] =
            OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME.equals(columns[i])
                ? "oTraiL-update.apk"
                : OpenableColumns.SIZE.equals(columns[i]) ? f.length() : null;
      c.addRow(values);
      return c;
    } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  @Override
  public Uri insert(Uri uri, ContentValues values) {
    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
  }

  @Override
  public int delete(Uri uri, String where, String[] args) {
    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
  }

  @Override
  public int update(Uri uri, ContentValues values, String where, String[] args) {
    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.app.job.*;

public final class UpdateCheckService extends JobService {
  private volatile boolean stopped;

  @Override
  public boolean onStartJob(JobParameters params) {
    stopped = false;
    if (!AppUpdater.daily(this)) return false;
    AppUpdater.check(
        this,
        false,
        (update, message) -> {
          if (!stopped) jobFinished(params, false);
        });
    return true;
  }

  @Override
  public boolean onStopJob(JobParameters params) {
    stopped = true;
    return true;
  }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/in/otrail/UpdateControls.java

package in.otrail;

import android.app.*;
import android.widget.Toast;
import java.io.File;

final class UpdateControls {
  private final Activity activity;
  private File pending;

  UpdateControls(Activity a) {
    activity = a;
  }

  void show() {
    new AppDialogs(activity)
        .setTitle("oTraiL updates")
        .setMessage(
            AppUpdater.status(activity)
                + "\n\n"
                + "APK updates come from viskie/oTrail0/releases. Downloads work on cellular and"
                + " Wi-Fi. Installation uses Android's confirmation screen and preserves app data.")
        .setPositiveButton("Check now", (d, w) -> check())
        .setNeutralButton(
            AppUpdater.daily(activity) ? "Disable daily checks" : "Enable daily checks",
            (d, w) -> {
              AppUpdater.daily(activity, !AppUpdater.daily(activity));
              show();
            })
        .setNegativeButton("Close", null)
        .show();
  }

  void resume() {
    if (pending != null && activity.getPackageManager().canRequestPackageInstalls()) {
      File file = pending;
      pending = null;
      AppUpdater.install(activity, file);
    }
  }

  private void check() {
    Toast.makeText(activity, "Checking GitHub…", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
    AppUpdater.check(
        activity,
        true,
        (manifest, message) ->
            activity.runOnUiThread(
                () -> {
                  if (activity.isDestroyed() || activity.isFinishing()) return;
                  if (manifest == null) {
                    new AppDialogs(activity)
                        .setTitle("App updates")
                        .setMessage(message)
                        .setPositiveButton("Close", null)
                        .show();
                    return;
                  }
                  new AppDialogs(activity)
                      .setTitle("Update to " + manifest.versionName())
                      .setMessage(
                          manifest.notes()
                              + "\n\nDownload: "
                              + MapPacks.size(manifest.size())
                              + ". SHA-256 and the APK signing key will be checked before"
                              + " installation.")
                      .setPositiveButton("Download", (d, w) -> download(manifest))
                      .setNegativeButton("Later", null)
                      .show();
                }));
  }

  private void download(UpdateManifest manifest) {
    android.app.ProgressDialog progress = new android.app.ProgressDialog(activity);
    progress.setTitle("Downloading oTraiL " + manifest.versionName());
    progress.setProgressStyle(android.app.ProgressDialog.STYLE_HORIZONTAL);
    progress.setMax(100);
    progress.setCancelable(false);
    progress.show();
    AppUpdater.download(
        activity,
        manifest,
        new AppUpdater.DownloadCallback() {
          public void progress(int percent) {
            activity.runOnUiThread(
                () -> {
                  if (!activity.isDestroyed()) progress.setProgress(percent);
                });
          }

          public void done(File file, String error) {
            activity.runOnUiThread(
                () -> {
                  if (activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                  progress.dismiss();
                  if (error != null) {
                    new AppDialogs(activity)
                        .setTitle("Update not installed")
                        .setMessage(error)
                        .setPositiveButton("Close", null)
                        .show();
                    return;
                  }
                  new AppDialogs(activity)
                      .setTitle("Update verified")
                      .setMessage(
                          "Android will ask you to approve installation. If prompted, allow oTraiL"
                              + " to install app updates. Your trails and maps stay in place.")
                      .setPositiveButton(
                          "Install",
                          (d, w) -> {
                            pending = file;
                            if (activity.getPackageManager().canRequestPackageInstalls())
                              pending = null;
                            AppUpdater.install(activity, file);
                          })
                      .setNegativeButton("Later", null)
                      .show();
                });
          }
        });
  }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/in/otrail/UpdateManifest.java
================================================================================

package in.otrail;

import java.net.URI;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Restrict update artifacts to this repository; Android signing verification is an additional
 * check.
 */
public record UpdateManifest(
    long versionCode, String versionName, String url, String sha256, long size, String notes) {
  public static final String PREFIX =
      "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/viskie/oTrail0/main/releases/";

  public static UpdateManifest parse(String text) throws Exception {
    JSONObject j = new JSONObject(text);
    long code = j.getLong("versionCode"), size = j.getLong("sizeBytes");
    String version = j.getString("versionName"),
        url = j.getString("apkUrl"),
        sha = j.getString("sha256");
    URI uri = new URI(url);
    if (code <= 0
        || version.isBlank()
        || size < 100_000
        || size > 80L * 1024 * 1024
        || !url.startsWith(PREFIX)
        || !url.endsWith(".apk")
        || uri.getQuery() != null
        || uri.getFragment() != null
        || url.contains("..")
        || !sha.matches("[a-fA-F0-9]{64}"))
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid update manifest");
    return new UpdateManifest(
        code, version, url, sha.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT), size, j.optString("notes", ""));
  }

  public boolean newerThan(long installed) {
    return versionCode > installed;
  }
}

package in.otrail;
import org.json.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Nearest mapped sites in any direction, measured as straight-line distances. */
public final class WorshipNearby {
  public static final String[] RELIGIONS={"hindu","muslim","christian","sikh","buddhist"};
  public static final String[] LABELS={"Temple","Mosque","Church","Gurdwara","Buddhist"};
  public static String summary(JSONObject payload,double lat,double lon)throws Exception {
    double[] nearest=new double[5];Arrays.fill(nearest,Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
    JSONArray elements=payload.optJSONArray("elements");if(elements!=null)for(int i=0;i<elements.length();i++){
      JSONObject e=elements.getJSONObject(i),tags=e.optJSONObject("tags"),point=e.has("lat")?e:e.optJSONObject("center");if(tags==null||point==null)continue;
      if(!"place_of_worship".equals(tags.optString("amenity")))continue;
      double distance=PhotoIndex.distance(lat,lon,point.getDouble("lat"),point.getDouble("lon"));
      for(int r=0;r<5;r++)if(RELIGIONS[r].equals(tags.optString("religion"))&&distance<=UiConfig.LIVE_WORSHIP_RADIUS_M)nearest[r]=Math.min(nearest[r],distance);
    }
    StringBuilder result=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0;i<5;i++){if(i>0)result.append(i==3?"\n":" · ");result.append(LABELS[i]).append(": ");if(Double.isFinite(nearest[i]))result.append(nearest[i]<1000?String.format(Locale.US,"%.0f m",nearest[i]):String.format(Locale.US,"%.1f km",nearest[i]/1000));else result.append("not mapped ≤25 km");}return result.toString();
  }
}

    Octagon(int fill,int edge,boolean mask){this.fill=fill;this.edge=edge;this.mask=mask;}
    @Override public void draw(Canvas canvas){
      Rect b=getBounds();float stroke=Math.max(2,b.width()*.018f),radius=(Math.min(b.width(),b.height())/2f-stroke)*UiConfig.LOCATE_VISUAL_SCALE,cx=b.exactCenterX(),cy=b.exactCenterY();Path path=new Path();

      if(mask){paint.setColor(Color.WHITE);canvas.drawPath(path,paint);return;}

      paint.setShader(new LinearGradient(cx-radius,cy-radius,cx+radius,cy+radius,new int[]{UiConfig.LOCATE_BEVEL_LIGHT,fill,fill},null,Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));canvas.drawPath(path,paint);paint.setShader(null);paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);paint.setStrokeWidth(stroke);paint.setColor(edge);canvas.drawPath(path,paint);
    }
    @Override public void setAlpha(int alpha){paint.setAlpha(alpha);invalidateSelf();}@Override public void setColorFilter(ColorFilter filter){paint.setColorFilter(filter);invalidateSelf();}@Override public int getOpacity(){return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;}
  }

package in.otrail;

/** Camera geometry only: GPS courses are clockwise from true north, map rotation is clockwise. */
public final class WtfCamera {
  private WtfCamera() {}
  public static float diagonalBearing(){return normalize((float)Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(UiConfig.WTF_DIAGONAL_X,UiConfig.WTF_DIAGONAL_Y)));}
  public static float normalize(float degrees){return (degrees%360+360)%360;}
  public static float rotation(float trueCourse){return normalize(diagonalBearing()-trueCourse);}
  public static float shortestTurn(float current,float target){return (normalize(target)-normalize(current)+540)%360-180;}
  public static boolean reliable(long now,long fixTime,float accuracy,float speed,boolean stopped){return !stopped&&now-fixTime>=-10000&&now-fixTime<=30000&&Float.isFinite(accuracy)&&accuracy>0&&accuracy<=UiConfig.WTF_MAX_ACCURACY_M&&Float.isFinite(speed)&&speed>=UiConfig.WTF_MIN_SPEED_MPS;}
  /** Falls back to displacement only if it clearly exceeds the combined location uncertainty. */
  public static Float displacementCourse(long time,long priorTime,double lat,double lon,double priorLat,double priorLon,float accuracy,float priorAccuracy){
    if(!Float.isFinite(accuracy)||!Float.isFinite(priorAccuracy)||!Double.isFinite(lat)||!Double.isFinite(lon)||!Double.isFinite(priorLat)||!Double.isFinite(priorLon)||accuracy<=0||time<=priorTime||time-priorTime>60000||priorAccuracy<=0||priorAccuracy>UiConfig.WTF_MAX_ACCURACY_M)return null;
    double a=Math.toRadians(priorLat),b=Math.toRadians(lat),dl=Math.toRadians(lon-priorLon);
    double h=Math.pow(Math.sin((b-a)/2),2)+Math.cos(a)*Math.cos(b)*Math.pow(Math.sin(dl/2),2);
    double distance=12742000*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)));
    if(distance<Math.max(12,(accuracy+priorAccuracy)*.75))return null;
    return normalize((float)Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(Math.sin(dl)*Math.cos(b),Math.cos(a)*Math.sin(b)-Math.sin(a)*Math.cos(b)*Math.cos(dl))));
  }
}

package in.otrail;
import java.util.*;

import static org.junit.Assert.*;
public class DriveMetricsTest {
  private DriveMetrics.Point p(long t,double lon,float speed){return new DriveMetrics.Point(t,20,lon,4,speed);}
  @Test public void stopLegsAndCurrentDriveUseDepartureBoundaries(){

  @Test public void overlappingLegacyStopsNeverProduceNegativeLegs(){var r=DriveMetrics.calculate(List.of(p(1000,77,5),p(6000,77.001,5)),List.of(new DriveMetrics.Stop(1,2000,5000,5000),new DriveMetrics.Stop(2,3000,0,6000)));for(var l:r.stops().values()){assertTrue(l.meters()>=0);assertTrue(l.end()>=l.start());}}
  @Test public void stationaryJitterIsExcluded(){var r=DriveMetrics.calculate(List.of(p(1000,77,0),p(6000,77.00001,0)),List.of());assertEquals(0,r.totalMeters(),0);}

package in.otrail;

import static org.junit.Assert.*;

import org.junit.Test;

public class HistoricAgeTest {
  @Test
  public void datesAndApproximation() {
    assertEquals(1650, HistoricAge.parse("1650-04-12").earliest());
    assertTrue(HistoricAge.parse("c. 1650").approximate());
    assertFalse(HistoricAge.parse("1650").approximate());
  }

  @Test
  public void centuryAndRange() {
    assertEquals(1500, HistoricAge.parse("16th century").earliest());
    assertEquals(1599, HistoricAge.parse("C16").latest());
    assertTrue(HistoricAge.parse("1500..1600").approximate());
  }

  @Test
  public void ageBoundaries() {
    assertTrue(HistoricAge.parse("1826").inWindow(2026));
    assertTrue(HistoricAge.parse("1426").inWindow(2026));
    assertFalse(HistoricAge.parse("1827").inWindow(2026));
    assertFalse(HistoricAge.parse("1425").inWindow(2026));
  }

  @Test
  public void unknownAgeNotInvented() {
    assertNull(HistoricAge.parse("old temple"));
    assertNull(HistoricAge.parse("before 1700"));
    assertNull(HistoricAge.parse("200 BCE"));
  }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/in/otrail/NavigationTest.java

package in.otrail;

import static org.junit.Assert.*;

import java.util.*;
import org.json.*;
import org.junit.Test;

public class NavigationTest {
  private RoutePlan straight() {
    return new RoutePlan(
        List.of(new RoutePlan.Point(20, 77), new RoutePlan.Point(20.01, 77)),
        List.of(
            new RoutePlan.Step(0, "Head north"), new RoutePlan.Step(1112, "Arrive at destination")),
        1112,
        120);
  }

  private String fixture() throws Exception {
    return new JSONObject()
        .put("code", "Ok")
        .put(
            "routes",
            new JSONArray()
                .put(
                    new JSONObject()
                        .put("distance", 1112)
                        .put("duration", 120)
                        .put(
                            "geometry",
                            new JSONObject()
                                .put(
                                    "coordinates",
                                    new JSONArray("[[77,20],[77,20.005],[77,20.01]]")))
                        .put(
                            "legs",
                            new JSONArray()
                                .put(
                                    new JSONObject()
                                        .put(
                                            "steps",
                                            new JSONArray()
                                                .put(
                                                    new JSONObject()
                                                        .put("name", "Road A")
                                                        .put(
                                                            "maneuver",
                                                            new JSONObject()
                                                                .put("type", "depart")
                                                                .put("bearing_after", 0)
                                                                .put(
                                                                    "location",
                                                                    new JSONArray("[77,20]"))))
                                                .put(
                                                    new JSONObject()
                                                        .put("name", "Road B")
                                                        .put(
                                                            "maneuver",
                                                            new JSONObject()
                                                                .put("type", "turn")
                                                                .put("modifier", "right")
                                                                .put(
                                                                    "location",
                                                                    new JSONArray("[77,20.005]"))))
                                                .put(
                                                    new JSONObject()
                                                        .put("name", "")
                                                        .put(
                                                            "maneuver",
                                                            new JSONObject()
                                                                .put("type", "arrive")
                                                                .put(
                                                                    "location",
                                                                    new JSONArray(
                                                                        "[77,20.01]")))))))))
        .toString();
  }

  @Test
  public void parsesGeoJsonAndTurns() throws Exception {
    RoutePlan p = OsrmRouteParser.parse(fixture());
    assertEquals(20, p.points.get(0).lat(), 0);
    assertEquals(77, p.points.get(0).lon(), 0);
    assertEquals(3, p.steps.size());
    assertEquals("Turn right onto Road B", p.steps.get(1).instruction());
    assertTrue(p.steps.get(1).along() > 500);
  }

  @Test
  public void rejectsNoRoute() throws Exception {
    try {
      OsrmRouteParser.parse("{\"code\":\"NoRoute\",\"message\":\"No road\"}");
      fail();
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
      assertTrue(expected.getMessage().contains("No driving route"));
    }
  }

  @Test
  public void rejectsInvalidCoordinates() {
    try {
      new RoutePlan.Point(91, 77);
      fail();
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
    }
    try {
      new RoutePlan.Point(Double.NaN, 77);
      fail();
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
    }
  }

  @Test
  public void projectsBetweenVertices() {
    RoutePlan p = straight();
    RoutePlan.Match m = p.match(new RoutePlan.Point(20.005, 77), 0, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
    assertEquals(0, m.distance(), 1);
    assertEquals(p.length() / 2, m.along(), 2);
  }

  @Test
  public void requiresThreeAccurateOffRouteFixes() {
    NavigationProgress p = new NavigationProgress(straight());
    RoutePlan.Point outside = new RoutePlan.Point(20.005, 77.002);
    assertFalse(p.update(outside, 8, 1000).offRoute());
    assertFalse(p.update(outside, 8, 6000).offRoute());
    assertTrue(p.update(outside, 8, 11000).offRoute());
    assertFalse(p.update(new RoutePlan.Point(20.005, 77), 8, 16000).offRoute());
  }

  @Test
  public void ignoresInaccurateAndDuplicateFixes() {
    NavigationProgress p = new NavigationProgress(straight());
    assertFalse(p.update(new RoutePlan.Point(20, 77), 80, 1000).accepted());
    assertTrue(p.update(new RoutePlan.Point(20, 77), 8, 2000).accepted());
    assertFalse(p.update(new RoutePlan.Point(20.01, 77), 8, 2000).accepted());
  }

  @Test
  public void arrivalNeedsTwoGoodFixes() {
    NavigationProgress p = new NavigationProgress(straight());
    assertFalse(p.update(new RoutePlan.Point(20.0099, 77), 8, 1000).arrived());
    assertTrue(p.update(new RoutePlan.Point(20.01, 77), 8, 6000).arrived());
  }

  @Test
  public void doesNotArriveAtStartOfLoop() {
    RoutePlan.Point origin = new RoutePlan.Point(20, 77);
    RoutePlan route =
        new RoutePlan(
            List.of(
                origin,
                new RoutePlan.Point(20.005, 77),
                new RoutePlan.Point(20.005, 77.005),
                origin),
            List.of(),
            1800,
            180);
    NavigationProgress p = new NavigationProgress(route);
    assertFalse(p.update(origin, 8, 1000).arrived());
    assertFalse(p.update(origin, 8, 6000).arrived());
  }

  @Test
  public void advancesInstructionAfterDeparture() throws Exception {
    NavigationProgress p = new NavigationProgress(OsrmRouteParser.parse(fixture()));
    var g = p.update(new RoutePlan.Point(20.001, 77), 8, 1000);
    assertEquals("Turn right onto Road B", g.instruction());
    assertTrue(g.untilTurn() > 400 && g.untilTurn() < 500);
  }

  @Test
  public void roundaboutAndUTurn() throws Exception {
    assertEquals(
        "Enter roundabout · take exit 3",
        OsrmRouteParser.instruction(
            new JSONObject().put("type", "roundabout").put("exit", 3), "", ""));
    assertEquals(
        "Make a U-turn",
        OsrmRouteParser.instruction(
            new JSONObject().put("type", "turn").put("modifier", "uturn"), "", ""));
  }

  @Test
  public void rejectsInsecureRoutingEndpoint() throws Exception {
    try {
      OnlineRouting.server("http://example.com/route/");
      fail();
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
    }
    assertEquals("https://example.com/route/", OnlineRouting.server("https://example.com/route"));
  }

  @Test
  public void currentJournalCoordinatesNotMutated() {
    List<RoutePlan.Point> input =
        new ArrayList<>(List.of(new RoutePlan.Point(20, 77), new RoutePlan.Point(20.01, 77)));
    RoutePlan route = new RoutePlan(input, List.of(), 1000, 100);
    NavigationProgress progress = new NavigationProgress(route);
    progress.update(new RoutePlan.Point(20.005, 77), 8, 1000);
    assertEquals(input, route.points);
    input.clear();
    assertEquals(2, route.points.size());
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import static org.junit.Assert.*;
import java.io.InputStream;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.w3c.dom.*;

public class OfflineMapThemeTest {
  @Test public void cityCaptionUsesConfigAndRetainsZoomRule() throws Exception {
    try(InputStream stream=new OfflineMapTheme().getRenderThemeAsStream()) {
      Document document=DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance().newDocumentBuilder().parse(stream);
      NodeList rules=document.getElementsByTagName("rule");boolean found=false;
      for(int i=0;i<rules.getLength();i++) {
        Element rule=(Element)rules.item(i);
        if(!"place".equals(rule.getAttribute("k"))||!"city".equals(rule.getAttribute("v")))continue;
        Element caption=(Element)rule.getElementsByTagName("caption").item(0);
        assertEquals(UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_FONT,caption.getAttribute("font-family"));
        assertEquals(UiConfig.BIG_CITY_LABEL_STYLE,caption.getAttribute("font-style"));
        assertEquals(String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT,"#%08X",UiConfig.BIG_CITY_LABEL_COLOR),caption.getAttribute("fill"));
        assertEquals(OfflineMapTheme.citySize(25,7),Float.parseFloat(caption.getAttribute("font-size")),.001);
        assertEquals("22",rule.getAttribute("zoom-max"));assertEquals(4,rule.getElementsByTagName("caption").getLength());found=true;
      }
      assertTrue("Base map city rule should still exist",found);
      assertTrue("Road geometry rules should remain",rules.getLength()>100);
    }
  }
  @Test public void citySizesGrowWithZoomAndAreCapped(){
    assertTrue(OfflineMapTheme.citySize(25,7)<OfflineMapTheme.citySize(25,10));
    assertTrue(OfflineMapTheme.citySize(25,10)<OfflineMapTheme.citySize(25,13));
    assertTrue(OfflineMapTheme.citySize(25,13)<=OfflineMapTheme.citySize(25,18));
    assertEquals(UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_MAX_SIZE*UiConfig.CITY_LABEL_SIZE_SCALE,OfflineMapTheme.citySize(100,18),.001);
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import org.junit.Test;
import static org.junit.Assert.*;
import org.json.*;

public class OfflineRouteCodecTest {
  @Test public void brouterInstructionsAndGeometrySurviveCacheNormalization() throws Exception {
    String raw="{\"features\":[{\"geometry\":{\"coordinates\":[[77,20],[77.001,20],[77.001,20.001]]},\"properties\":{\"track-length\":222,\"total-time\":30,\"voicehints\":[[1,2,0,100,90]]}}]}";
    RoutePlan p=OsrmRouteParser.parse(OfflineRouteCodec.brouter(raw));
    assertEquals(3,p.points.size());assertEquals("Turn left",p.steps.get(1).instruction());
    assertEquals(222,p.distance,0);assertEquals(30,p.duration,0);
    assertEquals("Arrive at destination",p.steps.get(2).instruction());
  }
  @Test public void valhallaPolyline6AndManeuversSurviveNormalization() throws Exception {
    String shape=encode(20000000)+encode(77000000)+encode(1000)+encode(1000);
    JSONObject leg=new JSONObject().put("shape",shape).put("maneuvers",new JSONArray()
      .put(new JSONObject().put("begin_shape_index",0).put("instruction","Head south on Example Road"))
      .put(new JSONObject().put("begin_shape_index",1).put("instruction","Your destination is on the left")));
    String raw=new JSONObject().put("trip",new JSONObject().put("legs",new JSONArray().put(leg)).put("summary",new JSONObject().put("length",.15).put("time",20))).toString();
    RoutePlan p=OsrmRouteParser.parse(OfflineRouteCodec.valhalla(raw));
    assertEquals(2,p.points.size());assertEquals(20.001,p.points.get(1).lat(),.0000001);
    assertEquals(150,p.distance,0);assertEquals("Head south on Example Road",p.steps.get(0).instruction());
  }
  @Test public void valhallaErrorsAreActionable() throws Exception {
    try{OfflineRouteCodec.valhalla("{\"error_code\":171,\"error\":\"No suitable edges\"}");fail();}
    catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){assertTrue(expected.getMessage().contains("No suitable edges"));}
  }
  @Test public void incompletePolylineRejected() throws Exception {
    try{OfflineRouteCodec.decode("_");fail();}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){}
  }
  private static String encode(long n){long v=n<0?~(n<<1):n<<1;StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder();while(v>=32){s.append((char)((32|(v&31))+63));v>>=5;}return s.append((char)(v+63)).toString();}
}

package in.otrail;
import org.junit.Test;
import static org.junit.Assert.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import org.json.*;
public class SignedModuleCatalogTest {
 private JSONObject version()throws Exception{return new JSONObject().put("id","mod1").put("name","GOD").put("version","1.0.0").put("api",1).put("minApp",23).put("entry","in.otrail.extensions.mod1.SourceStudio").put("url",SignedModuleCatalog.PREFIX+"GOD-1.0.0.oTrail0").put("sha256","a".repeat(64)).put("sizeBytes",1000).put("installSalt",Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(new byte[16])).put("installHash",Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(new byte[32]));}
 private String[] signed(JSONObject item)throws Exception{
   KeyPairGenerator g=KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("RSA");g.initialize(2048);KeyPair keys=g.generateKeyPair();
   byte[] payload=new JSONObject().put("schema",1).put("versions",new JSONArray().put(item)).toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
   Signature s=Signature.getInstance("SHA256withRSA");s.initSign(keys.getPrivate());s.update(payload);
   return new String[]{new JSONObject().put("payload",Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(payload)).put("signature",Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(s.sign())).toString(),Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(keys.getPublic().getEncoded())};
 }
 @Test public void camCanBeSignedWithoutPasswordGate()throws Exception{JSONObject v=version().put("id","mod2").put("name","CAM").put("entry","in.otrail.extensions.cam.CameraModule").put("url",SignedModuleCatalog.PREFIX+"CAM-1.0.0.oTrail0");v.remove("installSalt");v.remove("installHash");String[] data=signed(v);assertEquals("",SignedModuleCatalog.parse(data[0],data[1]).get(0).installHash());}
 @Test public void trustedCatalogPreservesCustomExtensionAndVersion()throws Exception{String[] data=signed(version());var entries=SignedModuleCatalog.parse(data[0],data[1]);assertEquals("GOD",entries.get(0).name());assertEquals("1.0.0",entries.get(0).version());assertTrue(entries.get(0).url().endsWith(".oTrail0"));}
 @Test(expected=SecurityException.class) public void tamperedSignatureRejected()throws Exception{String[] data=signed(version());JSONObject changed=new JSONObject(data[0]);byte[] sig=Base64.getDecoder().decode(changed.getString("signature"));sig[0]^=1;changed.put("signature",Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(sig));SignedModuleCatalog.parse(changed.toString(),data[1]);}
 @Test(expected=SecurityException.class) public void signedExternalDownloadRejected()throws Exception{String[] data=signed(version().put("url","https://example.org/GOD.oTrail0"));SignedModuleCatalog.parse(data[0],data[1]);}

import static org.junit.Assert.*;
public class StopDetectorTest {
    @Test public void stopMustExceedTwoMinutes(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();for(int i=1;i<=25;i++)assertNull(d.accept(i*5000,20,77,8,0));assertFalse(d.isStopped());StopDetector.Event e=d.accept(130000,20,77,8,0);assertTrue(e.opened());assertTrue(d.isStopped());assertEquals(5000,e.arrival());assertNull(d.accept(135000,20.01,77,8,5));assertTrue(d.isStopped());}
    @Test public void signalGapPreservesConfirmedStop(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();for(int i=1;i<=26;i++)d.accept(i*5000,20,77,8,0);assertNull(d.accept(200000,20,77,8,0));assertTrue(d.isStopped());assertEquals(5000,d.arrival());}
    @Test public void restoredStopRetainsArrivalAndClosesOnMovement(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();d.restore(5000,130000,20,77,true);assertNull(d.accept(900000,20,77,8,0));assertEquals(5000,d.arrival());assertNull(d.accept(905000,20.001,77,8,5));StopDetector.Event e=null;for(int i=1;i<=4;i++)e=d.accept(905000+i*5000,20.001+i*.0002,77,8,5);assertNotNull(e);assertTrue(e.closed());assertEquals(900000,e.departure());}
    @Test public void confirmedStopSurvivesBoundaryJitter(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();for(int i=1;i<=26;i++)d.accept(i*5000,20,77,8,0);assertNull(d.accept(135000,20.00034,77,7,1.18f));assertNull(d.accept(140000,20.00033,77,12,.94f));assertTrue(d.isStopped());assertEquals(5000,d.arrival());}
    @Test public void poorAccuracyNeverCreatesStop(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();for(int i=1;i<100;i++)d.accept(i*5000,20,77,80,0);assertFalse(d.isStopped());}
    @Test public void movingFixesNeverCreateStop(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();for(int i=1;i<100;i++)d.accept(i*5000,20+i*.0002,77,8,4);assertFalse(d.isStopped());}
    @Test public void duplicateTimestampsIgnored(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();d.accept(5000,20,77,8,0);assertNull(d.accept(5000,21,77,8,5));assertEquals(5000,d.arrival());}
    @Test public void anchoredRadiusPreventsSlowDriftStops(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();for(int i=1;i<100;i++)d.accept(i*5000,20+i*.00005,77,8,0);assertFalse(d.isStopped());}
    @Test public void poorReceptionCannotCloseConfirmedStop(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();d.restore(5000,130000,20,77,true);assertNull(d.accept(135000,21,78,80,30));assertTrue(d.isStopped());assertTrue(d.isUncertain());assertEquals(5000,d.arrival());}
    @Test public void driftingExcursionRecoversOnThreeStableFixes(){
      StopDetector d=new StopDetector();d.restore(5000,130000,20,77,true);
      for(int i=1;i<=12;i++)assertNull(d.accept(130000+i*5000,20+i*.00009,77,15,2.3f));
      assertTrue(d.isStopped());assertTrue(d.isUncertain());
      assertNull(d.accept(200000,20,77,5,0));assertFalse(d.stableSignal());
      assertNull(d.accept(205000,20,77,5,0));assertFalse(d.stableSignal());
      assertNull(d.accept(210000,20,77,5,0));assertTrue(d.stableSignal());assertFalse(d.isUncertain());assertEquals(5000,d.arrival());
    }
    @Test public void falseSpeedAtSamePointDoesNotEndStop(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();d.restore(5000,130000,20,77,true);assertNull(d.accept(135000,20,77,15,35));assertTrue(d.isStopped());assertTrue(d.isUncertain());}
    @Test public void realDriveInReducedAccuracyEventuallyConfirmsDeparture(){StopDetector d=new StopDetector();d.restore(5000,130000,20,77,true);StopDetector.Event event=null;for(int i=0;i<=18;i++)event=d.accept(135000+i*5000,20.001+i*.0003,77,15,6.5f);assertNotNull(event);assertTrue(event.closed());assertFalse(d.isStopped());}
    @Test public void thirteenSecondFixesPreserveStopArrivalAcrossPoorReception(){
      StopDetector d=new StopDetector();StopDetector.Event opened=null;
      for(int i=1;i<=11;i++){StopDetector.Event e=d.accept(i*13000L,20,77,6,0);if(e!=null)opened=e;}
      assertNotNull(opened);assertTrue(opened.opened());assertEquals(13000L,d.arrival());
      assertNull(d.accept(156000L,20.002,77,80,15));assertTrue(d.isStopped());
      for(int i=13;i<=15;i++)assertNull(d.accept(i*13000L,20,77,6,0));
      assertTrue(d.isStopped());assertFalse(d.isUncertain());assertEquals(13000L,d.arrival());
    }
}

package in.otrail;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.Test;
import static org.junit.Assert.*;
public class TrailPaletteTest {
  private TrailSegments.Sample p(long t,double lon){return new TrailSegments.Sample(t,1,t,20,lon);}
  @Test public void repeatedReverseTraversalGetsAnotherColor(){var strokes=TrailPalette.build(List.of(new TrailSegments.Segment(false,List.of(p(1000,77),p(11000,77.002))),new TrailSegments.Segment(false,List.of(p(200000,77.002),p(210000,77)))));assertEquals(2,strokes.size());assertNotEquals(strokes.get(0).color(),strokes.get(1).color());assertEquals(2,strokes.get(1).pass());}
  @Test public void paletteHas31UniqueNonContinuityColors(){Set<Integer> colors=new HashSet<>();for(int c:TrailPalette.COLORS){assertNotEquals(TrailPalette.CONTINUITY,c);colors.add(c);}assertEquals(31,colors.size());}
  @Test public void inferredEdgesKeepDedicatedColorAndDoNotCountAsPasses(){var result=TrailPalette.build(List.of(new TrailSegments.Segment(true,List.of(p(1000,77),p(11000,77.002)))));assertEquals(TrailPalette.CONTINUITY,result.get(0).color());assertEquals(0,result.get(0).pass());}
  @Test public void shiftedGpsTraversalStillGetsAnotherColor(){
    var first=new TrailSegments.Segment(false,List.of(p(1000,77),p(11000,77.002)));
    var shifted=new TrailSegments.Segment(false,List.of(new TrailSegments.Sample(3,1,200000,20.00015,77.002),new TrailSegments.Sample(4,1,210000,20.00015,77)));
    var strokes=TrailPalette.build(List.of(first,shifted));assertEquals(2,strokes.get(strokes.size()-1).pass());assertNotEquals(strokes.get(0).color(),strokes.get(strokes.size()-1).color());
  }
  @Test public void perpendicularCrossingIsNotARepeatedRoad(){
    var first=new TrailSegments.Segment(false,List.of(p(1000,77),p(11000,77.002)));
    var crossing=new TrailSegments.Segment(false,List.of(new TrailSegments.Sample(3,1,200000,19.999,77.001),new TrailSegments.Sample(4,1,210000,20.001,77.001)));
    var strokes=TrailPalette.build(List.of(first,crossing));assertEquals(1,strokes.get(strokes.size()-1).pass());
  }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/in/otrail/TrailSegmentsTest.java

package in.otrail;

import static org.junit.Assert.*;

import java.util.*;
import org.junit.Test;

public class TrailSegmentsTest {
  private TrailSegments.Sample p(long id, long trip, long time, double lat) {
    return new TrailSegments.Sample(id, trip, time, lat, 77);
  }

  @Test
  public void entireTrailRetainsFirstAndLast() {
    List<TrailSegments.Sample> in = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) in.add(p(i, 1, 1000 + i * 5000, 20 + i * .00001));
    List<TrailSegments.Segment> out = TrailSegments.build(in, 10);
    assertEquals(in.get(0), out.get(0).points().get(0));
    List<TrailSegments.Sample> points = out.get(0).points();
    assertEquals(in.get(99), points.get(points.size() - 1));
  }

  @Test
  public void shortGapGetsSeparateEdge() {
    var out = TrailSegments.build(List.of(p(1, 1, 1000, 20), p(2, 1, 121000, 20.001)), 100);
    assertTrue(out.get(1).inferred());
    assertEquals(2, out.get(1).points().size());
  }

  @Test
  public void longGapsConnectButImpossibleSpeedsDoNot() {
    assertTrue(
        TrailSegments.build(List.of(p(1, 1, 1000, 20), p(2, 1, 3601000, 20.001)), 100).stream()
            .anyMatch(TrailSegments.Segment::inferred));
    assertTrue(
        TrailSegments.build(List.of(p(1, 1, 1000, 20), p(2, 1, 121000, 25)), 100).stream()
            .noneMatch(TrailSegments.Segment::inferred));
  }

  @Test
  public void differentJourneysNeverBecomeRecordedEdges() {
    var out = TrailSegments.build(List.of(p(1, 1, 1000, 20), p(2, 2, 6000, 20.00001)), 100);
    assertTrue(out.stream().anyMatch(TrailSegments.Segment::inferred));
    assertTrue(out.stream().filter(s -> !s.inferred()).allMatch(s -> s.points().size() == 1));
  }
}
