package in.otrail.extensions.mod1;

import in.otrail.modules.*;
import dalvik.system.DexClassLoader;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;
import org.json.*;

final class StudioTasks {
  static void merge(File source,File destination)throws IOException {
    if(source.isDirectory()){
      if(!destination.isDirectory()&&!destination.mkdirs())throw new IOException("Cannot create tool directory");
      File[] children=source.listFiles();if(children==null)throw new IOException("Cannot read tool directory");
      for(File child:children)merge(child,new File(destination,child.getName()));
      if(!source.delete())throw new IOException("Cannot remove tool staging directory");
    }else Files.move(source.toPath(),destination.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
  }
  static JSONObject metadata(File pkg)throws Exception{try(ZipFile zip=new ZipFile(pkg);InputStream in=zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("studio.json"))){return new JSONObject(new String(StudioFiles.read(in,100000),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}}
  static File download(JSONObject spec,File target,ModuleV1.Progress progress,String phase,int base,int span)throws Exception{
    String url=spec.getString("url");long size=spec.getLong("sizeBytes");
    if((!url.startsWith("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/viskie/oTrail0/main/")&&!url.startsWith("https://dl.google.com/android/repository/"))||url.contains("..")||size<1||size>250000000)throw new IOException("Untrusted or oversized tool artifact");
    if(target.isFile()&&target.length()==size&&StudioFiles.sha(target).equals(spec.getString("sha256")))return target;
    File part=new File(target.getPath()+".part");target.getParentFile().mkdirs();HttpURLConnection c=(HttpURLConnection)new URL(url).openConnection();c.setConnectTimeout(15000);c.setReadTimeout(45000);c.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);
    try{if(c.getResponseCode()!=200)throw new IOException("Download HTTP "+c.getResponseCode());try(InputStream in=c.getInputStream();FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(part)){
      byte[] b=new byte[65536];int n,last=-1;long count=0;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){if(progress.cancelled())throw new IOException("Cancelled");count+=n;if(count>size)throw new IOException("Download exceeds verified size");out.write(b,0,n);int p=(int)(count*100/size);if(p!=last){last=p;progress.update(phase,base+p*span/100,count+" / "+size+" bytes");}}out.getFD().sync();
    }if(part.length()!=size||!StudioFiles.sha(part).equals(spec.getString("sha256")))throw new SecurityException("Download checksum mismatch");Files.move(part.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);return target;
    }finally{c.disconnect();part.delete();}
  }
  static void run(File pkg,File data,String request,ModuleV1.Progress progress)throws Exception{
    JSONObject args=new JSONObject(request),meta=metadata(pkg);JSONObject chain=args.optJSONObject("_verifiedToolchain");if(chain!=null)for(Iterator<String> it=chain.keys();it.hasNext();){String key=it.next();meta.put(key,chain.get(key));}String action=args.getString("action");
    if(action.equals("source")){
      JSONObject spec=args.getJSONObject("source");String version=spec.getString("version");boolean trusted=false;JSONArray sources=meta.getJSONArray("sources");for(int i=0;i<sources.length();i++)if(sources.getJSONObject(i).getString("url").equals(spec.getString("url"))&&sources.getJSONObject(i).getString("sha256").equals(spec.getString("sha256"))&&sources.getJSONObject(i).getString("version").equals(version))trusted=true;
      if(!trusted||!version.matches("[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"))throw new SecurityException("Source version is not in this module's verified manifest");
      File dest=new File(data,"projects/otrail-"+version);
      if(!dest.isDirectory()){
        File zip=download(spec,new File(data,"downloads/source-"+version+".zip"),progress,"Download source",0,90);
        File stage=new File(data,"projects/stage-"+System.currentTimeMillis());try{StudioFiles.unzip(zip,stage);if(!new File(stage,"settings.gradle").isFile())throw new IOException("Invalid project archive");if(!stage.renameTo(dest))throw new IOException("Cannot activate source workspace");}finally{StudioFiles.remove(stage);}
      }
      StudioFiles.write(new File(data,"project.json"),new JSONObject().put("path",dest.getCanonicalPath()).toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));progress.update("Source ready",100,"Existing workspace edits retained.");
    }else if(action.equals("setup")){
      if(!args.optBoolean("acceptLicenses"))throw new IOException("Review and accept tool licenses first");
      JSONArray artifacts=meta.getJSONArray("tools");File target=new File(data,"tools");target.mkdirs();
      for(int i=0;i<artifacts.length();i++){
        JSONObject spec=artifacts.getJSONObject(i);String name=spec.getString("file");if(!name.matches("[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"))throw new IOException("Invalid tool filename");
        File zip=download(spec,new File(data,"downloads/"+name),progress,"Download "+name,i*100/artifacts.length(),100/artifacts.length());
        if(spec.has("extractFiles")){
          JSONObject extracts=spec.getJSONObject("extractFiles");try(ZipFile archive=new ZipFile(zip)){
            for(Iterator<String> it=extracts.keys();it.hasNext();){String entry=it.next(),dest=extracts.getString(entry);File output=StudioFiles.safe(target,dest);
              try(InputStream in=archive.getInputStream(archive.getEntry(entry));OutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(output)){byte[] b=new byte[32768];int n;long count=0;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){if((count+=n)>100000000)throw new IOException("SDK file too large");out.write(b,0,n);}}
            }
          }
        }else if(spec.optBoolean("archive")){File stage=new File(data,"tool-stage");StudioFiles.remove(stage);StudioFiles.unzip(zip,stage);File[] files=stage.listFiles();if(files!=null)for(File f:files){File dest=new File(target,f.getName());merge(f,dest);}StudioFiles.remove(stage);}else Files.copy(zip.toPath(),new File(target,spec.getString("target")).toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
      }
      JSONObject checks=meta.getJSONObject("toolFiles");for(Iterator<String> it=checks.keys();it.hasNext();){String name=it.next();if(!StudioFiles.sha(new File(target,name)).equals(checks.getString(name)))throw new IOException("Tool verification failed: "+name);}
      StudioFiles.write(new File(target,"ready.json"),checks.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));progress.update("Tools ready",100,"Compiler, SDK classpath, dependency DEX and APK template verified. Compilation is entirely offline.");
    }else if(action.equals("build")){
      File tools=new File(data,"tools"),dex=new File(tools,"compiler.jar");JSONObject checks=meta.getJSONObject("toolFiles");
      for(Iterator<String> it=checks.keys();it.hasNext();){String name=it.next();if(!StudioFiles.sha(new File(tools,name)).equals(checks.getString(name)))throw new IOException("Download/repair build tools first: "+name);}
      if(!dex.setReadOnly())throw new IOException("Cannot protect compiler code");
      File workspace=StudioFiles.project(data);File backup=StudioFiles.snapshot(workspace,data);progress.update("Source snapshot saved",5,backup.getName());
      DexClassLoader loader=new DexClassLoader(dex.getAbsolutePath(),new File(data,"compiler-cache").getAbsolutePath(),null,CompilerV1.class.getClassLoader());
      CompilerV1 compiler=(CompilerV1)loader.loadClass("in.otrail.extensions.god.compiler.CompilerEngine").getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
      compiler.compile(workspace,tools,data,meta.toString(),progress);
    }else if(action.equals("githubCheck")||action.equals("githubPublish")){
      File tools=new File(data,"tools"),dex=new File(tools,"publisher.jar");if(!dex.isFile()||!StudioFiles.sha(dex).equals(meta.getJSONObject("toolFiles").getString("publisher.jar")))throw new IOException("Download the selected toolchain first");
      if(!dex.setReadOnly())throw new IOException("Cannot protect publisher code");
      DexClassLoader loader=new DexClassLoader(dex.getAbsolutePath(),new File(data,"publisher-cache").getAbsolutePath(),null,PublisherV1.class.getClassLoader());
      PublisherV1 publisher=(PublisherV1)loader.loadClass("in.otrail.extensions.god.compiler.GitPublisher").getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
      args.put("toolchain",meta);publisher.run(action,data,args.toString(),progress);
    }else throw new IOException("Unknown in-app task");
  }
}

FILE: modules/mod2/README.md

# CAM — downloadable camera module

CAM is a separately downloaded `.oTrail0` module; its Camera2 implementation is not bundled in the host APK. Activate CAM in Settings → Extension modules. A camera icon appears beside Navigate; Settings gains Photo folder & camera settings. Recorded stop details gain Photos. All camera and album screens open inside oTraiL.

Requires host 0.4.1 (24), Android 11+. No installation password is required for CAM. Camera permission is requested only when the camera opens. No photos or coordinates are uploaded.

Capture controls include available lenses, JPEG resolution/quality, flash/torch, white balance, zoom, exposure compensation, autofocus/manual focus, grid, timer and manual ISO/shutter where the lens advertises support. Unsupported controls are hidden. Sensor settings vary across devices/lenses.

Default originals: Downloads/oTraiL/Photos. A persisted Storage Access Framework folder can be selected instead. Each JPEG has UTC capture time, logged GPS coordinates/fix timestamp/accuracy, stop ID and stable stop reference in EXIF and a `.jpg.json` recovery sidecar. Filenames use `oTrail;<stop_uid|no-stop>;<UTC time>;<latitude>;<longitude>;<photo UUID>.jpg`. An unrelated old stop is never assigned to a moving photo. A GPS fix older than two minutes is explicitly retained with its old timestamp and does not assign a stop.

A normalized `photos` table in trails.db indexes UUID, stop foreign key, capture time, location and URI. Existing trail/stop tables are preserved by an additive v3→v4 migration. A photo and its sidecar are saved before its row is inserted. Rebuilding the index is idempotent; restored stop IDs are resolved from logged capture time/location. Folder changes and module/app updates do not delete prior photos or settings. On reinstall, restore trail logs, reselect the original folder and rebuild the photo index. Public original photos must be retained/backed up separately from trail-only backups.

Validated on the connected POCO: 4000×3000 preview/capture, JPEG + sidecar persistence, stop #79 index linkage and in-app viewing with reverse stop details. Individual lens/manual control combinations still require device-specific checks. No map/GPS collector changes are included.

CAM 1.0.1 restores the Capture button after an image-reader error. Install/activate this version over any pre-publication phone-test package; its photo index, folder and module settings are retained.

      String[] all=manager.getCameraIdList();if(all.length==0)throw new IOException("No camera available");if(!Arrays.asList(all).contains(cameraId))cameraId=all[0];chars=manager.getCameraCharacteristics(cameraId);

      android.util.Size[] sizes=map.getOutputSizes(android.graphics.ImageFormat.JPEG);if(sizes==null||sizes.length==0)throw new IOException("Camera does not support JPEG");
      jpegSize=sizes[0];long best=0;String preferred=prefs().getString("resolution."+cameraId,"");for(android.util.Size size:sizes){long pixels=(long)size.getWidth()*size.getHeight();if(pixels<=12000000&&pixels>best){best=pixels;jpegSize=size;}if(size.toString().equals(preferred)){jpegSize=size;break;}}
      previewSize=map.getOutputSizes(SurfaceTexture.class)[0];long previewBest=Long.MAX_VALUE;for(android.util.Size size:map.getOutputSizes(SurfaceTexture.class)){long pixels=(long)size.getWidth()*size.getHeight();if(size.getWidth()<=1920&&size.getHeight()<=1080&&pixels>=640*480&&pixels<previewBest){previewSize=size;previewBest=pixels;}}
      cameraThread=new HandlerThread("CAM-camera");cameraThread.start();cameraHandler=new Handler(cameraThread.getLooper());long token=++generation;opening=true;
      renderControls();manager.openCamera(cameraId,new CameraDevice.StateCallback(){public void onOpened(CameraDevice device){if(token!=generation||!live||closed){device.close();return;}opening=false;camera=device;createSession(token);}public void onDisconnected(CameraDevice device){device.close();if(token==generation){camera=null;opening=false;message("Camera disconnected; return to Camera to retry");}}public void onError(CameraDevice device,int error){device.close();if(token==generation){camera=null;opening=false;message("Camera error "+error+"; return to Camera to retry");}}},cameraHandler);
    }catch(Exception e){opening=false;fail(e);closeCamera();}
  }
  private void createSession(long token){try {
    SurfaceTexture surface=texture.getSurfaceTexture();if(surface==null)return;surface.setDefaultBufferSize(previewSize.getWidth(),previewSize.getHeight());previewSurface=new Surface(surface);reader=ImageReader.newInstance(jpegSize.getWidth(),jpegSize.getHeight(),ImageFormat.JPEG,2);
    reader.setOnImageAvailableListener(source->{try(Image image=source.acquireNextImage()){if(image==null)return;ByteBuffer buffer=image.getPlanes()[0].getBuffer();byte[] jpeg=new byte[buffer.remaining()];buffer.get(jpeg);JSONObject context=pending;String folder=prefs().getString("folder","");if(context==null){message("Capture metadata missing; retry");return;}pending=null;work(()->{try{JSONObject saved=PhotoFiles.save(a,folder,jpeg,context,host);message("Saved · "+saved.getString("filename"));}finally{capturing=false;ui(()->{if(shutter!=null)shutter.setEnabled(true);});}});}catch(Exception e){capturing=false;ui(()->{if(shutter!=null)shutter.setEnabled(true);});fail(e);}},cameraHandler);
    camera.createCaptureSession(Arrays.asList(previewSurface,reader.getSurface()),new CameraCaptureSession.StateCallback(){public void onConfigured(CameraCaptureSession s){if(token!=generation||camera==null){s.close();return;}session=s;try{repeating=camera.createCaptureRequest(CameraDevice.TEMPLATE_PREVIEW);repeating.addTarget(previewSurface);apply(repeating);session.setRepeatingRequest(repeating.build(),null,cameraHandler);ui(()->{transform();message("Ready · "+jpegSize+" · tap preview to focus");});}catch(Exception e){fail(e);}}public void onConfigureFailed(CameraCaptureSession s){message("Camera stream combination unsupported; choose another lens/resolution");}},cameraHandler);
  }catch(Exception e){fail(e);}}
  private void transform(){if(texture==null||previewSize==null)return;int w=texture.getWidth(),h=texture.getHeight();if(w==0||h==0)return;int rotation=a.getWindowManager().getDefaultDisplay().getRotation();Matrix m=new Matrix();RectF view=new RectF(0,0,w,h);if(rotation==Surface.ROTATION_90||rotation==Surface.ROTATION_270){RectF buffer=new RectF(0,0,previewSize.getHeight(),previewSize.getWidth());buffer.offset(view.centerX()-buffer.centerX(),view.centerY()-buffer.centerY());m.setRectToRect(view,buffer,Matrix.ScaleToFit.FILL);float scale=Math.max((float)h/previewSize.getHeight(),(float)w/previewSize.getWidth());m.postScale(scale,scale,view.centerX(),view.centerY());m.postRotate(90*(rotation-2),view.centerX(),view.centerY());}else if(rotation==Surface.ROTATION_180)m.postRotate(180,view.centerX(),view.centerY());texture.setTransform(m);}
  private void apply(CaptureRequest.Builder b){
    b.set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_MODE,CaptureRequest.CONTROL_MODE_AUTO);int af=CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE_OFF;int[] afModes=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.CONTROL_AF_AVAILABLE_MODES);if(afModes!=null&&!manualFocus)for(int mode:afModes)if(mode==CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE_CONTINUOUS_PICTURE)af=mode;else if(af==CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE_OFF&&mode==CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE_AUTO)af=mode;b.set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE,af);if(manualFocus)b.set(CaptureRequest.LENS_FOCUS_DISTANCE,focus);
    b.set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AE_EXPOSURE_COMPENSATION,exposure);b.set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AE_MODE,manualSensor?CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AE_MODE_OFF:flash.equals("Auto")?CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AE_MODE_ON_AUTO_FLASH:flash.equals("Flash")?CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AE_MODE_ON_ALWAYS_FLASH:CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AE_MODE_ON);
    b.set(CaptureRequest.FLASH_MODE,flash.equals("Torch")?CaptureRequest.FLASH_MODE_TORCH:CaptureRequest.FLASH_MODE_OFF);
    int white=wb.equals("Daylight")?CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE_DAYLIGHT:wb.equals("Cloudy")?CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE_CLOUDY_DAYLIGHT:wb.equals("Incandescent")?CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE_INCANDESCENT:CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE_AUTO;b.set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE,white);
    Range<Float> zoomRange=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO_RANGE);if(zoomRange!=null)b.set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO,Math.max(zoomRange.getLower(),Math.min(zoom,zoomRange.getUpper())));
    else{Rect sensor=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SENSOR_INFO_ACTIVE_ARRAY_SIZE);if(sensor!=null){int w=(int)(sensor.width()/zoom),h=(int)(sensor.height()/zoom);b.set(CaptureRequest.SCALER_CROP_REGION,new Rect(sensor.centerX()-w/2,sensor.centerY()-h/2,sensor.centerX()+w/2,sensor.centerY()+h/2));}}
    if(manualSensor){Range<Integer> sr=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SENSOR_INFO_SENSITIVITY_RANGE);Range<Long> er=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SENSOR_INFO_EXPOSURE_TIME_RANGE);if(sr!=null)b.set(CaptureRequest.SENSOR_SENSITIVITY,Math.max(sr.getLower(),Math.min(iso,sr.getUpper())));if(er!=null)b.set(CaptureRequest.SENSOR_EXPOSURE_TIME,Math.max(er.getLower(),Math.min(exposureNs,er.getUpper())));}
  }
  private void update(){Handler h=cameraHandler;if(h!=null)h.post(()->{try{if(session!=null&&repeating!=null){apply(repeating);session.setRepeatingRequest(repeating.build(),null,cameraHandler);}}catch(Exception e){fail(e);}});}
  private void focusOnce(){Handler h=cameraHandler;if(h!=null)h.post(()->{try{if(camera==null||session==null)return;CaptureRequest.Builder b=camera.createCaptureRequest(CameraDevice.TEMPLATE_PREVIEW);b.addTarget(previewSurface);apply(b);b.set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE,CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE_AUTO);b.set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_TRIGGER,CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_TRIGGER_START);session.capture(b.build(),null,cameraHandler);}catch(Exception e){fail(e);}});}
  private void shutter(){if(capturing||camera==null||session==null){message("Camera is not ready");return;}capturing=true;shutter.setEnabled(false);if(timerSeconds>0)message("Capture in "+timerSeconds+" seconds…");long token=generation;main.postDelayed(()->{if(!live||token!=generation){capturing=false;if(shutter!=null)shutter.setEnabled(true);return;}try{long time=System.currentTimeMillis();JSONObject context=new JSONObject(host.photoContext(time));context.put("camera_id",cameraId).put("resolution",jpegSize.toString());pending=context;Handler h=cameraHandler;if(h==null)throw new IOException("Camera closed");h.post(()->capture(token));}catch(Exception e){capturing=false;shutter.setEnabled(true);fail(e);}},timerSeconds*1000L);}
  private void capture(long token){try{if(token!=generation||camera==null||session==null||reader==null)return;CaptureRequest.Builder b=camera.createCaptureRequest(CameraDevice.TEMPLATE_STILL_CAPTURE);b.addTarget(reader.getSurface());apply(b);b.set(CaptureRequest.JPEG_QUALITY,(byte)quality);int rotation=a.getWindowManager().getDefaultDisplay().getRotation()*90;Integer orientation=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SENSOR_ORIENTATION),facing=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.LENS_FACING);int sensor=orientation==null?90:orientation;b.set(CaptureRequest.JPEG_ORIENTATION,(sensor+(facing!=null&&facing==CameraCharacteristics.LENS_FACING_FRONT?rotation:-rotation)+360)%360);session.capture(b.build(),new CameraCaptureSession.CaptureCallback(){@Override public void onCaptureFailed(CameraCaptureSession s,CaptureRequest request,CaptureFailure failure){capturing=false;pending=null;ui(()->shutter.setEnabled(true));message("Photo capture failed: "+failure.getReason());}},cameraHandler);}catch(Exception e){capturing=false;pending=null;ui(()->shutter.setEnabled(true));fail(e);}}
  private interface Choice{void select(String value);}
  private void choices(String title,String[] values,Choice action){new AlertDialog.Builder(a).setTitle(title).setItems(values,(d,i)->action.select(values[i])).setNegativeButton("Cancel",null).show();}
  private interface Slider{void change(int value);}
  private void slider(String title,int max,int value,Slider change){TextView caption=label(title,12);controls.addView(caption);SeekBar bar=new SeekBar(a);bar.setMax(Math.max(1,max));bar.setProgress(Math.max(0,value));controls.addView(bar);bar.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener(){public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar b,int p,boolean user){if(user)change.change(p);}public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar b){}public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar b){}});}
  private void renderControls(){if(controls==null)return;while(controls.getChildCount()>1)controls.removeViewAt(1);
    buttons(controls,button("Flash / light",()->choices("Flash / light",Boolean.TRUE.equals(chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.FLASH_INFO_AVAILABLE))?new String[]{"Off","Auto","Flash","Torch"}:new String[]{"Off"},v->{flash=v;update();})),button("Timer",()->choices("Capture timer",new String[]{"0","3","10"},v->timerSeconds=Integer.parseInt(v))),button("Grid",()->{grid=!grid;previewBox.invalidate();for(int i=0;i<previewBox.getChildCount();i++)previewBox.getChildAt(i).invalidate();}));
    buttons(controls,button("Resolution",()->{try{android.util.Size[] sizes=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SCALER_STREAM_CONFIGURATION_MAP).getOutputSizes(ImageFormat.JPEG);String[] names=new String[sizes.length];for(int i=0;i<names.length;i++)names[i]=sizes[i].toString();choices("JPEG resolution",names,v->{prefs().edit().putString("resolution."+cameraId,v).apply();buildPage("camera");});}catch(Exception e){fail(e);}}),button("White balance",()->{int[] modes=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.CONTROL_AWB_AVAILABLE_MODES);ArrayList<String> supported=new ArrayList<>();if(modes!=null)for(int mode:modes){if(mode==CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE_AUTO)supported.add("Auto");if(mode==CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE_DAYLIGHT)supported.add("Daylight");if(mode==CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE_CLOUDY_DAYLIGHT)supported.add("Cloudy");if(mode==CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AWB_MODE_INCANDESCENT)supported.add("Incandescent");}choices("White balance",supported.toArray(new String[0]),v->{wb=v;update();});}),button("JPEG quality",()->choices("JPEG quality",new String[]{"85","95","100"},v->quality=Integer.parseInt(v))));
    Range<Float> zr=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO_RANGE);Float maximum=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SCALER_AVAILABLE_MAX_DIGITAL_ZOOM);float maxZoom=zr!=null?zr.getUpper():maximum==null?1:maximum;slider("Zoom · 1–"+String.format(Locale.US,"%.1f×",maxZoom),100,(int)((zoom-1)/Math.max(.01f,maxZoom-1)*100),v->{zoom=1+(maxZoom-1)*v/100;update();});
    Range<Integer> ev=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.CONTROL_AE_COMPENSATION_RANGE);if(ev!=null&&ev.getUpper()>ev.getLower()){exposure=Math.max(ev.getLower(),Math.min(exposure,ev.getUpper()));slider("Exposure compensation",ev.getUpper()-ev.getLower(),exposure-ev.getLower(),v->{exposure=ev.getLower()+v;update();});}
    Float minFocus=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.LENS_INFO_MINIMUM_FOCUS_DISTANCE);if(minFocus!=null&&minFocus>0){buttons(controls,button("Focus: auto / manual",()->{manualFocus=!manualFocus;message(manualFocus?"Manual focus enabled":"Continuous autofocus enabled");update();}));slider("Manual focus · infinity → near",100,(int)(focus/minFocus*100),v->{focus=minFocus*v/100;manualFocus=true;update();});}
    int[] capabilities=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.REQUEST_AVAILABLE_CAPABILITIES);boolean manual=false;if(capabilities!=null)for(int cap:capabilities)if(cap==CameraCharacteristics.REQUEST_AVAILABLE_CAPABILITIES_MANUAL_SENSOR)manual=true;
    if(manual){buttons(controls,button("Sensor: auto / manual",()->{manualSensor=!manualSensor;message(manualSensor?"Manual ISO/exposure enabled":"Auto exposure enabled");update();}));Range<Integer> sensitivity=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SENSOR_INFO_SENSITIVITY_RANGE);if(sensitivity!=null)slider("Manual ISO · "+sensitivity.getLower()+"–"+sensitivity.getUpper(),100,20,v->{iso=sensitivity.getLower()+(sensitivity.getUpper()-sensitivity.getLower())*v/100;manualSensor=true;update();});Range<Long> exposureRange=chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SENSOR_INFO_EXPOSURE_TIME_RANGE);if(exposureRange!=null){long high=Math.min(exposureRange.getUpper(),1000000000L);slider("Manual shutter · logarithmic, up to "+high/1000000+" ms",100,50,v->{exposureNs=(long)(exposureRange.getLower()*Math.pow((double)high/exposureRange.getLower(),v/100.0));manualSensor=true;update();});}}
    controls.addView(label("Controls depend on the selected lens. Capture uses the latest logged GPS and the active logged stop. Camera permission is requested only when opened.",12));
  }
  private void closeCamera(){generation++;opening=false;capturing=false;pending=null;if(session!=null){session.close();session=null;}if(camera!=null){camera.close();camera=null;}if(reader!=null){reader.close();reader=null;}if(previewSurface!=null){previewSurface.release();previewSurface=null;}repeating=null;if(cameraThread!=null){cameraThread.quitSafely();cameraThread=null;}cameraHandler=null;}
  @Override public void resume(){live=true;if(page.equals("camera"))openCamera();}
  @Override public void pause(){live=false;closeCamera();}

package in.otrail.extensions.cam;

import android.content.*;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.*;
import android.provider.*;
import android.media.ExifInterface;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.*;
import org.json.*;
import in.otrail.modules.ModuleV1;

/** Public originals plus self-contained sidecars allow recovery after reinstall/folder re-selection. */
final class PhotoFiles {
  static String filename(JSONObject j)throws Exception {
    SimpleDateFormat f=new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmssSSS'Z'",Locale.US);f.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC"));
    return "oTrail;"+j.optString("stop_uid","no-stop")+";"+f.format(new Date(j.getLong("captured_ms")))+";"+(j.has("latitude")?String.format(Locale.US,"%.6f;%.6f",j.getDouble("latitude"),j.getDouble("longitude")):"no-gps")+";"+j.getString("id")+".jpg";
  }
  static Uri create(Context c,String folder,String name,String mime)throws Exception {
    if(!folder.isEmpty()){
      Uri tree=Uri.parse(folder);Uri parent=DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree,DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree));
      Uri result=DocumentsContract.createDocument(c.getContentResolver(),parent,mime,name);if(result==null)throw new IOException("Folder did not create file");return result;
    }
    ContentValues v=new ContentValues();v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME,name);v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE,mime);v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH,Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS+"/oTraiL/Photos");v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING,1);
    Uri result=c.getContentResolver().insert(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,v);if(result==null)throw new IOException("Cannot create photo in Downloads");return result;
  }
  static void publish(Context c,String folder,Uri uri){if(folder.isEmpty()){ContentValues v=new ContentValues();v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING,0);c.getContentResolver().update(uri,v,null,null);}}
  static String rational(double n){long degrees=(long)Math.floor(Math.abs(n));double minutes=(Math.abs(n)-degrees)*60;long min=(long)minutes;return degrees+"/1,"+min+"/1,"+Math.round((minutes-min)*60*10000)+"/10000";}
  static void exif(Context c,Uri uri,JSONObject j)throws Exception {
    try(ParcelFileDescriptor p=c.getContentResolver().openFileDescriptor(uri,"rw")){
      if(p==null)throw new IOException("Cannot open photo metadata");ExifInterface e=new ExifInterface(p.getFileDescriptor());
      SimpleDateFormat f=new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy:MM:dd HH:mm:ss",Locale.US);f.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC"));String t=f.format(new Date(j.getLong("captured_ms")));
      e.setAttribute("DateTime",t);e.setAttribute("DateTimeOriginal",t);e.setAttribute("OffsetTimeOriginal","+00:00");e.setAttribute("SubSecTimeOriginal",String.format(Locale.US,"%03d",j.getLong("captured_ms")%1000));
      e.setAttribute("UserComment",j.toString());e.setAttribute("ImageDescription","oTraiL CAM; stop="+j.optString("stop_uid","no-stop")+"; fix_ms="+j.optLong("fix_ms",0)+"; accuracy_m="+j.optDouble("accuracy_m",-1));
      if(j.has("latitude")){double lat=j.getDouble("latitude"),lon=j.getDouble("longitude");e.setAttribute("GPSLatitude",rational(lat));e.setAttribute("GPSLatitudeRef",lat<0?"S":"N");e.setAttribute("GPSLongitude",rational(lon));e.setAttribute("GPSLongitudeRef",lon<0?"W":"E");e.setAttribute("GPSProcessingMethod","oTraiL logged GPS; see fix_ms");}
      e.saveAttributes();
    }
  }
  static JSONObject save(Context c,String folder,byte[] jpeg,JSONObject context,ModuleV1.Host host)throws Exception {
    JSONObject j=new JSONObject(context.toString());j.put("id",UUID.randomUUID().toString());j.put("filename",filename(j));j.put("schema",1);
    Uri photo=create(c,folder,j.getString("filename"),"image/jpeg");j.put("uri",photo.toString());Uri sidecar=null;
    try {
      try(OutputStream out=c.getContentResolver().openOutputStream(photo,"w")){if(out==null)throw new IOException("Cannot write photo");out.write(jpeg);}
      exif(c,photo,j);
      sidecar=create(c,folder,j.getString("filename")+".json","application/json");
      try(OutputStream out=c.getContentResolver().openOutputStream(sidecar,"w")){if(out==null)throw new IOException("Cannot write metadata sidecar");out.write(j.toString(2).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}
      publish(c,folder,photo);publish(c,folder,sidecar);
      // Original and recovery metadata are durable before the database row is inserted.
      host.savePhoto(j.toString());return j;
    }catch(Exception failure){
      // Never delete a saved photo because indexing failed: its sidecar permits later recovery.
      publish(c,folder,photo);if(sidecar!=null)publish(c,folder,sidecar);throw failure;
    }
  }
  static int scan(Context c,String folder,ModuleV1.Host host)throws Exception {
    ContentResolver r=c.getContentResolver();int count=0;
    if(folder.isEmpty())throw new IOException("Choose the existing photo folder first, then rebuild its index");
    Uri tree=Uri.parse(folder);String parent=DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree);Uri children=DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(tree,parent);
    Map<String,Uri> files=new HashMap<>();
    try(android.database.Cursor cursor=r.query(children,new String[]{DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME},null,null,null)){
      if(cursor!=null)while(cursor.moveToNext())files.put(cursor.getString(1),DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree,cursor.getString(0)));
    }
    for(Map.Entry<String,Uri> f:files.entrySet())if(f.getKey().endsWith(".jpg.json")&&f.getKey().startsWith("oTrail;")){
      Uri photo=files.get(f.getKey().substring(0,f.getKey().length()-5));if(photo==null)continue;
      try(InputStream in=r.openInputStream(f.getValue())){
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytes=new ByteArrayOutputStream();byte[] b=new byte[4096];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){if(bytes.size()+n>100000)throw new IOException("Metadata sidecar too large");bytes.write(b,0,n);}
        JSONObject j=new JSONObject(new String(bytes.toByteArray(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));j.put("uri",photo.toString());host.savePhoto(j.toString());count++;
      }
    }
    return count;
  }
}

# Journey summary

Status: planned; not implemented or enabled in Settings.
Stable ID: journey-summary

Optional daily distance, drive-duration and long-stop summaries. Reuse existing normalized fix and stop metrics, keeping estimated gaps distinguished from measured distance. The v1 snapshot is insufficient for daily grouping: extend a read-only host query API first, with work off the main thread and cancellation on shutdown. Validate old records, service restarts and no changes to raw journal rows.

# Road ahead

Status: planned; not implemented or enabled in Settings.
Stable ID: road-ahead

Extend existing cached road/landmark information with an optional upcoming-places panel. Prefer cached data; online refresh only under existing connectivity choices. No new recorder or GPS stream. Define distance limits, deduplication, background task ownership and cancellation before implementation. Reuse the core cache through a future read-only host API; do not open a competing trail database writer.

package in.otrail;

import android.app.*;
import android.content.*;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.*;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Toast;
import in.otrail.modules.ModuleV1;
import java.io.*;

public final class ModuleActivity extends Activity implements ModuleV1.Host {
  private ModuleV1 module;private ModuleStore store;private SignedModuleCatalog.Release release;
  @Override public void onCreate(Bundle state){super.onCreate(state);store=new ModuleStore(this);
    try{
      String id=getIntent().getStringExtra("id"),version=store.active(id);
      for(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r:store.catalog(false))if(r.id().equals(id)&&r.version().equals(version))release=r;
      if(release==null)throw new IOException("Activate a module version first");
      module=store.load(release);View view=module.create(this,this);setContentView(view);
    }catch(Exception|LinkageError e){failed(e);}
  }
  private void failed(Throwable e){
    CrashReports.save(this,"Downloaded module",e);Toast.makeText(this,"Module stopped: "+e.getMessage(),Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
    if(release!=null){try{store.rollback(release.id());}catch(Exception ignored){store.deactivate(release.id());}}finish();
  }
  private void photoAccess(){if(release==null||!release.id().equals("mod2"))throw new SecurityException("CAM photo capability required");}
  @Override public String photoContext(long time)throws Exception{photoAccess();try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(this)){return PhotoIndex.context(db,time).toString();}}
  @Override public void savePhoto(String json)throws Exception{photoAccess();try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(this)){PhotoIndex.save(db,json);}}
  @Override public String photos(long stop)throws Exception{photoAccess();try(TrailDb db=new TrailDb(this)){return PhotoIndex.list(db,stop);}}
  @Override public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int request,String[] permissions,int[] grants){super.onRequestPermissionsResult(request,permissions,grants);if(module!=null)try{module.permissionResult(request,permissions,grants);}catch(RuntimeException e){failed(e);}}
  @Override public File packageFile(){return store.file(release);}
  @Override public File privateDirectory(){File f=new File(getFilesDir(),"modules/data/"+release.id());f.mkdirs();return f;}
  @Override public String taskStatus(){return ModuleTaskService.readStatus(this,release.id());}
  @Override public String toolchains(boolean refresh)throws Exception{return store.toolchains(refresh);}
  @Override public String selectedToolchain()throws Exception{return store.selectedToolchain(release.id()).toString();}
  @Override public void selectToolchain(String id)throws Exception{
    org.json.JSONArray list=new org.json.JSONArray(store.toolchains(false));boolean found=false;for(int i=0;i<list.length();i++)if(list.getJSONObject(i).getString("id").equals(id))found=true;
    if(!found)throw new IOException("Toolchain is not in the verified catalog");
    android.util.AtomicFile atomic=new android.util.AtomicFile(new File(privateDirectory(),"selected-toolchain"));FileOutputStream out=atomic.startWrite();try{out.write(id.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));atomic.finishWrite(out);}catch(Exception e){atomic.failWrite(out);throw e;}
  }
  @Override public void cancelTask(){startService(new Intent(this,ModuleTaskService.class).setAction("cancel"));}
  @Override public void startTask(String request) throws Exception {
    if(request.length()>500000)throw new IOException("Module task too large");
    startForegroundService(new Intent(this,ModuleTaskService.class).putExtra("id",release.id()).putExtra("version",release.version()).putExtra("request",request));
  }
  @Override public void installBuiltApk(File file) throws Exception {AppUpdater.prepareBuiltApk(this,file);AppUpdater.install(this,new File(getFilesDir(),"updates/verified.apk"));}
  @Override protected void onActivityResult(int request,int result,Intent data){super.onActivityResult(request,result,data);if(module!=null)try{module.activityResult(request,result,data);}catch(RuntimeException e){failed(e);}}
  @Override protected void onResume(){super.onResume();if(module!=null)try{module.resume();}catch(RuntimeException e){failed(e);}}
  @Override protected void onPause(){if(module!=null)try{module.pause();}catch(RuntimeException e){CrashReports.save(this,"Module pause",e);}super.onPause();}
  @Override protected void onDestroy(){if(module!=null)try{module.close();}catch(RuntimeException e){CrashReports.save(this,"Module close",e);}super.onDestroy();}
  @Override public void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean focus){super.onWindowFocusChanged(focus);if(focus){getWindow().setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false);android.view.WindowInsetsController controller=getWindow().getDecorView().getWindowInsetsController();if(controller!=null){controller.setSystemBarsBehavior(android.view.WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE);controller.hide(android.view.WindowInsets.Type.systemBars());}}}

package in.otrail;

/** Stable IDs also name persisted enable flags; never reuse an ID for a different module. */

      new Entry("road-ahead","module_road_title","module_road_summary",false),
      new Entry("journey-summary","module_journey_title","module_journey_summary",false));
  static TrailModule create(String id){
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Module is not bundled: "+id);

package in.otrail;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/** Owns extension views/lifecycle; core GPS recording never depends on module enable flags. */
final class ModuleHost implements AutoCloseable {
  private final LinearLayout container;
  private final List<TrailModule> active=new ArrayList<>();
  private final Activity activity;
  ModuleHost(Activity activity){
    this.activity=activity;container=new LinearLayout(activity);container.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
    SharedPreferences prefs=activity.getSharedPreferences("modules",Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    for(ModuleCatalog.Entry entry:ModuleCatalog.ENTRIES){
      if(!entry.available()||!prefs.getBoolean(entry.id(),false))continue;
      TrailModule module=null;
      try{
        module=ModuleCatalog.create(entry.id());View view=module.createView(activity);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params=new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,-2);
        params.topMargin=params.bottomMargin=Math.round(3*activity.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
        container.addView(view,params);active.add(module);
      }catch(RuntimeException error){
        if(module!=null)try{module.close();}catch(RuntimeException ignored){}
        failure(error);
      }
    }
    container.setVisibility(active.isEmpty()?View.GONE:View.VISIBLE);
  }
  View view(){return container;}
  void update(TrailModule.Snapshot snapshot){
    for(TrailModule module:new ArrayList<>(active))try{module.update(snapshot);}
    catch(RuntimeException error){active.remove(module);try{module.close();}catch(RuntimeException ignored){}failure(error);}
  }
  private void failure(RuntimeException error){CrashReports.save(activity,"Extension module",error);}
  @Override public void close(){for(TrailModule module:active)try{module.close();}catch(RuntimeException error){failure(error);}active.clear();}
  static void settings(Activity activity){
    activity.startActivity(new android.content.Intent(activity,ModuleManagerActivity.class));
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.content.Context;
import dalvik.system.DexClassLoader;
import in.otrail.modules.ModuleV1;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.json.JSONObject;

final class ModuleStore {
  interface Progress { void update(int percent); }
  private final Context context;
  ModuleStore(Context c){context=c.getApplicationContext();}
  List<SignedModuleCatalog.Release> catalog(boolean refresh) throws Exception {
    File cache=new File(context.getFilesDir(),"modules/catalog.json");String text;
    if(refresh){
      text=OnlineRouting.get(SignedModuleCatalog.PREFIX+"catalog.json",1_000_000);
      List<SignedModuleCatalog.Release> verified=SignedModuleCatalog.parse(text,ModuleTrust.PUBLIC_KEY);
      cache.getParentFile().mkdirs();android.util.AtomicFile atomic=new android.util.AtomicFile(cache);FileOutputStream out=atomic.startWrite();
      try{out.write(text.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));atomic.finishWrite(out);}catch(Exception error){atomic.failWrite(out);throw error;}
      return verified;
    }
    if(!cache.isFile())return List.of();
    return SignedModuleCatalog.parse(new String(Files.readAllBytes(cache.toPath()),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8),ModuleTrust.PUBLIC_KEY);
  }
  String toolchains(boolean refresh) throws Exception {
    if(refresh)catalog(true);
    File cache=new File(context.getFilesDir(),"modules/catalog.json");
    if(!cache.isFile())return "[]";
    org.json.JSONArray list=SignedModuleCatalog.verified(new String(Files.readAllBytes(cache.toPath()),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8),ModuleTrust.PUBLIC_KEY).optJSONArray("toolchains");
    return list==null?"[]":list.toString();
  }
  JSONObject selectedToolchain(String id) throws Exception {
    File choice=new File(context.getFilesDir(),"modules/data/"+id+"/selected-toolchain");
    String selected=choice.isFile()?new String(Files.readAllBytes(choice.toPath()),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8):"";
    org.json.JSONArray list=new org.json.JSONArray(toolchains(false));
    for(int i=0;i<list.length();i++){
      JSONObject item=list.getJSONObject(i);
      if((selected.isEmpty()&&i==0)||selected.equals(item.getString("id"))){
        if(item.getInt("api")!=1||AppUpdater.installed(context)<item.getInt("minApp")||android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT<item.optInt("minSdk",30))throw new IOException("Toolchain requires a compatible host update");return item;
      }
    }
    throw new IOException("Refresh and select a compatible toolchain first");
  }
  File file(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r){return new File(context.getFilesDir(),"modules/packages/"+r.id()+"/"+r.version()+"/module.oTrail0");}
  boolean installed(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r){return file(r).isFile();}
  private File marker(String id){if(id==null||!id.matches("[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}"))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid module ID");return new File(context.getFilesDir(),"modules/active-"+id);}
  String active(String id){File f=marker(id);if(f.isFile())try{return new String(Files.readAllBytes(f.toPath()),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();}catch(IOException ignored){}return context.getSharedPreferences("downloaded_modules",0).getString("active."+id,"");}
  boolean available(String id){try{for(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r:catalog(false))if(r.id().equals(id)&&installed(r))return true;}catch(Exception ignored){}return false;}
  boolean enabled(String id){return !active(id).isEmpty()&&available(id);}
  void deactivate(String id){try{marker(id).getParentFile().mkdirs();Files.write(marker(id).toPath(),new byte[]{32});}catch(IOException ignored){}context.getSharedPreferences("downloaded_modules",0).edit().remove("active."+id).apply();}
  void activate(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r) throws Exception {
    ModuleV1 trial=load(r);trial.close();
    String previous=active(r.id());
    android.util.AtomicFile atom=new android.util.AtomicFile(marker(r.id()));FileOutputStream stream=atom.startWrite();try{stream.write(r.version().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));atom.finishWrite(stream);}catch(Exception e){atom.failWrite(stream);throw e;}
    context.getSharedPreferences("downloaded_modules",0).edit().putString("previous."+r.id(),previous).putString("active."+r.id(),r.version()).commit();
  }
  void rollback(String id) throws Exception {
    String previous=context.getSharedPreferences("downloaded_modules",0).getString("previous."+id,"");
    for(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r:catalog(false))if(r.id().equals(id)&&r.version().equals(previous)){activate(r);return;}
    throw new IOException("No previously active version is available");
  }
  void install(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r,char[] password,Progress progress) throws Exception {
    try {
      if(!r.installHash().isEmpty()){
      javax.crypto.spec.PBEKeySpec spec=new javax.crypto.spec.PBEKeySpec(password,java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(r.installSalt()),120000,256);
      byte[] check;try{check=javax.crypto.SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256").generateSecret(spec).getEncoded();}finally{spec.clearPassword();}
      if(!MessageDigest.isEqual(check,java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(r.installHash())))throw new SecurityException("Incorrect module installation password");
      }
    } finally { java.util.Arrays.fill(password, '\0'); }
    checkCompatibility(r);File ready=file(r);ready.getParentFile().mkdirs();
    File part=File.createTempFile("module-",".part",ready.getParentFile());
    HttpURLConnection c=(HttpURLConnection)new URL(r.url()).openConnection();c.setConnectTimeout(15000);c.setReadTimeout(30000);c.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);
    try{
      if(c.getResponseCode()!=200)throw new IOException("Module server HTTP "+c.getResponseCode());
      // Android 14+: mark the code file read-only before writing via the already-open descriptor.
      try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(part);InputStream in=c.getInputStream()){
        if(!part.setReadOnly())throw new IOException("Cannot protect module code");
        byte[] bytes=new byte[32768];int n,last=-1;long total=0;
        while((n=in.read(bytes))!=-1){if(Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted())throw new IOException("Download cancelled");total+=n;if(total>r.size())throw new SecurityException("Module exceeds catalog size");out.write(bytes,0,n);int p=(int)(total*100/r.size());if(p!=last){last=p;progress.update(p);}}
        out.getFD().sync();
      }
      verify(r,part);
      Files.move(part.toPath(),ready.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
    }finally{c.disconnect();part.delete();}
  }
  private void checkCompatibility(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r) throws Exception {
    if(r.api()!=ModuleV1.API_VERSION||AppUpdater.installed(context)<r.minApp()||android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT<r.minSdk())throw new IOException("This module requires a newer compatible oTraiL host");
  }
  private void verify(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r,File file) throws Exception {
    if(file.length()!=r.size())throw new SecurityException("Module size mismatch");
    MessageDigest digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");try(InputStream in=new FileInputStream(file)){byte[] b=new byte[32768];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1)digest.update(b,0,n);}
    if(!AppUpdater.hex(digest.digest()).equals(r.sha256()))throw new SecurityException("Module checksum mismatch");
    try(ZipFile zip=new ZipFile(file)){
      ZipEntry manifest=zip.getEntry("module.json");if(manifest==null||manifest.getSize()>16000||zip.getEntry("classes.dex")==null)throw new SecurityException("Invalid module package");
      JSONObject m=new JSONObject(new String(readManifest(zip.getInputStream(manifest)),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
      if(!r.id().equals(m.getString("id"))||!r.version().equals(m.getString("version"))||r.api()!=m.getInt("api")||!r.entry().equals(m.getString("entry")))throw new SecurityException("Module identity mismatch");
    }
  }
  private byte[] readManifest(InputStream stream) throws IOException {
    try(InputStream in=stream;ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream()){
      byte[] b=new byte[4096];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){if(out.size()+n>16000)throw new IOException("Module manifest too large");out.write(b,0,n);}return out.toByteArray();
    }
  }
  ModuleV1 load(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r) throws Exception {
    checkCompatibility(r);File pkg=file(r);verify(r,pkg);
    DexClassLoader loader=new DexClassLoader(pkg.getAbsolutePath(),context.getCodeCacheDir().getAbsolutePath(),null,ModuleV1.class.getClassLoader());
    Object object=loader.loadClass(r.entry()).getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
    if(!(object instanceof ModuleV1 module)||!module.id().equals(r.id()))throw new SecurityException("Module entry does not implement the expected API");return module;
  }
}

package in.otrail;

import android.app.*;
import android.content.*;
import android.os.*;
import in.otrail.modules.ModuleV1;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/** In-app, separate-process compiler worker. No external app, shell, server or trail DB access. */
public final class ModuleTaskService extends Service {
  private final ExecutorService worker=Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
  private volatile boolean busy,cancelled;
  private String moduleId="mod1";
  @Override public IBinder onBind(Intent i){return null;}
  @Override public int onStartCommand(Intent intent,int flags,int startId){
    if(intent!=null&&"cancel".equals(intent.getAction())){cancelled=true;if(!busy)stopSelf();return START_NOT_STICKY;}
    NotificationManager manager=getSystemService(NotificationManager.class);
    manager.createNotificationChannel(new NotificationChannel("module_tasks","Module build tools",NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));
    startForeground(2403,new Notification.Builder(this,"module_tasks").setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_sys_download).setContentTitle("oTraiL module tools").setContentText("Running on this phone").setOngoing(true).build());
    if(busy)return START_NOT_STICKY;if(intent==null){stopSelf();return START_NOT_STICKY;}
    moduleId=intent.getStringExtra("id");String version=intent.getStringExtra("version"),request=intent.getStringExtra("request");
    busy=true;cancelled=false;save("Starting",0,"",true);
    worker.execute(()->{ModuleV1 module=null;try{
      ModuleStore store=new ModuleStore(this);SignedModuleCatalog.Release release=null;
      for(SignedModuleCatalog.Release r:store.catalog(false))if(r.id().equals(moduleId)&&r.version().equals(version))release=r;
      if(release==null)throw new IOException("Module version unavailable");module=store.load(release);
      JSONObject task=new JSONObject(request);task.put("_verifiedToolchain",store.selectedToolchain(moduleId));
      module.task(store.file(release),directory(this,moduleId),task.toString(),new ModuleV1.Progress(){
        public void update(String phase,int percent,String log){save(phase,percent,log,true);}
        public boolean cancelled(){return cancelled||Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted();}
      });
      save(cancelled?"Cancelled":"Complete",cancelled?0:100,lastLog(),false);
    }catch(Exception|LinkageError error){save("Failed",0,lastLog()+"\n"+error.toString(),false);CrashReports.save(this,"Module task",error);}
    finally{if(module!=null)try{module.close();}catch(RuntimeException ignored){}busy=false;stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE);stopSelf();}});
    return START_NOT_STICKY;
  }
  private static File directory(Context c,String id){if(id==null||!id.matches("[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}"))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid module ID");File f=new File(c.getFilesDir(),"modules/data/"+id);f.mkdirs();return f;}
  static String readStatus(Context context,String id){try{
    File file=new File(directory(context,id),"job.json");
    if(!file.isFile())return "{\"phase\":\"Ready\",\"busy\":false,\"percent\":0,\"log\":\"\"}";
    String text=new String(Files.readAllBytes(file.toPath()),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    JSONObject state=new JSONObject(text);
    if(state.optBoolean("busy")){
      boolean alive=false;java.util.List<ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo> processes=context.getSystemService(ActivityManager.class).getRunningAppProcesses();
      if(processes!=null)for(ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo process:processes)if(process.pid==state.optInt("pid"))alive=true;
      if(!alive)state.put("busy",false).put("phase","Interrupted; source and prior APK retained");
    }
    return state.toString();
  }catch(Exception e){return "{\"phase\":\"Status unavailable\",\"busy\":false}";}}
  private String lastLog(){try{return new JSONObject(readStatus(this,moduleId)).optString("log","");}catch(Exception e){return "";}}
  private synchronized void save(String phase,int percent,String log,boolean running){try{
    if(log.length()>180000)log=log.substring(log.length()-180000);
    JSONObject json=new JSONObject().put("phase",phase).put("percent",percent).put("log",log).put("busy",running).put("pid",android.os.Process.myPid()).put("updated",System.currentTimeMillis());
    android.util.AtomicFile atomic=new android.util.AtomicFile(new File(directory(this,moduleId),"job.json"));FileOutputStream out=atomic.startWrite();
    try{out.write(json.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));atomic.finishWrite(out);}catch(Exception e){atomic.failWrite(out);}
  }catch(Exception e){CrashReports.save(this,"Module job status",e);}}
  @Override public void onDestroy(){cancelled=true;worker.shutdownNow();super.onDestroy();}
}

package in.otrail;
/** Public verification key only. Signing private key stays outside this repository. */
final class ModuleTrust { static final String PUBLIC_KEY=""; }

package in.otrail;

import java.net.URI;
import java.security.*;
import java.security.spec.X509EncodedKeySpec;
import java.util.*;
import org.json.*;

/** Signed catalog is the trust root for every downloadable executable version. */
public final class SignedModuleCatalog {
  public static final String PREFIX="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/viskie/oTrail0/main/modules/releases/";
  public record Release(String id,String name,String version,int api,int minApp,int minSdk,String entry,String url,String sha256,long size,String notes,String installSalt,String installHash) {}
  public static JSONObject verified(String envelope,String publicKey) throws Exception {
    if(envelope.length()>1_000_000)throw new SecurityException("Catalog too large");
    JSONObject signed=new JSONObject(envelope);
    byte[] payload=Base64.getDecoder().decode(signed.getString("payload"));
    Signature verifier=Signature.getInstance("SHA256withRSA");
    verifier.initVerify(KeyFactory.getInstance("RSA").generatePublic(new X509EncodedKeySpec(Base64.getDecoder().decode(publicKey))));
    verifier.update(payload);
    if(!verifier.verify(Base64.getDecoder().decode(signed.getString("signature"))))throw new SecurityException("Module catalog signature is invalid");
    JSONObject root=new JSONObject(new String(payload,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    if(root.getInt("schema")!=1)throw new SecurityException("Unsupported catalog schema");
    return root;
  }
  public static List<Release> parse(String envelope,String publicKey) throws Exception {
    JSONObject root=verified(envelope,publicKey);
    JSONArray versions=root.getJSONArray("versions");List<Release> out=new ArrayList<>();Set<String> seen=new HashSet<>();
    for(int i=0;i<versions.length();i++){
      JSONObject v=versions.getJSONObject(i);String id=v.getString("id"),version=v.getString("version"),url=v.getString("url"),sha=v.getString("sha256"),entry=v.getString("entry");
      URI uri=new URI(url);long size=v.getLong("sizeBytes");
      if(!id.matches("[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}")||!version.matches("[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")||!seen.add(id+"/"+version)
          ||!url.startsWith(PREFIX)||url.contains("..")||!url.endsWith(".oTrail0")||uri.getQuery()!=null||uri.getFragment()!=null
          ||!sha.matches("[a-f0-9]{64}")||size<100||size>20_000_000||!entry.matches("in\\.otrail\\.extensions\\.[A-Za-z0-9_.]+"))throw new SecurityException("Invalid module version");
      if(v.has("installHash")&&(Base64.getDecoder().decode(v.getString("installSalt")).length<16||Base64.getDecoder().decode(v.getString("installHash")).length!=32))throw new SecurityException("Invalid password verifier");
      out.add(new Release(id,v.getString("name"),version,v.getInt("api"),v.getInt("minApp"),v.optInt("minSdk",30),entry,url,sha,size,v.optString("notes",""),v.optString("installSalt",""),v.optString("installHash","")));
    }
    return List.copyOf(out);
  }
}

# Installable builds

## 0.2.4 — 2026-11-05

`oTraiL-0.2.4-debug.apk` — source commit `3811a1d`, versionCode 6.

- In-app online driving route preview, destination search/coordinates/map points, written turns, remaining distance/time and rate-limited automatic rerouting. No voice guidance or live traffic.
- Cached active routes can resume after restart and be followed offline; new paths/reroutes still need internet.
- Daily/manual update checks use `releases/latest.json`, not GitHub Releases. APK size/SHA-256/package/version/signing identity checked before opening Android's user-confirmed installer.
- Journal schema stays at 2. Route caches and updater files are separate from GPS fixes, stops, maps and backups. Signing certificate matches 0.2.3.

Validation: 29 passing JVM tests, Android lint without errors, debug app/instrumentation APK compilation. Live synthetic routing API + production parser smoke test: 244 points / 20 written maneuvers. Phone/road/UI/installer testing is pending because no device is connected; uploaded to GitHub as requested. The new journal-invariance instrumentation check is compiled but not executed. Install over the existing app to preserve its data; do not uninstall.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build GOD independently; only loader/API enter the main APK. Private keys stay outside Git."""
import argparse,base64,hashlib,io,json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,urllib.request,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,zipfile
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BUILD=ROOT/'modules/mod1/build'; BUILD.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
RELEASES=ROOT/'modules/releases'; RELEASES.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
SDK=pathlib.Path(os.environ['ANDROID_HOME']);JAVA=pathlib.Path(os.environ['JAVA_HOME'])
CLASSES=ROOT/'app/build/intermediates/javac/debug/compileDebugJavaWithJavac/classes'
D8=SDK/'build-tools/36.0.0/lib/d8.jar'; SIGNER=SDK/'build-tools/36.0.0/lib/apksigner.jar'
LIBS=BUILD/'libraries';LIBS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
MAVEN={'ecj':('org/eclipse/jdt/ecj/3.38.0','ecj-3.38.0.jar'),
'jgit':('org/eclipse/jgit/org.eclipse.jgit/6.10.0.202406032230-r','org.eclipse.jgit-6.10.0.202406032230-r.jar'),
'jgit-ssh':('org/eclipse/jgit/org.eclipse.jgit.ssh.jsch/6.10.0.202406032230-r','org.eclipse.jgit.ssh.jsch-6.10.0.202406032230-r.jar'),
'jsch':('com/github/mwiede/jsch/0.2.21','jsch-0.2.21.jar'),
'slf4j':('org/slf4j/slf4j-api/1.7.36','slf4j-api-1.7.36.jar'),
'ewah':('com/googlecode/javaewah/JavaEWAH/1.2.3','JavaEWAH-1.2.3.jar'),
'codec':('commons-codec/commons-codec/1.17.0','commons-codec-1.17.0.jar')}
def run(args):subprocess.run([str(x) for x in args],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
def sha(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with open(path,'rb') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()
def download(url,path):
 if not path.exists():
  print('Download',path.name,flush=True);subprocess.run(['curl','-L','-f','--retry','3','--connect-timeout','15','--max-time','240','-sS',url,'-o',str(path)],check=True)
 return path
def zipfiles(path,files):
 with zipfile.ZipFile(path,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as out:
  for name,file in files.items():out.write(file,name)
def jar(path,folder):zipfiles(path,{p.relative_to(folder).as_posix():p for p in folder.rglob('*.class')})
def javac(source,out,classpath):
 if out.exists():shutil.rmtree(out)
 out.mkdir(parents=True)
 run([JAVA/'bin/javac','-source','8','-target','8','-Xlint:-options','-encoding','UTF-8','-classpath',os.pathsep.join(map(str,classpath)),'-d',out,*source])
def fingerprint(jars):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 for file in jars:
  with zipfile.ZipFile(file) as z:
   for name in sorted(z.namelist()):
    if name.endswith('.class'):h.update(name.encode());h.update(z.read(name))
 return h.hexdigest()
def dex(name,jars,classpath=()):
 out=BUILD/name
 signature=fingerprint(jars)
 stamp=out/'.fingerprint'
 if stamp.exists() and stamp.read_text()==signature and list(out.glob('*.dex')):return out
 if out.exists():shutil.rmtree(out)
 out.mkdir()
 args=[JAVA/'bin/java','-Xmx1800m','-cp',D8,'com.android.tools.r8.D8','--min-api','30','--lib',SDK/'platforms/android-37.0/android.jar','--output',out]
 for item in classpath:args+=['--classpath',item]
 run(args+list(jars))
 files=list(out.glob('*.dex'))
 if name=='module-code' and len(files)!=1:raise RuntimeError(name+' exceeds single DEX; split toolchain code before publishing')
 stamp.write_text(signature)
 return out

def prepare():
 for name,(base,file) in MAVEN.items():download('https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/'+base+'/'+file,LIBS/(name+'.jar'))
 # Public Java compiler APIs are absent on ART; include the OpenJDK java.compiler API under its Classpath Exception.
 api=BUILD/'java-compiler-api.jar'
 with zipfile.ZipFile(JAVA/'jmods/java.compiler.jmod') as source,zipfile.ZipFile(api,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
  for name in source.namelist():
   if name.startswith('classes/javax/') and name.endswith('.class'):out.writestr(name[len('classes/'):],source.read(name))
 stubs=BUILD/'bootstrap-stubs';stubs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 run([JAVA/'bin/javac','--patch-module','java.base='+str(ROOT/'modules/mod1/compiler-stubs'),'-source','17','-target','17','-d',stubs,*list((ROOT/'modules/mod1/compiler-stubs').rglob('*.java'))])
 jar(BUILD/'compiler-stubs.jar',stubs)
 runtime=[]
 for line in (ROOT/'app/build/god-runtime-paths.txt').read_text().splitlines():
  path=pathlib.Path(line)
  if path.suffix=='.aar':
   with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
    for member in archive.namelist():
     if member=='classes.jar' or member.startswith('libs/') and member.endswith('.jar'):
      dest=BUILD/('runtime-'+hashlib.sha256((line+member).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]+'.jar');dest.write_bytes(archive.read(member));runtime.append(dest)

package btools.codec;

import btools.util.BitCoderContext;

/**
 * Container for some re-usable databuffers for the decoder
 */
public final class DataBuffers {
  public byte[] iobuffer;
  public byte[] tagbuf1 = new byte[256];
  public BitCoderContext bctx1 = new BitCoderContext(tagbuf1);
  public byte[] bbuf1 = new byte[65636];
  public int[] ibuf1 = new int[4096];
  public int[] ibuf2 = new int[2048];
  public int[] ibuf3 = new int[2048];
  public int[] alon = new int[2048];
  public int[] alat = new int[2048];

  public DataBuffers() {
    this(new byte[65636]);
  }

  /**
   * construct a set of databuffers except
   * for 'iobuffer', where the given array is used
   */
  public DataBuffers(byte[] iobuffer) {
    this.iobuffer = iobuffer;
  }

}

package btools.codec;

/**
 * Special integer fifo suitable for 3-pass encoding
 */
public class IntegerFifo3Pass {
  private int[] a;
  private int size;
  private int pos;

  private int pass;

  public IntegerFifo3Pass(int capacity) {
    a = capacity < 4 ? new int[4] : new int[capacity];
  }

  /**
   * Starts a new encoding pass and resets the reading pointer
   * from the stats collected in pass2 and writes that to the given context
   */
  public void init() {
    pass++;
    pos = 0;
  }

  /**
   * writes to the fifo in pass2
   */
  public void add(int value) {
    if (pass == 2) {
      if (size == a.length) {
        int[] aa = new int[2 * size];
        System.arraycopy(a, 0, aa, 0, size);
        a = aa;
      }
      a[size++] = value;
    }
  }

  /**
   * reads from the fifo in pass3 (in pass1/2 returns just 1)
   */
  public int getNext() {
    return pass == 3 ? get(pos++) : 1;
  }

  private int get(int idx) {
    if (idx >= size) {
      throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("list size=" + size + " idx=" + idx);
    }
    return a[idx];
  }
}

package btools.codec;

/**
 * Simple container for a list of lists of integers
 */
public class LinkedListContainer {
  private int[] ia; // prev, data, prev, data, ...
  private int size;
  private int[] startpointer; // 0=void, odd=head-data-cell
  private int listpointer;

  /**
   * Construct a container for the given number of lists
   * <p>
   * If no default-buffer is given, an int[nlists*4] is constructed,
   * able to hold 2 entries per list on average
   *
   * @param nlists        the number of lists
   * @param defaultbuffer an optional data array for re-use (gets replaced if too small)
   */
  public LinkedListContainer(int nlists, int[] defaultbuffer) {
    ia = defaultbuffer == null ? new int[nlists * 4] : defaultbuffer;
    startpointer = new int[nlists];
  }

  /**
   * Add a data element to the given list
   *
   * @param listNr the list to add the data to
   * @param data   the data value
   */
  public void addDataElement(int listNr, int data) {
    if (size + 2 > ia.length) {
      resize();
    }
    ia[size++] = startpointer[listNr];
    startpointer[listNr] = size;
    ia[size++] = data;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize a list for reading
   *
   * @param listNr the list to initialize
   * @return the number of entries in that list
   */
  public int initList(int listNr) {
    int cnt = 0;
    int lp = listpointer = startpointer[listNr];
    while (lp != 0) {
      lp = ia[lp - 1];
      cnt++;
    }
    return cnt;
  }

  /**
   * Get a data element from the list previously initialized.
   * Data elements are return in reverse order (lifo)
   *
   * @return the data element
   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if no more element
   */
  public int getDataElement() {
    if (listpointer == 0) {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("no more element!");
    }
    int data = ia[listpointer];
    listpointer = ia[listpointer - 1];
    return data;
  }

  private void resize() {
    int[] ia2 = new int[2 * ia.length];
    System.arraycopy(ia, 0, ia2, 0, ia.length);
    ia = ia2;
  }
}

FILE: third_party/brouter/src/main/java/btools/codec/MicroCache.java
